Thursday 12:34 PM

Up on the high-rise, around the 10th floor, sat the main office of the Evernight Restaurant chain. Five 4-star restaurants were located around the country, with the biggest here in Okhema city. Unlike some fancy restaurants, the waiting list was always very short. They tried very hard to accommodate everyone who wanted to dine.

The CEO's office had a special visitor today.

A tall woman in a grey suit was on the guest side of a huge office desk. “Mr. Deimos, I do wish to thank you again for this wonderful opportunity. The purchase of this estate will be just what you need to fully be on your own.” She was very relaxed in his presence. Everything was wonderful in their interactions.

Mydeimos Kremnos, the only heir to the Kremnos family fortune, head chef and CEO of the Evernight restaurants, was finally getting out on his own. He had been living with his parents for some time while finishing culinary and business school. Now that both schoolings were done and the restaurants were doing way better than before, his own place was a must.

He was a modest and simple man. He didn't need much, but a place to call his own and have some privacy. It was definitely needed after all the years of answering to butlers, maids, and his parents. Everyone was always a part of his business, whether he wanted them to or not.

Gorgo had mentioned to him in passing that his father had wanted him to find a partner and marry, but she knew her son. He was much like her in that he followed what his heart told him. When he wanted something, that's when he went after it. Knowing how determined he was to do well running his own company, she knew love wasn't even on the docket for him.

Proving himself as a capable leader and chef was the most important thing to him. Making good food was the glory that he sought after.

Now that all restaurants were turning a much better profit than before he took over, he used a small portion of his income and finally bought a house. Most of the other time, a good portion went to charity.

It was a modern home, but not overly eccentric. Most with money bought places that were just for show, hardly living in them. He wanted something practical.

He only had a few requirements for it: a restaurant-grade kitchen so the things he made there could also be made by his staff; a pool; and room enough for workout equipment. Keeping a fit mind and body was always a philosophy of his. Also, a room big enough for a small library. The books he'd collected over the years were steadily growing, plus the addition of artifacts he'd collected from various places. His own private collection was very important to him.

The biggest thing of all? Privacy. Away from the town and people. He liked the peace of nature. There were a bunch of places that had made offers. Everyone wanted the best head chef in the city to live in their establishment. There was a collective disappointment when he chose to buy his own place. They were all looking for clout.

And it just so happens that Mrs. Vipsania had the perfect place for him. It actually had a bit more features than what he was looking for, but the requirements were still met.

Finishing up a text she was in, "I was just in contact with your parents, and they will be getting the movers to get your stuff in right away. Looking through everything..." Shuffling through all the paperwork to make sure it was all signed and dated, "...We are good to go." She handed him the keys to the place.

"Mrs. Vipsania, I greatly appreciate your time in finding this place for me. I know I will be more than happy to finally be on my own. This place is just perfect. Thank you." Shaking her hand, she bowed and departed his office. On the way out, she passed his secretary coming in.

Finally getting a chance to sit, he poured a glass of imported pomegranate juice. “Congratulations on your new place, sir.”

“Thank you, Miss Castorice. Drink?” Offering her a glass.

She politely shook her head no. “I do hope that this new place will be less stressful for you. I know you have been complaining about home life for quite some time. Being an adult, you do need your privacy.”

He motioned for her to sit. “Yes, I agree. It was more than needed. It was very hard to even get five minutes to myself some days. At least now, I can finally drive that car I got to pick for my birthday a few years back.”

“Are you going to be alright not having any support people there? Just by yourself?” She was concerned that the heir was going to need help in his single living conditions.

“OK, yes, the place is a bit more on the fancy side, but not as bad as others. At least that gives me a chance to almost be a normal person.” Sighing, he looked through the pictures of the place. There was a lot he was going to need to learn. Book and knife skills are one thing. Regular living skills were another.

Being from a prominent family, it was hard to know what normal life was like. Everything was always taken care of for you, never having to do anything for yourself. Until one day, many, many moons ago, and much shorter in height, when he meandered into the kitchen before anyone was up, startling their head chef, who was concerned the young master needed something.

He did.

It was to learn.

He was always fascinated by food and the culinary arts, so he took it upon himself to learn, even if in secret. The chef was more than happy to teach the inquisitive young man about his craft. Everything he had learned over 45 years in the kitchen was going to be passed on. Seeing the passion in the young master's eyes was so prideful for him. Those skills he was taught helped him through school and to be where he is now. That head chef was as proud as a parent.

Yes, some may be called in to do menial tasks for him, but almost every day, he would be doing everything on his own. Making his own food, cleaning, driving; he wanted to do it all, even going to a grocery store to shop.

He was more than excited to finally live his life how he wanted.

“I was wondering if you could put a call into the head of my security team? I wish to have a meeting with him.” Gathering up the documents, everything was filed in a folder, all except for the blueprints of the house.

Castorice pulled out her tablet and sent the message as requested.

It just so happened the head of the tech office was in the building, so the reply was quick.

“He can be here in 5 minutes. If you have the time?”

Mydei was surprised that the message came back that quickly. “Yes, please, if he is available.”

Within the said five minutes, there came a knock at his door. Mydei stood to accept his company. “Door’s open.”

A young man, around Mydei's age, poked his head in the door. “You called for me, Mr. Deimos?”

“Yes, please, Mr. Khaslana. Please come in.”

The head of his security team, Phainon Khaslana, was a tech wizard from the Telesaltes Technology Company (TTC). He made sure all of the restaurants had round-the-clock security. Because the price of some ingredients was very high, it could be the cause of theft. The computer system that was used by all restaurants was kept under regular maintenance and security. All staff and customers needed their orders and information secured.

Phainon was the man who headed the whole team of six. He had a bright and bubbly personality, always keeping the mood up, even when some felt down. Amongst most of his kitchen staff and office, Phainon stood out the most. He was the only man Mydei had ever known with hair that could rival the first snowfall and eyes brighter than any gemstone on the market.

“Please have a seat.” Picking up the bottle he was drinking, he motioned it towards the security head. “Can I offer you a drink?”

Smiling, Phainon couldn't resist, “Who am I to turn down such a good offer? Anything that you've ever offered me was amazing. What were you able to get a hold of this time?”

Grabbing a glass from the cabinet behind him, Mydei poured the juice, “Imported pomegranate juice from my homeland. My parents had recently come back and brought me a few bottles. How it is cultivated and made is quite different from other places.”

Handing him the glass, Phainon treated it like a fine wine. Seeing how it swirled in the glass, the smell, and even the texture on his lips, everything was different and amazing about it. It was thicker, but richer. You could taste something different in the mix.

“If I may ask, what makes this so different in taste?”

“It's how it's made. The grove where they are has trees with and without fruit. The two are combined to make a different flavor. You get a minor hint of cranberry or grape, depending on your taste buds or just the flower.” He takes another drink of it. Mydei never savors it like wine; he grew up on it, so he consumed it just like water.

“Incredible. Thank you for sharing this with me. So, I did get a message from Miss Castorice stating, "You wanted to see me?” He was hoping the meeting wasn't a bad thing. Sometimes you can never tell.

“Yes. Since you and your team do such an impeccable job at security for both our real and internet world…”

Phainon could feel his cheeks getting a little red. “Now, sir, please. We don't need that kind of adoration. We are just doing our jobs.” He wasn't used to getting this kind of praise, certainly not from the head of everything.

“No, I insist. Since I have had your team in charge of things, I have not had a problem.“ Sitting down, he pulled out the blueprints to the house. “I was wondering if I could give YOU a special task?”

Phainon pointed to himself, confused.

Mydei smiled at the gesture. It almost looked like a confused puppy.

Gawd, that smile is gorgeous. He is an utterly attractive man. The hair, glasses, suit, and physique. Shit, it's all perfect. I could get lost in all of him.~ Phainon was lost in thought.

“Yes, you.” Sliding the documents towards him, “Just 15 minutes ago, I finished all the documents securing a purchase of a new home.”

Phainon’s face lit up with excitement. “That's wonderful news. I'm so glad to hear that, but how am I involved with this?”

“I would like you personally to set up and manage security at the place.” Phainon almost choked on his drink.

He felt like a bomb had just exploded in his mind. The man he's lusted after for years is asking HIM. Not his team. HIM to manage it. His insides almost didn't know what to do.

“If I can be so bold, sir? Not to question your judgment, but why just me?” Shit.. is he offering for me to watch him? Like I don't get to see him enough as is, but to be the sole person.. fuck-he can feel his excitement growing- … I need to calm down, I don't need to be showing anything bad in his office.

“You, I feel, are the most skilled on your team. The constant schooling you put yourself through to keep up with the changes in technology is impressive. Most don't go as far as you.” Phainon wasn't sure he could handle all this praise from someone who looked like a stunning sunset.

“And I would rather leave it to just one person. It is the whole reason why I bought the place where I did. Privacy. I don't need everyone knowing where I live.”

“It is understandable, it would give you peace of mind then.” Not me, fuck. Dream come true. Then again, it's the only chance I'll get. Rumor has it that he isn't interested in either sex. So I probably don't have a chance, but to get to stare at him more often, even if through video. I'll fucking take it.

“If you are not busy, I would like you to accompany me to the house to see where security could be set up. That copy of the blueprint is yours if you'd like to take notes on it.” Reaching behind him, he grabbed his jacket. A simple black one with a small gold lion pin, matching the rest of his attire. Black pants and a turtleneck finished off the look.

“Actually, no, I am not busy. It would be an honor to be the first guest in your new home. Let me run back to the office to get my tablet, and I'll meet you at the front doors?” Phainon was having the hardest time holding in his elation. This is the first time in the 7 years they have known each other that they would get to be alone. No one around but them. No security. He was the security.

“I will see you there, thank you so much again.” Watching the snow-haired man leave, he was more than excited to get this set up and finally get to live something relatively normal.

After the man had left the office, Mydei packed his things up for the day. Making sure everything had its place. Locked up if need be. He had already had a few amenities taken to the house when they had agreed to buy the place. There was already word given from the head of the realtor company that he could move some stuff in before signing. He had clout because of his family name.

Now that it was his, he wanted to be there. All plans were for him to spend the weekend there, officially moving in. It was Friday night, and work didn't come around again till Wednesday morning. An extra two days were taken to move stuff in.

Grabbing his bag and keys, he headed out to his secretary's desk. “I'm off, Miss Castorice. I am taking Mr. Khaslana to the house to plan out security for it. If you don't have anything pressing to do, please take the rest of the afternoon off.”

Her smile was always sweet and warm. “Thank you so much, sir. There are a few more reports I need to handle since you won't be back till the middle of next week. I want to get them settled before then, and after I will happily take your offer. I hope you two get everything squared away with it.“

“Again, your hard work is always appreciated.  I will see you next week,” he started towards the elevator.

“You too, Mr. Deimos.”

On the other side of the office…

Phainon was in a tizzy. Trying to get his stuff together and not be excited to spend alone time with the hottest single man in the city was getting to him.

“I can do this. I CAN be professional……shit, I don't know. Fuck. Why do I have to want something I can't touch?” Finishing up his bag, he goes to leave. The future prospects looked promising to say the least.

When he got down to the front, there was no fancy car. No driver.

Then a sleek black car pulled up to him. When it stopped, he noticed a maroon iridescence shining in the sunlight. The car was simply beautiful. Stunning. Then there was the diver.

Mydei got out of the driver's seat to greet him.

Phainon was dumbfounded. He didn't know that the heir to the Kremons dynasty could drive, and he didn't think that he'd be allowed to. All expectations were now being thrown out the window.

Phainon also didn't know which was more ravishing: the car or the driver. Noticing his hair was now pulled back in a messy bun, the driver won that battle. He was trying so hard not to drool. Dressed down or up, his man was getting to him.

“Wow, this is yours?” He tried to cover up his staring.

“Yes, it is. I got this a while ago. I just never get a chance to drive it much because you know….being CEO and family. I did tell them that once I got my own place, I was driving more often, without a chauffeur. Only when I'm working would I possibly allow it.” Leaning back on it, the weight that he's been feeling for a long time is slowly starting to melt away.

“Can I touch it?” I mean fuck, I'd like to touch you right now. You look too hot against that. Ohh, what I could do on and in that car. Shhhiiit, I know what I'm thinking about tonight.

Mydei moved out of the way so Phainon could inspect it. The shape was beautiful. Pristine condition. “What kind of color is this? It isn’t a solid black.”

“No, it's a special chromium color. Custom-made. It is black for the most part, but then it shines shades of red to dark red in the light. Besides the specks of gold that are in the paint.”

Moving in just the right angle to catch the sun, he was able to see all the shades of the car.

“The reds are so beautiful, they match your hair.”

Inside, Mydei's system stopped, like a rock was thrown into the gears running a perfectly working clock. He's gotten compliments all his life, been praised for everything. This one tiny sentence broke his brain. He couldn't find the reason why.

Clearing his throat, “Thank you. Are you ready to go then?”

Running pale fingers gently over the shape of the hood, seeing from his peripheral vision, amber eyes were watching his ministrations. Caressing the curves of the vehicle. Phainon stood up. “Yes, sir, I am.” He was definitely enjoying himself.

Opening the door, he got into the passenger seat. The insides shared some of the vibrant red that was shimmering in the paint. The seat was comfortable; his butt was cushioned so well. He could take a nap here. Very spacious with tons of leg room. It was new enough to have a computer system in the dashboard.

Mydei gets in beside him, turning the key.

“You know, sir…”

“Mydei,” He interrupted.

“Huh?? You're letting me call you by your shortened name. No one gets to do that.” Phainon was stunned that he was being given such a privilege.

“Well, for one, I'm not at work. So it's fine. And two, I would like to, or well I don't know if you'd allow me…….to consider you a friend?? We have known each other for ages. 8 years soon?” Phainon could feel the nervousness in his words. With his position, Mydei never really got close to anyone. Always making sure to keep the most professional attitude towards everyone. Everyone was on an equal level in his eyes. From just a simple dishwasher to members of the board and all in between. Everyone meant something to this place.

“I would be more than honored to be considered your friend ... Mydei.” Phainon savored the name coming off his lips. He was just permitted to do something so grandiose and secret. Like finding a treasure no one knew about.

The ride was quiet up to the house. Phainon kept his bag on his lap for many good reasons. Looking out the window, he pushed his lips together. He knew the reason. The major one was his excitement. His dick and heart. This whole day had been beyond his wildest fantasy, and those have happened a lot over the years. Probably more frequent going forward. The second was to try and keep his mind off being in a car with another person.

Phainon had been Mydei's admirer for years. Never getting any further than that. Always more than an arm's reach away was the beautiful Adonis statue behind a gated fence. No one was allowed entry.

Now?

Now things have changed. That distance feels much closer now. He wasn't sure how to handle it all.

In all his distraction, the car had stopped, and he was very much unaware.

Mydei grabbed his shoulder and shook him a little.

“Huh?? Sorry, I was lost deep in thought. Just enjoying the view.” It's mostly you, though. Gawd, if you only knew how bad I want you. I HAVE to be a good boy. I can't screw this up.

“Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to disturb your thoughts. We are sorta here. I did send you the print also to your phone so you can handle the technical aspect of it.” Mydei got out of the car, walking around to the gate.

“I could just sit here and watch that beautiful ass walk all day. Dammit, behave. He makes it so difficult, though.” Grabbing his tablet, he made his way over to his employer.

“I do want to have some type of security at the gate. Not sure. What would you suggest? There is a fence around the grounds. It was put in with nature in mind, I'm told.”

Pulling up the plans, Phainon could see all the details for the property. Doing a rough few sketches on it. A camera with a double security keypad and a matching ‘key’ for the car. Perimeter sensors, with new features to detect animals from people.

“Easy enough. What do you think?” Handing the sketches to him.

Mydei looked it all over, not noticing Phainon was taking in the whole experience. The sun was just at the right height to illuminate all of Adonis’ features. He wanted to burn it into his memory. The way the sunset hair lay on the back of his neck. Muscles moved under the shirt as he cycled through things on the tablet. The sun makes everything on his face bewitching.

Phainon did know, though, that this outing had thoroughly ruined him. Seeing another side of Mydei was just heaven.

The tech wizard was content where he was at. Knowing that his position had moved up in Mydei's circle, now being called a friend. Maybe he could spend more time with the untouchable man.

“Looks good. Let's head to the house.”

Getting back in, they made it the rest of the way. Once parked by the front door, Phainon took note of visible and blind spots.

Not paying my attention while drawing, the door opened for him, and his bag was taken. When he finally looked up, he was so smitten and confused at the same time.

“You were so busy writing, I figured I'd help out by getting the door and your bag.”

“Sorry, I just get lost in my work sometimes.” Putting the pen back in its slot, he left the car. Once the door was shut, he took in the place. It was modern but had some old-world charm to it. A combination of future and Greek architecture. Very different. Seemed to fit the owner well.

“Once we get the tour and details set, can I make you something for all your troubles?” Putting the key in, he left Phainon standing by the car, dumbfounded again.

Hurrying up to meet him in the foyer, “Wait, wait, wait!?!? Thee CEO of Evernight restaurants and heir to the Kremnos dynasty…wants to cook… for me!?!?”

Mydeu looked at him with a straight face, internally laughing at his minor hysterical moment. “Yes, I do. Why is that so hard to grasp? I've asked you to do a pretty large task and have you leave the office to do it. It's one of my ways of showing thanks.” Besides covering the equipment and installation costs.

“I mean it isn’t every day that THEE Deimos cooks for just ONE person, so I will humbly and graciously accept it.” Bowing to him like a prince.

“Come now, it isn't that special. I cook at the restaurants fairly often.”

“I know that. We get a lot more foot traffic when people know you're there on those nights. But thank you truly, it means so much.” Phainon is internally screaming right now. If he is sleeping, he doesn't want to wake up. This is all so perfect.

Setting the bags down at the entrance, they make their way through the rest of the house. Surveillance and locks for the garage. The pool area had a high enough wall, but cameras were there just in case, on the outside. A few other places he wanted security, and they were duly noted.

Walking down the hall, Phainon stopped, staring at the tablet. They were standing by the master bedroom. Mydei had halted a few feet in front of him.

“This should be the master suite. Would you mind if I looked around? Just to double-check the area.”

“No, please, you're the security expert. When you are finished, I'll meet you in the kitchen. I'll go get dinner started.” Phainon acted like he was working, in all actuality, watching the sexiest man in his world walk away.

It was starting to become one of his favorite things. Getting to do this more than once a day was the best dessert ever.

Ohhhh, he’s gonna be the death of me. What I wouldn't give…..

Shaking his head and biting his lip, he entered a most special of spaces. The master bedroom was large. The bed was across from the door, against the wall. Balcony door to the left of the bed. Same length window matching on the right. A smaller fireplace than the living room adorned the wall opposite the bathroom. Not much was in the room right now, besides a bed and a nightstand.

Wandering around the room, he took in all the nooks and crannies. Taking note in his head.

The far end of the left side was the bathroom. It housed a marble shower with a seat. Impressive overhead shower head. A large step led into an equally big jacuzzi/ tub combination.

His mind was wandering, looking at everything. There were a few extra cameras he wanted to install that only he had access to. Others may occasionally guard the house. But the lead, he had other plans.

Smells from the kitchen drifted down the hall. Phainon was almost drooling, taking them all in. I guess I'm done gawking now. Notes are taken. But dammit, that cooking is making me more hungry, so I guess it's time to eat.

The kitchen was alive with flavor when he walked in, taking a seat at the kitchen island. With the flat top grill on the island, he got to watch a master at work. The meat and vegetables were handled with utmost care. Dancing in between utensils and sauces. He'd never seen something so amazing. Yes, some steak houses put on a show, but that's it. A SHOW. This was a show like no other. Magic, it felt like. Everything has such meticulous timing that it almost seemed like a dream.

The best part was the cook. Sleeves rolled up, hair in a tighter bun, no glasses, and complete concentration.

He wonders to himself, what would he have to do to get this more often? But maybe that is a thought for another time. Now it's time to enjoy the best meal he has ever had in his life.

They always say, A way to a man's heart is through his stomach.

Phainon wanted to return his heart on a gold platter.

The next morning, Phainon was too eager to get up. So much of the day was ahead of him.

Sneaking a few pictures of the prince yesterday was just what he needed when arriving home.  They were taken for all reasons, but the one last night: self-pleasure.

Before, he'd have to use pictures and clips saved from news articles. But now, these ones were candid. Showing Mydei in a different light than most see him. Yes, he was still regal and stunningly handsome, but these were him being most normal. A side no one gets to see.

But now he is.

And he knew the dirty truth. It was only going to get better for him. Was it illegal? Yes. But there was part of him he didn't let anyone see. There were things that gave him pleasure that most would think are wrong.

Now that there was a clear opportunity, he wasn't going to leave it. He was taking it full force.

Finishing trying to make himself presentable, he hurried down to the tech store for the order. After they were done eating last night, Phainon sent it in. Because of knowing the owner for so long and a repeat customer, it was available first thing after opening.

Installing a home security system was going to be a breeze. Much simpler than running a restaurant. A two story house, with specific rooms, would take no time at all to complete.

The drive back to the house felt the same as yesterday,  just without a handsome man driving him there. Well, except for himself. Phainon knew the looks he carried.  Many of both sexes have tried asking him out, but have been politely declined. Even if it wasn't going to happen, one man had a hold of his soul, and he was happy to leave the reins where they were. Even if they were never taken up, he didn't care.

Parking beside the black chromium car in the early morning light was just as beautiful as yesterday. The colors danced before him. That car was a piece of art, but oh, how he wanted to do things with it.

Gawd, what I wouldn't give to lay you over that hood, under me. The beautiful sunset hair was sprayed about. Holding onto my arms, begging for more. It's definitely going to need to be washed after we are done with it.

At least he knew the prince was still home. Phainon, bag in hand, made his way to the door.

Knock

….

…..

……

……

Is he still in bed?? Phainon was really confused.

Knock

…..

……

…….

Still, no sounds were heard. Going against his better judgment, he grabbed the handle and twisted. He was able to turn it the whole way and open the door.

Part of Phainon's heart sank. Did something happen to him after they parted?? Someone came in and murdered the heir?! So many things were running through his mind.

“Shit, would you look at the time? It's twelve-thirty… I need to get lunch.” Phainon was so lost in thought when he worked, time was put to the wind. Everything in the house was set up. There was a gentle breeze going through the trees as he made his way down to the entrance. It was calming his turbulent mind. This was going to be a little more involved installation. The stone had to be drilled into.

Just as he was about to put the drill to stone, his pocket vibrated. Setting the drill down, removing his gloves, he fished the phone from his pocket.

It was Mydei. A text from him.

▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎

My Prince:

Hi. I just wanted to check to see how things were going. You're probably too busy for a call right now. Nothing important…

▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎

“Phainon?”

“Ohh, good, I caught you, and never am I ever too busy for you.” I'd like to get busy WITH you, but that's a dream. I get to at least talk and be around you more. That's more than I ever could have asked.

“Thank you, I appreciate that.” A huge sigh came from the other end. “I have been packing since I got here. Haven't taken a break or eaten since this morning with you.”

“Ohhh, come now. You're telling me at that big mansion, NO ONE bugged you to eat. You're their prince after all. If I were even a sliver of a good cook like you, I WOULD have made you food.”

A small cough could be heard on the other end. Did I embarrass him?? Was he blushing??

“Actually, no, to answer your question. Most have just left me to my work. Once I'm deep within something, I don't stop until it's completed." Mydei offered up honestly.

Fuck, you can't say that to me. That just brings up fantasies of hours of sex with you. Never stopping till we are both wrung dry. Why is it so easy for him to get me excited?? Ohhh yeah.. Because I am easy for him.

“Well, at least you are taking a break. I'm glad you called. It's kinda lonely up here without you to talk to.” Phainon sounded forlorn on the other end.

“I…thank you. It's kinda nice to be wanted for more than my money or family status. I do want to apologize again for this morning. I wasn't sure what came over me.”

I just want you for you. I would love to have the whole person now. Before, it was just your looks; now, seeing the Heir stripped away, it is a beautiful and lonely man who just needs to be loved. I wish it could be me.

“It's perfectly ok. You probably needed it. You even made it clear that you never felt like you could be a normal person. If you can be that with me and have no worries, then I can be here as much as you need me. Everyone needs someone close. I just don't want to push you to do anything you're not comfortable with.”

“Phainon, I really wish I had known you a long time ago. You are someone I wish I had in my life. You're not part of this circus. Someone normal that just treats me as myself, not the heir to….this..” Mydei waved his hands at the room before him, even though the man on the other end couldn’t see it.

“Well, I will gladly take their prince, make him my prince, and go outside and color. Or go jumping into a lake at midnight. Taking walks through the woods. Go to a fair……” His heart hurt a little saying that place, but he would tough it out for the man so desperately in need of a friend, “…. and ride all the rides till they kick us out. Anything you want that isn't what they want, I will do with you.” Phainon’s inner voice was adding more inappropriate things. He had to bite his tongue not to say any of them.

“Would you?? Would you really do that?? For me?” Mydei was dumbfounded and touched all at the same time.  Someone is treating him like  a normal person. Not some idol that couldn't be touched.

“Yes, I would be more than honored to. Hell, if it weren't weird and not such a total mess, I'd play in the mud with you. I didn't have anyone growing up either. So, to get to do the things that we would have done growing up, I'd drop everything to give you that world. “

“You know, I'll hold you to that. If you don't mind me changing the subject, how is the project coming along?" A rustling of books could be heard on the other end. He was still packing.

“Uhmm, good actually.  Everything is installed in the house. I was just getting ready to put in the gate camera when you called. I just have to physically install this, and the hardest part is over. I just have to network everything together, making sure it's all running properly.’

“Well, that will take a few more hours, correct?” The sound of packing tape can be heard closing a box.

“Yeah, probably.  Why do you ask?” Phainon was excited and curious as to what he wanted.

“Would you be willing to go out to eat with me when I return? After packing all day, I don't feel like standing to cook.”

Phainon's mind just broke. He did forget how to breathe. He was being asked out on a date. Maybe to Mydei it was just a meal, but to him, it was a

date. He can't take how much this man is winning.  Just asking things of him like it's nothing, but it hits his heart in every way it can.

“Welllllll, that all depends. Where are we going? I'm not exactly dressed to go out to eat. Plus, I'm about to drill into your driveway wall and get dusty as hell. I was only planning on installing everything, giving you the stuff for the security system, and then going home. “

“Ohh, I see, it's ok then. Maybe some other time…” Sadness can be heard in his tone. He wanted to spend the time together.

“Buttttttttt my dear prince, I said before I would drop anything for you. So how about this? I'll finish the physical part of this, run home and change…”

“You could just maybe…” The prince got suddenly became quiet.

“Maybe??” A white eyebrow raised at the interjection. There was something more.

“Grab some things and spend the night? The guys are dropping the truck off at the house. Since I did so much today, I probably won't be unpacking anything more. The living room furniture was already there before we arrived yesterday afternoon. I had already bought it. I just had it delivered before I signed the paperwork. I need to go buy other stuff, or I'd offer a guest room.”

“Mydei….are you asking me for a sleepover?”

A warm laugh is heard on the other side. Something Phainon would never get tired of hearing. “I guess I am. It's kinda funny. It will be my first one at almost 30.”

“Really? Huh, I guess that makes two of us. So I'll let you go, finish this, run home to get everything, and come back.” Fuckkkkk I don't know if I can take this. I get to have a date and a sleepover. I AM getting a little hard thinking about it. Thank God no one is around.

“You can use my bathrooms if you wish; it doesn't matter which one. Just so you don't feel like ‘work’ when we go out. Please take care. Be careful going to and fro.” Mydei was smiling from ear to ear, and he wasn't sure why. He was feeling things he had never felt. Is this what friendship was like? Being around people you liked gave those sorts of feelings. It was much more different than his family or servants.

“You as well. I'll see you when you get here.”

The call ended. He was more elated than he’s ever been. So many feelings at this moment, he knew he had to be on his best behavior tonight. The prince needed cheering up, and that was what he was there for.

To be a friend.

Chapter Summary

Wednesday had rolled around for the Tech Wizard and there was an install that needed to happen with a live technician. Phainon thought he was alone.. he wasn't. Miss Castorice stopped by to make sure he was ok and drop off a message from the boss.

Phainon just can't escape him.

Maybe stopping for a take out on the way home wont be such a bad thing, will it? It may be when the manager on duty tells your boss about it.

Chapter Notes

Soft beta read.

Authors note: to clear up some confusion about Phainon using sex toys. For the story, he has been lonely for almost 30 years, thinking no one would want him. He had watched a bunch of adult things to find what he liked. And has also used a bucnh of sex toys to find what he liked as well. A top using a plug isn't only for a top to do. It is the same as sexuality.. it isnt cut and dry one can't do this and others can. A friend of mine said he read a story where the top had one in when they were doing the bottom.

So, when writing it I did not see it as an issue. Anyone can like toys. But trust me. This is top phainon/bottom mydei. The tags have been fixed, i hope that clears things up. Sorry about the confusion. I do know tags are important. So sorry again if it was not a clear thing.

The week had been relatively quiet in the office. Pahinon went back to work on Monday as usual. The week was flying by in a blink. Somehow, it was

Wednesday already.

Greeting Miss Castorice on the way in every day. Stopping at the lounge, he grabbed a black coffee before heading down the hall to the space that was given to the TTC for their work.

It was a small office space. There were six closed-off cubicles. Making sure everyone had a quiet space to do their work in. Only when any of those six doors were closed did you know the tech masters were hard at work. At the back of the space was his office. Pretty big size for all they do for security. Six large flat-screen TVs covered the one wall. One each for the respective restaurant and the last one for the office here. A locked-up secondary room for the servers was also housed in the room.

Phainon's desk had two monitors as well. Multitasking was a must for him. Always being able to keep an eye on what was important and getting security reports filed. Being one of the top managers for the company, he had to make sure everything was going as smoothly as possible. He wouldn't be in the position he was without meticulous work habits. Everything had to be done a certain way to ensure the security was at its peak.

It was 5:30 in the afternoon. The sun was hanging lower in the sky. The rest of the office had bid him farewell for the evening, a half hour to forty-five minutes ago. Phainon was still occupied in his office. The door wasn't shut; it was just cracked a little.

He was about ready to pull up the app for the prince when a soft knock came at his door. Phainon tried to play it cool, but wasn't expecting anyone in the office at this time. He's glad no one saw him jump a bit at his desk.

Who could it be? Hopefully, this doesn't take long. I have a prince to go look after.

“Come in?” He still couldn't fathom who could be here at this hour.

Beautiful lavender hair peeked its way into the door, and the lady holding that set of locks was just as lovely. “Excuse me, Mr. Khaslana. I didn't

realize you were trying to burn the candle at both ends today.” A slight giggle followed her sentence.

He stood up to greet her. “Ohhh, Miss Castorice? What do I owe the pleasure? I don't normally see you on this end of the building. Is something wrong?”

Walking in, she was surrounded by all sorts of technology, with no idea how any of it worked. She didn't come in very far. “Well, not per se. I was more concerned about you. The rest of your colleagues had already left, but I hadn't seen you depart the office yet. I just wanted to make sure everything was ok.”

Phainon took notice of her purse hanging off her shoulder. A bag was tucked under her arm. A tiny, purple dragon keychain was dangling from it. It was so her.

Phainon ran his hand through the snow white locks, laughing at the realization of his situation. “Ohhhh!! I'm so sorry to have worried you. I forgot to tell you on the way in this morning that I'd be staying late. There is a new security patch for the system that needs to be installed, but it has to be done here. Plus, there are other steps involved; it requires a live technician. I have nothing going on, so I told everyone I'd get it. It was no big deal. Plus, some had plans, and it worked out.”

Which was true. He wasn't lying to her. Many of them had families or friends waiting for clock-out time. Phainon, on the other hand, had his whole life free. There were no obligations on his table. It was all his choice, though. After his parents passed of old age a few years ago, he found no reason to go out anywhere anymore.

Over the years, he's gotten used to the loneliness. It saved anyone from being hurt by him. Even when the office would go out for drinking or to celebrate, he politely declined. People being happy with him involved was too much for his heart to take. Even after being adopted, he rarely went anywhere with his parents. Something deep inside was afraid of being in a vehicle with people he cared about.

They were used to it and never forced anything on him. He was content being at home. Playing in the wheat field behind the house with his dog. It was safe. It was all he needed.

He still wasn't sure why he agreed to ride in the car with Mydei. Twice no less.

Mydeimos had power over him, and his heart he didn't understand. The prince wasn't coming to slay the dragon that was hidden in the dark cave. Almost like he wanted to join it. Everyone knows that isn't how the story goes.

I can't let him get attached to me. I'm no good for his life. I'll ruin it… He's too perfect for that.

Castorice was watching his face intently. She was very good at reading people. Always has been. Something in his mannerisms was just off. Not alarmingly, just enough for her to notice. From her conversation with the boss over the weekend, she was watching him more closely. Something about him was different than most.

“Well, I don't want to keep you from it. I just wanted to check and make sure you were ok.”

“Yes, yes, I am fine. Thank you for your concern. I won't be very long. The maintenance had already started before you came in.” He was hoping she wasn't going to drill him for any other answers.

“Good to hear, I'll see you in the morning then?” She was just about out the door and stopped. “Ohh, and Mr. Kremnos sends his regards as well. He hasn't talked to you in a while and was hoping you were well. He was also very pleased with Saturday. I was just told to pass along the word. Have a good evening, sir.” With no more said, the door was closed, and she was gone. He was left alone with his thoughts - that was a very dangerous thing.

The app was loaded on the computer sitting in front of him.

It's sweet she cares, but why?? I've stayed late a million times before, but not till now does she check on me? And she talked to Mydei……ABOUT ME?....Shit dude ... .wait wait… hold the phone,yo. She said ‘Saturday’, not the installation…. The day??? Had fun?? That can't be right. I made him upset twice for sure.

The screen came alive, showing the feed of the house. The big truck from the mansion was parked with its back door to the house. A long ramp extends from it for easier access.

I wonder how far he's gotten. I've been trying not to look as much since I came home. This is just security after all. I don't need to get any more attached than I am.

Flipping through the screens, the house looks fuller now. The living room was so much more alive. With lots of furniture added, it was becoming lived in. A big white rug in front of the fireplace caught his eye. Waaayyy in the back of his imagination, thoughts were brewing. They were just going to have to stay there. He had more of the house to explore.

The kitchen was almost like he pulled it out of one of the restaurants. The equipment wasn't as industrial, but still huge for a normal kitchen. Even other fancy homes didn't have machines like this. Unless they were ridiculously wealthy. When he said he wanted it restaurant grade, he wasn't kidding. Like…there is a lot, but not. It just looks like….I don't know...homey and work. It's odd. Feels like him, though.

Phainon zoomed in the camera on the one counter. Fresh pastries adorned it. The quality of the camera was good enough to even catch the wisps of hot air leaving the flaky crust. From the looks of them, he gathered, they were just removed from the oven.

Switching over to the garage, the beautiful black iridescent car was parked in there. Something off in the corner caught his eye.

A bike!?!??! What nooo?!?! Are you kidding me.??? He knows how to ride…. Ohhh damn..I bet he does like something fast between his legs. Noooo, noooo, nooo don't start. You're still at work.

“I wonder if I'll ever get to see him ride it. No way in hell am I getting on that. That's worse than a car.” He did notice that there was a lot more in there than expected. Especially noting the gardening equipment in the back. Every image coming across his screen was always a surprise.

“Where is HE, though?” Just as the words left his mouth, a red dot appeared on the notifications. It was there, alerting him to a body presence. Clicking over to it, there he was. Hair pulled back in a tight bun. The same body defining jeans from the other night and a very form fitting tank top. Phainon knew he was drooling.

Mydei was the object of his obsession. Seeing him in anything other than a business suit was always a pleasant surprise. This particular outfit had to be one of his favorites. Making the untouchable heir look like a normal man.

Yeaaaa, well, normal enough. Most aren't as cut as he is. I still swear that the whole body was chiseled out of marble.

Phainon kept the feed on him, watching his every movement. He still couldn't ascertain what was in the 3 very odd shaped boxes that were being taken upstairs. The camera app switched to the special ones in the bedroom. Maybe he could get a better grasp of things following the prince.

All 3 boxes were laid out on the bed. He actually hadn't seen the bedroom since Saturday night. So anything in it now was all new to him. There was a rectangular, almost 3-meter-long box. A large square box. The final box on the bed was rather small. It didn't look like it fit with the other 2.

The middle box was open first. Phainon almost couldn't believe his eyes. He had to be dreaming. A large bronze shield was removed from the box. It had an ornate design. Still being visible, even with how old it looked. It had a circle going around the diameter. With large petal-looking strokes spaced apart. Circles adorned the spaces in between. And along the rim was a beautiful filigree design.

“Holy shit, that's gorgeous. Even for being old, it's almost in immaculate shape.” The shield was taken from the box and placed onto brackets on the

wall behind his bed. There was a little alcove made specifically for these items.

The top box was then opened. Hand-made red silk, adorned with golden flames, covered the item. Once moved, Phainon was even more shocked. It was a long red spear. An intricately made spike was at the end of it, flanked by 2 diamond-shaped cross guards. Adorning the larger end was a thick red metal tip. It was the reason why the width of the box had to be so large. To accommodate that amount of detail, it needed to be wide. The end looked like a twisted dragon's spine coming to a point. It too was placed in that alcove.

The red scarf, from the box, adorned the shelf below the ancient items. It looked like an exhibit from a museum. They were stunning to his eyes. He'd never seen something so magnificent before. Mydei was taking great care with these items; the years could be seen on the shield of any of the items.

The last box was the smallest. Pahinon couldn't imagine what kind of relic it housed. The same red silk lined the box. Even when moved aside, the camera couldn't see what was in it. Not until he reached in, pulling out a hefty item. It wasn't clear what was in his hands till it was put on a bust to the left of the bed. The bust had its own shelf in the wall. Mirroring what was under the weapons, silk was placed below it. Then a hefty gold necklace adorned it. The zoom couldn't get close enough to see all the details, but it could pick up the glitter of blue gems that were interspersed around it.

“Shit. That's all so amazing. I don't think I've ever seen antiques so old, but also in this good condition. I wonder if they are from within the family?”

Flipping back over to the maintenance, it was already over. He probably could have left fifteen minutes ago, but Phainon's gaze was elsewhere.

I still wish I could get over his charm. It's crazy. I'm not sure if I should distance myself from him or not. I don't want him to think I'm afraid of him. I’m….I’m just afraid of myself. So much in my life has gone wrong with people involved. But I couldn't bear to see him cry; it hurt so much.

Logging out of all the apps open, securing all files that were open, it was time to go home. Everything was put on its normal standby for the office. He and his team may sleep, but security is up 24/7. Once everything was back to the way it was, all items having a place, he shut off the lights-locking the door. His office also led to the server room; it always had to be secure.

Walking past all of the other cubicles, Phainon did a last check before leaving himself.

Maybe I'll swing by the restaurant and get something to take home. Maybe I can find something on the menu that would be like something he'd make. Desert as well. Good thing with being a top manager for the company, I can get in quickly for food. They know I always get take-out. Eating at Zeno's was the first time I've eaten in a place in god knows how long.

“OK, so let's see. It's Wednesday. I'm most of the way through the truck. I have very little left and it's only six o'clock. I think the next two days, at least, I can finish and be done, done. Shit though… I'm starving. Maybe I'll text Phainon and see if he wants to come up to eat.”

Putting the last of the books on the shelf, Mydei took a step back to see his final work. It looked like a miniature library. He was more than happy about it.

Grabbing a stool at the counter, he pulled out his phone.

Right as he was about to text, a notification popped up.

“Maybe this will help, though. Give him one less thing he has to worry about. I wonder if this will get him to text me. He's been awfully quiet. I do hope it wasn't me.”

Setting the phone down on the counter, he was searching his newly stocked refrigerator for something to eat. Chapter Summary

Mydei is now all done moving his stuff in. Now he can finally enjoy HIS home. A thought struck him. I have a restaurant grade kitchen, might as well use it. Much to Cass' suprise Monday morning comes equipped with a more cheerful boss and pastry presents.

But she wasn't the only one. He also had some for his IT manager. Being the head of the office, he had a skeleton key for all the doors. He really wishes that he could be here when Phainon gets in, just see the reaction, but taking off a week, meetings need taken care of.

Phainon is so going to have a hissy fit that someone was inside his office.

Chapter Notes

Soft beta read.

This is a sad emotional chapter.

The weekend went by in a flash. The large moving truck was returned to its business, and the prince finally had all his stuff moved in. He could finally call it his home.

Even living in a studio apartment till now, didn't feel as weird as having a whole house to yourself. The room and privacy is what he really was after. Maids and body guards always made sure he was OK or needed anything. Parents are making him go to ‘events’ to mingle with people. None of that he really wants or needs.

Like he had told Kyros, the kitchen was more important to him. A business still had to be run, and Mydei knew it. But everything was by his rule and how he wanted it done. And from the business reports that have been coming in for the past few years, things have been turning a major profit.

All five restaurants under his leadership were doing amazing business. Customers were more than ecstatic to go. Raving about everything under the sun. They loved the food and the service, but the only thing they didn't like was the wait times. They knew why, though. The food was worth it.

For that, Mydei could be content with being CEO instead of Chef de Cuisine. He would rather be in the kitchen basking in the chaos there, helping make things, and just being on ground level. Yes, he was the heir to a big family business, but none of that mattered. Like his mother always said, He followed his heart.

If you ask most, that is what draws people in. Leading by his heart and trying to be fair with everyone isn't something you find a lot these days. When things were tough and needed to be taken care of, no one wanted to be on the receiving end of his wrath. There wasn't any screaming, but the words hit you like a dagger through the heart.

~~~~~

A basket of pastries was placed on the desk.

“Uhmm..Hi, sir!” Castorice was shocked by the huge vessel sitting on her desk.”What is all of this?? It smells amazing.”

“I was busy with my new kitchen. Made a few things.”

“Sir, that is way more than a ‘few’ things. It's like you brought me the whole bakery, but I graciously accept them, though. Thank you so very much,” Castorice was beaming from ear to ear. She was so excited to receive such a gift.

“Question, My dear Castorice. Has Mr. Khaslana happened to come in yet?”

“No, actually, I don't believe he has yet. Is that a problem?”

A smile sneaks into the corner of his mouth. He turned to go down the hall to the IT branch of the office. “Absolutely not at all. I'll be back.”

Walking into the office, no one was in yet. Which was a total convenience for him. His steps stopped at the door situated at the end of the six mini offices. Mydei reached into his pocket, getting a stack of keys. Since he was head of the office, the ring housed the master keys to all the doors. He had them all in case of an emergency, like the power going out. Finding the right one, he put it in slowly, letting himself into the office. He had actually never been in Phainon's office before. Most meetings are held in his own. He couldn't believe the amount of technology in the room.

“Wow, there is so much here. It's crazy. Hopefully, he enjoys the present.” He places the basket on the desk, hand lingering on it for a time. Lost in thought. There was that mysterious force again calling him.

“I should get going, I have a lot of stuff to get to, I've been out for a week.” Locking the door behind him, Mydei walked through the halls of the office back to his own. Still drifting off in thought. What is it about one white haired man that has me so distracted? I don't get it.

Once back at the entrance, he passes the front desk. ”Ohh, Cass, I got the itinerary. I'll be out of the office in meetings for most of the day. So if anything happens to come through, can you handle it for me?”

“Yes, sir, I can. Don't forget to eat lunch, too.”

He is gone for the shortest amount of time. Enough to get his work laptop and documents for the meetings, he was ready to go. “I won't. I know you'll hound me later about what I ate.”

“Ohh, too. The house looks very nice from the pics you sent me. I'm so happy you have a place to call your own now. You do seem much happier than before you bought it.”

The smile came back to his face, adjusting the glasses that adorned it. “Thanks, I'll have to take you up sometime.” With a smile and nod, he boarded the elevator and left for the day.

As the clock switched over to eight-thirty, the IT department started filling in. Castorice greeted them all as they passed her desk. There was one person she was waiting for. Knowing what their boss was up to, the reaction was imminent. Just to what degree was to be seen.

~~~~~

The Monday morning trek into work was always terrible. Not so bad now after he's had a ‘personal’ workout and eye candy all week. The boss was fulfilling so many of his desires. Phainon couldn't ask for more.

The elevator clicked with a loud ding, signaling he was at the desired floor. The forecast was calling for rain today, making stepping out onto the office floor not so bright. Even being up as high as they were, the first thing in the morning is a lot for eyes that normally stare at computer screens all day.

“Morning, Miss Castorice. I hope your weekend went well.” Even though his body was ‘tired’ from all the work he put it through, Phainon was still able to keep a smile on his face.

“Good morning, Mr. Khaslana. Yes, it went well, thank you. I hope yours did as well.”

Just rounding her desk, he stopped to see her. “Yes, it did. Hey, question, is the boss in?”

Phainon wasn't sure why he was asking. He did A LOT of seeing the boss in the past week - With and without clothes. Even though there was a hiccup with going out and spending time together, the cameras were now his new favorite thing.

“Actually, no. Since he was out for a week, all of his meetings from last week got pushed to today. He is going to the meetings instead of them coming here. Mr. Kremnos felt bad about having to reschedule. Did you

need a meeting with him?” She knew something was up, but didn't press anything. Probably within the hour, she'd see him again over the basket.

“No, no.. I'm good. Just wondered. Well, I got a system to make sure things went well overnight. I'll see you later, Ma'am.” With his back to her, strolling down the hall, he waved.

Why did I want to know? It isn't like I NEED to see him. I need to stop wanting this. I know I agreed to be friends on my terms, but I don't need to push it. I can't have him finding out about my past or what I do now. I'd be ruined if he did.

Opening the door to their section of the office, he can hear the chatter of everyone going over their weekends. Walking past the rooms, greeting everyone with a smile, coffee in hand. No one made conversation with him first thing in the morning. Phainon just didn't like getting up, and Monday mornings were always the worst. They normally waited about 10-15 minutes before popping their head in to personally do a morning greeting.

Key pad numbers were pressed on the door, turning the handle. His hand went in first to pop the lights. Stepping inside his heart was in turmoil and panic. There was a basket on his desk. Someone had entered his office when he wasn't there. Cleaning always came before they left for the day. Scanning the area, his visual memory was running down how the office looked when he was last here on Friday night. It was really odd that nothing was touched.

What IS going on? I don't like this.

Slowly walking around the desk, the basket never left his sight. There was a red cover over top of the contents with a note placed above.

Once in front, the basket was inspected for any misgivings. Nothing seemed off. There was a card placed on top.

¤¤¤¤¤

Phainon

I hope you don't mind me dropping off a present for you. I feel like some unsaid things may have happened between us that have made things weird. I deeply apologize. I do hope you'll accept my apology. I wanted to give this to you the morning you fell ill. Please take care of yourself. I don't want to lose a dear friend.

Mydei

P.S. I do hope the gnocchi were good.

¤¤¤¤¤

“I can't believe him. He broke into my office just to give me presents. At least he admitted to buying me dinner, brat.” A warmth was felt within him. Phainon didn't know where it was coming from. It has been a long time since someone has put forth so much effort for him. The last people that did were his parents. They respected his boundaries but still tried to show their affection when possible.

Phainon knew they loved him.

They put forth so much love. He was adopted because his ‘mother’ couldn't convince, and both still wanted to be parents. Phainon would always be grateful for them. They were the only people in his life who made him feel loved, despite the demons he harbored against himself.

Now there was someone else who was trying.

That someone was his boss.

Heir to a huge family.

Who just wanted to be normal

And have friends.

Him.

Seeing his reflection in the blank monitor, there was a smile on his face. Small, but there. Something in how much Mydei cares and is trying, weaving its way into his heart. It was looking for a space in the darkness to call its own. As much as he wanted to fight it, that little portion just couldn't be patched back over. Phainon was allowing the prince in.

Sometimes he didn't understand himself at all.

Ohh fuck, stupid. You still didn't see your present. I mean...he was my present, but we don't need to talk about that. God, it was soooo good.

Lifting up the red cloth with the same ornate flame design on it as was with the antiques, he was greeted with a plethora of sweets and breads. Phainon knew that they were all hand made in that new kitchen of his. Already having Mydei's cooking, he knew they were going to be amazing.

He took out a small cupcake-looking pastry. The sides were folded in and covered with sugar, and a big dollop of cream cheese sat at the center. Like a Danish, but bite-sized. The bite he took was the perfect amount of sweet to contrast his bitter black coffee. First thing in the morning, it was the only drink that ever woke him up. He'd tried other things, but the first thing in the day to help was this. Once he was awake and fully ready to take on the world, there were other beverages that could be had.

Finishing off the mini Danish, he licked his fingers clean. The boss wanted to take care of him. It was so weird. They hardly interacted over the 8 years he’s been in this office. Searching his memory, he couldn't find any reason why Mydei would single him out to want to be friends with.

Unfortunately, I think I'm fucked in that department. I mean, I'm more of a top anyway… maybe. I mean, I've never had sex… and I don't feel toys count. I do want to see him under me, though…

His admission kinda shocked him. He’s used to just watching from the shadows, never wanting any more than. Something about the sunset was drawing him in. Almost had him wanting to wade out into the ocean and just drown in it.

“I need to go ask Castorice what she knows about this.”

She tried to hold in her smile; him coming back was a sign that what the boss did worked. She was way too good at feigning ignorance.

“Yes, Mr. Khaslana?? What can I do for you?” She smiled up at him, stopping mid-type.

“Just out of curiosity, when did Mr. Kremnos come in this morning? And did he have anything with him?”

Pulling up her log on the computer, it showed the clock-in times of everyone on the floor.

“Let's see. He was in around 7 am. There was a meeting he had to get to by 8:15 that was across town. The only thing with him was his phone. His briefcase and laptop were here. Why do you ask?” She had already hidden her basket before anyone else came into the building.

“Noo, noo. You're good. I was left some things by him. No biggie,” He was getting nervous, hoping that she couldn't tell. “I'll get back to my stuff, sorry to bother you, Ma'am.”

Castorice watched him walk away, rubbing the back of his neck. It was very red. She only felt a little bad for embarrassing him, but there was an energy she felt from him talking about Mydei. More than just co-workers or friends. She didn't want to push it, but was going to keep an eye on them both. A possible romance was brewing, and she was more than excited about it.

~~~~~~

“Yes, thank you. I can't wait to see how we can incorporate this product into our meals.”

After shaking hands with the clients, Mydei left the boardroom. He was partway down the hall when his phone vibrated. He stopped, leaning against

the wall to take a break. Even though he had been sitting for a while, walking and reading just wasn't what his eyes needed.

The icons at the top showed texts, and the notification bar just showed ‘Messages’ so it was more than just one. Touching the bar, it took him to the list. One was from Castorice at the very top.

¤¤¤¤

Cass:

Hi, sir! Hope your meetings are going well. Just FYI, I feigned ignorance when your Security head came to ask about the basket. It was cute that he was very embarrassed about getting a present. Plus, he looked kinda sad you weren't here to talk to when he first came in. Thought I'd let you know. Have a good rest of the day. :)

¤¤¤¤

Mydei just laughed at the message. He has always known she was up to no good. It's the quiet ones you have to watch out for. He appreciated her help, though. Maybe Mydei can finally get some kind of friendship from Phainon with her help. The security head was more locked up with his emotions than the servers that were being watched over.

“Maybe one day, I will truly have a friend that I can openly share stuff with. There is just something about him. I can't put my finger on it, but I know he's special. Which, speaking of special…”

Below her text was one from the man in question. Part of him was excited to be able to talk to him. Mydei hurried his walk back to the car. He wanted privacy to read these texts.

Once in the car, he just sat. Didn't turn the car on, either. Leaning back in the seat, deep thoughts were running through his mind.

Maybe…I don't know… maybe I'm developing feelings for him. I don't really know what love is like outside of family...but going out to eat and

spending time in the car together… and hell, I had a breakdown in front of him. I don't do that. But I did, and he hugged me. It… it felt nice. Warm. If I weren't such a mess talking about my childhood, I could have had one longer...

He leaned the seat back a bit more. Checking the time, it was 10 am. The next meeting wasn't for another forty-five minutes. Maybe he could take some time to talk through his feelings.

“ Is that what love is beyond friendship? That deep level of caring. Getting a warm feeling around them or talking about them?? I'm gonna hold off on asking Cass about it till I feel a bit more ok with it all.”

He was stalling too much in his head; there was still another text to see.

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

Phai:

I really don't know what to say.

Besides, I almost needed to get my heart checked.

How did you get into my office??

And then leave such a big present. : )

It all looks amazing.

I did have the one cupcake Danish thing.

It was really good.

I think I could eat like 10 of them.

But….

Thank you.

Mydei:

1: It's called a kouignette.

Yes, it's kinda like a Danish.

I happen to like cream cheese,

so I made some with it.

Also, I made a variant with pomegranate jam.

2: I'm glad you liked it

3: You forget I run the office.

I do have a master key, but don't worry.

I won’t abuse my power with it.

Phai:

Ohhh, uhmm hi.

I wasn't expecting you to respond.

Miss Castorice said you have meetings all day.

Mydei:

I do, but I'm in between ones right now.

I made time to talk.

Phai:

No no.. I don't want to interrupt.

Mydei:

I'd enjoy the distraction.

(Phainon felt a big thump in his chest. Swallowing hard, he wasn't sure if he was breathing. Did I take my meds? Something in the care that was given made his heart feel things he's never felt before. No one has ever given him these kinds of emotions. There were two sides to him. One was his happy side that everyone sees. Who was more than elated to receive gifts and be thought of. Then the other. The one Phainon feels is a monster and doesn't deserve anything. Least of all, the attention from his desire. He wishes so hard there was a middle ground between the two; trauma makes it all hard.)

Phai:

I don't know what to say.

Mydei:

I am sorry if I caused any issues.

I didn't think you'd let me give it to you in person.

I wanted to respect your boundaries,

but still wanted to leave you a gift for everything.

(Deimos…. Your smile was enough for me. You are too kind and caring. I truly believe I'm falling in love with you, and I can't. You make it so hard not to. Everything is so infectious, and fighting it is so hard. I want it...I do. I can accept some things...I'll try...Please, I don't want more. Phainon was having such an internal battle.)

Phai:

I…uhmm. Thank you.

Mydei:

It is totally up to you, and you can say no if you wish.

Would you be willing to come with me this weekend?

There is a place I'd love to show you.

Phai:

Let me think about it.

Plus, I don't know what's up for the weekend.

Mydei:

Fair enough. I have to get going.

He closed his phone, holding it tight in his hand. Mydei was hoping with all his being that the offer would be accepted. It was something good from his childhood that he wanted to share. He wanted this feeling again. Something about talking to this one person made his heart beat in a way that was new and exciting. Like the walk through the woods, straying from the path. Not being afraid of the unknown, but feeling like the destination would be worth it.

Only time would tell.

“I knew it… I guess it's a nice surprise, though. I don't get that often.”

Phainon sat back in the chair, just staring at the basket and what it meant. Mydei was putting forth so much effort into just him. It feels way different than his parents. They were there 24/7 with him growing up; they knew their son. But this is his boss, whom he only sees maybe once a week if need be. Sometimes not at all.

They figured it must be something important not to be staying after hours. Each of them looked at him strangely, noticing the basket he carried with the normal briefcase.

“Hey, Miss Castorice.”

She jumped a little in her seat. Busing working on her reports; his footsteps were never heard. “Ohhh, Mr. Khaslana?! Uhmm hi. Sorry, I was doing reports. What can I do for you?”

“I just wanted to let you know I'm heading out. There are some people I need to go see before heading home. Everyone knows I'm leaving. “

She was a little shocked by the statement. Phainon was never known to leave early. And go meet with PEOPLE. Most took him for a hermit. Her inner matchmaker was taking note to tell the boss. “Oh, sure thing. Please have a pleasant evening, and I'll see you in the morning.”

“Yes, Ma'am. You as well.”

Watching him get on the elevator and leave, she pulled out her phone sending a quick text to the boss letting him know what had just transpired.

“There is definitely something there between them. I just wonder what. I do know that they would be so cute together.” Humming happily to herself, she went back to her work after sending the text.

~~~~

Exiting the flower shop, two small bouquets were in hand. They had an important destination.

The drive over to the cemetery was a short one. Good business strategy on their part. People always wanted flowers and wreaths for their past loved ones. Why not be practically right across the street?

Pulling into the lot, luck was on his side. Totally empty. He could have had his meeting in peace.

Going down the lane, it was very serene. Everyone is taking their eternal nap. Mother Nature is a soft blanket for them. Most found the cemetery a place they didn't want to come often, but it didn't bother him any.

He did scold himself for not coming more often. It had been a few months.

Stopping beside a huge cherry tree, the pink springtime petals were all gone by now. Summer was starting soon, and most had gone through their cycle already. He would have loved to come when they were all in bloom.

There, just beside the tree, was a joint head stone.

Squatting down, he placed flowers down for them both. Small tears were welling up in his eyes. He hugged his knees.

“Hi, guys. Sorry, I haven't been around as of late. Work has been busy. My mind has been all over the place. I wish you were here to talk to. I could really use your support. More now than ever before.”

His heart was so emotional right now that he never noticed that a light rain was falling. It's like the worldly mother saw his pain and wanted to embrace him the best she knew how. He then couldn't tell his tears from the rain. It didn't matter. Getting soaked was fine by him.

“Someone is trying to be friends with me, and I don't know how to handle it. He's so uber nice. You both would have loved him, but you know me. I've always kept to myself. Afraid of the unknown. Keeping my distance kept me safe. I didn't get attached. I didn't have to lose anyone ever again. Now this….”

He sat on the ground, not caring if he got messy. Hugging himself was the only way he knew to maybe stop crying. Everything hurts.

“Mother, he's too nice. You would have loved him the most. He's such a wonderful person, and I have done some bad things he doesn't know about.

I want to keep our distance, but something keeps pushing us together. It's just all too much.”

Time was lost to him now.

He didn't know what time it was when he actually stopped crying. When he came to, after having a talk with them, his whole body was drenched. It had rained enough to soak through all his clothes.

The light shower continued to come down on him. Phainon wasn't sure if talking to the dead would help his situation, but it just felt good to get it all out in the open. His problem was still there and just something he'd have to work on.

Finally getting up, he ran his fingers along the stone. Saying a silent goodbye for now to them.

The melancholy white hair made its way back from whence he came. Reaching into the back seat, he got towels to cover his sitting area. He was a mess. In more than one sense of the word. A long, hot shower was what he needed once he'd returned home.

Maybe nap too, his heart was still broken and wet.

~~~~

Popping the umbrella open, Mydei made his way to the car. The last meeting he had was coincidentally by the graveyard. His eyes caught sight of something very familiar. A dark blue car that belonged to his security officer.

What is it doing here?

Opening his phone, another text from Cass gave him the answer he was looking for. Following the path with his eyes, he found a lone body, drenched, standing beside a headstone.

Mydei felt his heart breaking watching what was before him.

He knew then it was his parents.

Getting into the car, he headed over to the flower shop. Purchasing two flowers that had a soft red gradient. Dusted with blue glitter on the ends. Made them look wet.

Not wanting to get in the way, Mydei waited till the blue car was gone to go over. He followed the path Phainon walked down, stopping at the tree. The headstone read ‘Khaslana’.

Placing the two flowers with the ones already there, he thanked them for having such a wonderful son. Mydei felt he was lucky to have met him and hoped that they could provide him with the help he was looking for.

“Please look after him. Phainon is an amazing person. I would like to try and make him happy. He deserves it.”

Bowing at the two of them, he walks back to the car. It was quiet in his head. It is as if the spirits of the cemetery were walking him to the gates. A silent ‘thank you’ left his lips as he got into the car.

After a quick trip to the office, it would be time to go home. It's been a long day physically and emotionally. He just wanted a long soak in the tub to unwind.

I do hope he's ok.

~~~~~~

Chapter End Notes

Poor baby, you just want to hug him. So much makes him feel like he isn't worth it, but to one CEO, he is worth more than an employee. He wants that friendship.

A text conversation is leading to what many would, most definitely call a date. Will Phainon ageee to the request or not? ~~~~~~• Thank you for reading. Uber appreciate it!
