chapters.title: Chapter 8
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Phainon still couldn't understand it all. Did the universe think it was fun to pick on him? First, he had a crush on a boy from the news. Then, he got a nice cushy job, only to then be manager at the place where that boy, now a man, owns and operates a business. Now, that crush wants to spend a whole weekend with him. It's like the universe was poking him every step of the way. Even the silent gravestones of his parents would probably say the same thing : just try.

Will one phone call happen to change his mind? (Again universe doing its poking)

Chapter Notes

No official beta read. First off, sorry this took so long, been battling a head cold this past week and that + work has kicked my butt. I do thank you for keepinh up with their tale of romance unspoken.

Even though Phainon had access to the one thing that gave him the deepest pleasure in the world, after visiting his parents, it was hard to watch.

All the perversion that came from the camera installation took a back burner to the turmoil of his own feelings. Saying how he felt, out in the open, put a lot of his life into perspective. He knew, though in the end, no matter how he was feeling about Mydei, it couldn't go any further. He would have to try to fight it. As much as his parents would want him to find someone who could love and be there for him, his sins outweighed the positive.

There were a few videos during the week that were saved to watch later, his heart, or well, his drive, wasn't in it.

Before Phainon knew it, Friday was already here. Deciding to take another trip to see them might help him make a decision on how he wanted to handle the weekend. Knowing full well that Mydei wanted to take him somewhere. It was the fight between being a hermit or trying to be friends with the man that had clenched his soul.

Since Monday, everything had been fairly normal, but quiet. Not once did he see or interact with the boss. He felt maybe Mydei was giving him space. Not trying to push things.

Life on his terms.

The same trip back to the cemetery felt like the one earlier in the week, minus the rain. Going down the same flower path, something caught his eye. Finally getting back to the headstone, he found the anomaly. There were 2 single flowers put in each bouquet. They were each varying shades of red that were dusted with blue glitter.

“They are so pretty. But who? I wanted them buried here so I could visit them more often. Our home was far from here. My parents didn't have any friends that I know of. So who would leave them such a simple but poignant gift?”

Just as the last words left his lips, his pocket vibrated. Leaning against the tree, he fished the phone out.

Mydei?

Part of him forgot what today was. The day before the weekend.  Meaning he had all the free time in the world.

¤¤¤¤

Mydei:

Hey, sorry to bother you.

Just wanted to see how you were doing.

Cass had said you've looked a bit down.

If there is any way I can help, let me know.

Please don't trouble yourself with the thing I had mentioned.

Maybe some other time.

Phai:

No, you're fine.

Just a lot has been on

my mind as of late.

…..

……

…….

Uhmmm, I would probably have enjoyed whatever you had planned,

but I don't do long car rides very well.

I'm not sure how I did

those trips with you, honestly.

Mydei:

I assume it's something more than motion sickness?

As I said, it's ok.

I understand.

You don't have to push anything on my account.

I won't bother you as much

if it gives you the space you need.

I can be content with just this.

Just someone to talk to.

Phai:

Mydei.. I..

Mydei:

It's ok.

I don't mind.

Really.

I was headed there anyway.

I'll bring you back some….

Phai:

Noooo, wait!

I do want to go,

but if it's a long trip,

I have to do something

to mitigate my anxiety.

Mydei:

Are you sure?

I don't want to be too much.

Phai:

No…. No, you're not.

I'll figure myself out.

You take care of the trip.

How do you want to do this?

Mydei:

Well, it is a longer car ride.

I was thinking, if ok with you,

we'd stay the weekend.

I can pick you up early tomorrow morning, drive us there,

show you the surprise,

and then come home Sunday night.

Since we both have work on Monday morning.

(Wait!?! Shit!?! Alone with Mydei?? ALL WEEKEND! I can do this. I can't promise I won't fall more madly in love with him. But if I go, I can't run away. If it gets too much, I won't be at home, where I can hide. Just remember to bring more meds. Phainon was excited, but that anxiety was creeping in again.)

Phai:

Ok. That's fine.

If I need a few for myself,

is that gonna be an issue??

I don't want to ruin your surprise.

Mydei:

Not at all. I'll make sure we have separate rooms so that you can have your privacy.

So if you're ok with it all,

I'll pick you up around 5:30am.

Just so we can get on the road before things get busy.

Just remember to bring your meds with you.

I can get you to a hospital if need be,

but it would be a bit difficult where we'll be.

Phai:

Trust me,

I won't be forgetting them.

Wait….

How about just picking me up at work?

Mydei:

Sounds like a plan.

Thank you.

I do hope you have a good time.

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

“Shit.. what did I just agree to? Well, I'd better head home and get packed. Get my meds in order.” Reaching down, he placed a hand on the headstone. “I'm trying… for you guys. I hope I'll be ok.”

~~~~~

5:15 am, Saturday

Phainon had arrived fifteen minutes early to try and prepare his nerves. The medicine for his blood pressure and anxiety was already taken, but this was way too early in the morning for him. The excitement of it all made Phainon restless. His extra pillow and blanket, which his mom made, were on the trip. Maybe having her comfort would ease his troubled mind.

The cameras at the house sent a notification that the boss was on the move. With a speedy car like his, he'd be here in no time.

Just breathe, you got this.

Five-thirty on the dot, the sleek black iridescent car pulled in beside him. It was time for Phainon to face his fears. It is a trial; he was hoping that failure wasn't an option. He wanted to try so hard. Try to do maybe one thing positive with his life.

Once parked, the driver exited. Sunset hair pulled up in a little bun at the back, letting the rest hang down. Mydei's signature braid was worn with the tightest of folds. Donning his black spectacles made the young CEO look so much more alluring. A black short-sleeved button down was over a dark red tank top. Nothing was buttoned but the ones at the bottom, tucked into his pants. The under shirt was tight enough that Phainon could make out his pecs and possibly his abs. Mydei even wore his favorite ripped jeans.

The whole image was to die for.

“Since it's so early, would you want to sleep most of the way there? Might mitigate having to look at the road.” Phainon was stunned by how

thoughtful everything was. “Honestly, I already put the chair back to lie down in, and there is a small cooler in the back seat with water in case you need it.” Mydei added.

Walking to the back of the car, strong fingers that have seen many cuts and burns glossed over a part of the trunk.  It popped. Phainon had never seen a trunk so fancy before. Must be the perks of choosing how your car is made. “If you want, anything you don't want to leave upfront, throw it back here in the trunk.”

Making sure everything was out of his car was important. Phainon grabbed the bags first. Taking over to the trunk, he was in awe of how much space it had, considering how small the car looks. “Damn, this car is so nice, like everything on it, in it. It's all beautiful.”

That smile Phainon loved came back to Mydei's face. “My mother would love to hear you say that. She went with me to get this. Helped pick out all it would have.”

“She has such good taste. Like, I'm not a CAR guy, but I know nice when I see it.” Closing his back doors, he gets in his passenger side, taking out the pillow and blanket. The whole situation still felt a bit weird to him, but he remembered that he promised to try.

Mydei opened the door for him to get in, placing his stuff on the seat. “Are you sure you're ok? I don't want to push you.” The worry and concern were written all over his face.

“Yes, we are good. This thing is important enough for you to want to share it with me, of all people.” Taking a big deep breath, Phainon steeled his nerves. Trying to be open was a big step for him. Especially considering that someone wasn't family.

“Well, I do consider you someone special. And you've already been partially exposed to it. So I figured, why not take it to the next level?” Mydei was as vague as possible.That smile was still on his face. Even though the sun wasn't out at this time of morning, the driver was the

brightest thing here. Lighting up not only the area, but a dark part of his being.

Wait?!?! Next level!?!? What is he talking about?? Nooo!..No...no...no and no…we are not dating.  Not happening.

A voice broke his panicked thoughts, “Are you just gonna stand there in your head or are you gonna get in to go back to bed?”

“Ohh shit, sorry.” Giving his car the once over, it was beeped. Keys shoved in his pocket. Getting into the plush passenger side was like heaven on his butt. He still couldn't get over how comfortable the seats were. Putting the belt across his lap, he lay back on the seat.

“Shit…” a yawn pulled from his body “...this seat is.. com..fy.. “ it was almost as if being hugged by the cushions was just enough pressure and support to make him feel sleepy. He didn't last long. Mydei waited till his passenger was fast asleep to pull out of the parking lot.

Being that it was a newer car, it rode very smoothly. When any kind of bumps or divots in the road happened, all the wheels acted like it was nothing. Mydei had some soft classical playing at a low volume, not to disturb Phainon's sleep.

I really wonder if car rides are that bad for him? Did something happen in his past? Hopefully, I can get him there ok.

Some time had passed on the road.

Glancing at the clock, Mydei noted they were making great time. Everything was going ok until he heard the blanket shift a bit. Then a lot. Because of being on the highway and no one being around, Mydei set it to cruise control.

Looking over at his passenger, Phainon had the most pained look on his face, and his body was shaking.

Shit, he's having a nightmare.

Keeping his eyes on the road, left hand on the steering wheel, Mydei reaches over to the sleeping passenger. Gently grabbing his hand to try and ease whatever turmoil his mind is playing. Phainon’s hand squeezes a bunch. All with varying levels of tightness.

What's going on inside his mind must be the reason why he is so distant from people. That's so horrible. For someone so nice to experience this, it isn't fair.

Suddenly, the grip loosens. It's not clinging on as if its life depends on it. Just gently holding on to the only thing that is keeping him stable in his own mind.

Mydei was more than happy to help.

He probably hasn't had any kind of support all his life from any nightmares. Hopefully, this works. Even if it is just a little bit.

He keeps the grip until they are almost at their destination. Phainon's rest must have gotten better. There were no more pained looks or tight squeezes.

“Phai,” a hand is placed on his arm, and gently shakes. “ Hey Sleeping Beauty, we are just about there.”

THUMP

Phainon opens his eyes slowly, partially staring at the man beside him. The cerulean eyes look so much brighter after his nap.

Mydei felt something in his chest looking at the ocean staring back at him. He could get lost in them. Being this close, all the different shades of blue can be seen.

Just like a master piece….. wait, what?? I….Mydei thought looking at his sleepy companion

A big stretch came from the passenger, followed by a yawn, “Shit.. are we almost there??” Sitting his seat back up, Phainon was greeted with the most beautiful countryside. Trees are all out in full bloom. They carry varying

shades of white to oranges and reds. Just swaying in the early summer breeze.

But surrounding them in the distance…

“FUCK!! IS THAT CASTRUM KREMNOS??” He couldn't believe his eyes. It rose above the trees and mountain ranges. The tall towers almost touched the clouds. It had been abandoned for centuries, but the Kremnos family still had all the rights to the land. When his parents eventually pass, Mydei would inherit it. Not just the land, but the ruins as well.

The car drove down a path to the orchard. He parked along the side of the road, pomegranate trees just a short walk from where they were. They got out to see the foliage much better.

“Shit, that almost makes you a prince.”

Mydei got very quiet. Looking off into the distance, Phainon felt he had said something wrong.

“Oh my god!! I'm so sorry. Did I say something wrong?” Fuck, did I already ruin the trip? Even though he may have a lot wrong with his mind, he never wants to hurt anyone with his actions or words. And the one person Phainon is getting attached to(much to his dismay), he feels like he's already screwed up so much.

A hand comes over and grabs his arm. He then looks up at the most beautiful amber eyes he'd ever seen. They were sad, but not hurt.

“Phainon, you get in your head way too much. I'm fine. It just hurts a little because I haven't been called that since I was little. You remember the boy who passed? He used to call me that.  Because of my family having -waving his hand towards the distance - all this, he saw me as a prince. Also, because I was so nice to him, he told me I was just like the princes from his storybooks.”

Ohhhh that… I.. ohhhh. Well, the kid wasn't wrong. Mydei is so a prince.

“If I can be honest. He wasn't wrong.”

THUMP

Mydei tried very hard to hide his blush with his hair. That feeling was creeping back into his heart and mind. Less and less he was understanding how one IT person could make him feel like this.

“I uhmm…. Thanks..” Without another word, he started walking towards the trees. Hoping to hide the red his face was showing.

Waiiiiit….did I embarrass him?? Why does he have to be so beautiful all the time? It's not fair.

Running towards the prince, he caught up. Walking along beside him, something just felt good. Right. Something both men couldn't explain. Like a question that needed answered out loud, but both their hearts knew. The odd twist of fate was pushing them together.  Neither man knew how the other felt outright. There were little things each was picking up on, but they were too subtle to count as something more than just friends.

“So, can I ask you something?"

“Depends on what it is.” That sunset hair was beaming again against that smile.

“What did you mean by taking it to the next level?” Pleaaaasssee don't ask for anything more than this.

“Ohhh that. Since you have already had my family's wine and juice, why not take you to where it is made? You can try it right from the source.”

“And you grew up here!?”

Reaching up to a hanging bush, Mydei grabbed a fruit that was hanging low enough. He got it into his back pocket, fetching a pocket knife. With chef-like precision, the fruit was splayed open, showing the contents inside.

Phainon couldn't deny he loved watching the master at work.

Damn, what that man can do with his hands. I mean…. I've seen both good...and bad good. Those fingers can do a lot.

“Yes, I did. Both of my parents frequently came out here for meetings. I got dragged along because they didn't want me to be lonely at home. Which..” His eyes just lingered on the fruit, thinking of a lot of things from his past.

“You were lonely even WITH people at home? I'm sorry. We both have had very different childhoods, but I can totally get how you feel.”

Pulling a section out of the fruit, picking out the white parts, Phainon sank his teeth into the fruit. All the fresh juices flowed out of each pod. Sweet and bitter at the same time.

Mydei just stood stunned, watching the man before him consume the fruit. It was like watching something dirty, but he couldn't take his eyes off it. That feeling of embarrassment hit him again. Mydei was trying so hard to hide it all. Good thing Phainon's face was too busy to notice.

“Holy shit, these are so good. They don't taste like normal ones. Like, yeah the tang is there, but the sweetness is amazing. No wonder your family makes wine out of it.” Looking up at his prince, he noticed Mydei was trying to hold back laughter. “What?? What's wrong??”

Mydei reached into his back pocket, grabbing a rag he took specifically for this. Not realizing that the fruits were worthy of being made love to, apparently. “Your face is an absolute mess. You look like a wild animal.” Without prompting, he starts to clean up the mess on Phainon's face.

Phainon's insides froze, feeling the soft hands holding on to his chin.

Ohhhh shit… ohh gawd.. wait.. what color pants did I wear… ????? Ohhh, yeaaa black.. this isn’t good. My heart and erection can't take him. Part of me would love to kiss him… I can't.. Why does he have this effect on me?? I just don't get it. Shit, people like me don't deserve love.

“There...all clean. You don't have to eat it like an animal. Some foxes may be offended by you eating dirtier than them.” Leaving the rag in his hand, Mydei walked on, picking pods out and eating them like popcorn.

Almost just like a dog, he cocked his head to the side, watching the nicest ass he'd ever seen walk away. Everything about him, Phainon felt, belonged in a museum, but his own personal one. He didn't want to share.

“Hey, slowpoke, you coming?? Or are you making a mess again?”

Haha, in my pants. I just about did. Dammit.

Running to catch up again, he stopped beside Mydei. They were both overlooking a long way down. Blue eyes followed the valley up, trying to find more land. Then it came into view. They were near the gates of the city.  Still shining with all its brightness hundreds of years later.  Pieces may be missing, or huge chunks lying on the ground, but a lot of it was still intact.

“God damn. It's…. Just.. I've seen it in history books, but never in my wildest dreams did I figure I'd be standing before it.”

“ What about in it??” His feet began to take him towards the bridge.

“Wait, Wait, Wait!!! We can't just waltz in there.” Catching up beside Mydei, he was getting nervous.

“And why not?” Said with a smug look on his face.

“This is historical land. PLUS, it's falling apart. We don't have permi….”

“Phainon, what is my last name?” While the snow hair stopped in its spot, the sunset continued on, getting to the opening of the bridge.

The caretakers of the castle part of their land knew the heir was going to pay a visit.  Everything was in place for him to give a quiet tour with no one around. They were told by the Madam of the family to give him time and not to go back to their duties until he left the premises.

Over the years, due to foot traffic, the bridge was repaired often. Especially for the family it belonged to, the caretakers do an amazing job with the grounds. They maintain the whole ‘old’ look of the place. If something had collapsed, it was taken care of with the utmost pride and safe keeping.  If nature and time seeking, it was allowed to take its course, but should it be a danger, the team took care of it right away. Making it less of a threat.

Mydei took his strides with precision. Just knowing how fast and far to step. Waiting until Phainon's brain caught up with him, and then his feet soon followed. The prince was about 40 feet from the start of the bridge before someone finally yelled at him.

‘HEY!! HEY!!! MYDEIMOS!!!” Phainon’s feet were trying to carry him as fast as they could. He was no runner, but all his years of staying in shape helped him get to his prince faster. “Holy shit!! God dang.. why.. you.. I….” Finding his breath was harder than getting fruit in the orchard.

Continuing to walk at a slower pace now that his guest had finally decided to catch up, a smile and laugh adorned his face. In the midday sun, Phainon couldn't help but stare. He knew full well now, it wasn't just desire. Watching the yellows and reds flow in the breeze, his heart skipped so many beats. He knew right then and there, on Mydei's homeland, he was in love. Searching his thoughts more(which always got him in trouble) told him it could never happen between them. The one-sided love and desire were all he had.  I guess just spending time is enough.  A partner doesn't seem to be on his agenda. Definitely not for a pervert like me.

Phainon had to get out of his own head somehow. “So, growing up here, I assume you know more history than what the books say. I wouldn't be surprised if you've been all over this place.”

“I do. I got my love of history from here, from how my culture used to do things. Not that I agree with war, but I know that's how things went back in the day.”

Their walk in the ruins felt like they were there forever, until Mydei stopped. Large chains separated them from the next big structure. Phainon

had to ask, “Uhmmm, not to be an ass, but how are we gonna get over?? They didn't seem to make any alternative paths further in.”

His prince looked at him with the most serious face. “We take the chains, of course.”

Phainon’s whole soul dropped out of his body. “You can't be serious? They look so damn old that even a bird might collapse them.”

The strawberry-blond hair donned a large smirk, starting his way across the chains.

“DUDE!! If something happens to you, they will murder me!”

“Are you scared?” Mydei kept pressing onwards.

“Nooooo….” Internally, he was torn. Yes, he was totally scared. Everything here looked as if it could break with just a breath on it. Phainon's other half wanted to show his prince he was able to stand side by side with him.

Biting his lip, almost drawing blood, he let his feet take him where his heart was afraid. Just about when he was near Mydei, a hand reached back for him. His brain didn't have time to react. Phainon grabbed the hand in front of him, squeezing it tight. Something about it felt so familiar. He wasn't sure why. It was reassuring and calming, just something he needed.

"I'm going to let you in on a secret. My mother used to bring me this far in. I was even walking the chains by myself. I had to learn to steel my mind and not be afraid of the unknown. Yes, things could happen at any time, like things giving out, but you never know until you try.” A squeeze of the hand, he hoped to show Phainon, “It's ok to be afraid. I was when I started, but I always had support. So I'm here for you now.”

“Your mother sounds like an amazing woman.”

“She is, I think she wears the pants more than my father does. She raised me more than both of them. He was always busy.” A small laugh left his

lips. “To be fair, I still like her better.  Her big heart, strong mind, sense of justice….. I wanted to grow up to be just like her.”

“I think you have. Everyone looks up to you. The respect given is unreal. I think, from your description, you're just like her. “

“Phainon??”

“Uhmm, yea??”

“We are at the top of the chain.”

He looked back and saw they were.  Mydei's storytelling had distracted him enough not to notice they had reached the top. His eyes peered over the ledge to a huge drop-off. “Shit”

“Good job, it only gets easier from here.”

“You're funny. WE have to go back down it.” A slight panic tinged his voice.

“WE are going to be fine. I want to show you the furthest place in here, and then we can go eat.”

Dude. I am so glad I took my meds this morning, or I'd be a total wreck right now. I'm so all over the place. Why does this have to be so high? Work doesn't count. It's closed in. This… yea we could die.. I'm ok..

Mydei squeezed his hand a little tighter, bringing his thoughts back to the man before him. Phainon took some deep breaths, shaking his head yes, so that they could continue on. Being inside the building made him feel a little better, that is, until they came to another door that led outside.

Stepping out onto the old stone, both could feel the powerful history below their feet. Just how many people traveled this path in the past? To battle, to worship, and maybe to marry. So many things could be felt in the air.

“Come, we are almost there.”

Traveling down the steps led to another bridge. Phainon was starting to not like bridges anymore.  They all looked like erosion would set in any second, and they would never be seen again.

This is hella better than those chains. God damn.. I felt my soul leave my body.

While in his head again, he never knew Mydei had stopped walking. Phainon ran right into him. For a split second, he could feel all the muscles beneath the clothes. Taking a step back, before he could speak, imaginations ran wild. Picturing his prince in full armor, one worthy enough for royalty. Cutting down those before him, always coming out the victor.

Yeah, he is definitely from here.

“Shit, I’m so sorry. I wasn't watching where I was going. Here I really should.”

A soft laugh could be heard. “No, you're fine. I got lost in thought, too. When I was here a long time ago, I never got to experience things by myself. I always had to have someone with me. I couldn't ‘Explore’, but with you I can. I have time. “

“Hey, I'm the one having hissy fits. You have no fear here. I'm glad I could visit and see this with you. I bet when they do tours here, it never goes this far.”

Standing in a large circle with a gap between the ‘stage’ and the seating, the large scale of it all really came into perspective. Festivals and combat challenges could be seen.  Parts on the metal flooring show signs of strong slashes on them.

“There is a fairy tale about this place. Do you know it?”

“No, I'm not sure I do. Wanna have story time?”

Sitting down on a large boulder at the side of the area, Mydei motions for Phainon to come sit beside him. They have a long sit, Phainon hearing the

story of how a floating sword used to hang above the area and pass judgment on things. Always a symbol of the people. Ever there for their protection. No remains of a sword have ever been found, so most chalk it up to a fairy tale. Nothing more. They still use the imagery to show the might of the land, though.

With half the day away, both men were hungry.  Making their way back to the car,  Phainon was a bit more proud of himself for not needing help. Still wary, but made it.

“Hey”

Looking up into the beautiful amber eyes. “Yes’sum?”

“Are you doing ok? Like the car ride here, the walking…. The drop-offs.”

“Ohhh that… uhmmm, yeah I’m doing ok. Just hungry right now.”

“Well, how about we get lunch, go to the local museum, and then to the winery for dinner? The hotel knows we are coming. I texted the manager earlier. He just said, ‘Get here when you do.’ We don't need to worry about in or out time.”

“That sounds…. Wonderful. I don't know how it can repay you for this experience. This is all truly magnificent.” Phainon was almost at a loss for words. Trying to turn his brain off was a bit of a challenge. He managed, though.

“You're being my friend and giving me a chance to share it, is repayment enough.”

It was Phainon's turn to don the red face. Being that his hair was white, it couldn't be easily hidden. Hurrying up to get in the car. He was hoping that not being in the sun wouldn't show his embarrassment.

Cute. Is all Mydei could think of.

He felt that adorable was the only way to describe a lot of Phainon’s actions. Maybe this time around, he could have a friend.  Maybe the fates

would be nice to him this go around.

~~~~~~~

Chapter End Notes

Well, he took the leap. Going on this trip is going to be quite an experience for them both. Besides Mydei sharing things from his child hood and family land, there are definitely budding feelings happening. How will the rest of their weekend fair, being alone together?

thank you so much for reading and support.<3

chapters.title: Chapter 9
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

After nearly(NOT) dieing in the ruins, the check in for the hotel was needed. After a quick stop there, food was needed. After some deliberation, seafood was chosen. And it just so happens that Mydei knows another old man that runs a restaurant who would love to see them.

This 'date' is going well.

Chapter Notes

No true beta read. Hopefully you enjoy!

Back on the main road, it was a short way down to the hotel they were staying at. The building was as large and grandiose as the ruins they were just in. The building was so expansive and large that it housed almost anything you could want from a tourist destination. Multiple floors, entertainment, hot springs, regular dining/buffets, and shopping for souvenirs or items you have forgotten.

Being in the Kremnos region, hot springs and lava flows were abundant. The hotel utilized them when building the place. Using the lava flows was a clean heat source. Adding many public and private onsens was a pull to the area. The health benefits draw in a lot of people. Making it ‘Must Do’ while here.

Pulling up to the entrance, the car parked off to the side. Making sure it was over far enough not to block any traffic. Phainon was taking note of all the cars parked here. Many fancy ones, of course. There were also regular ones. He watched a fairly normal family get out of a van, gather their things, and head to the hotel.

Wow! For as big and fancy as this place looks, I didn't figure it was affordable. Only people with money came here. I was totally wrong. Then again, look at their prince. Nothing like what people would expect in private. I guess I am really lucky to see it.

Something Phainon did take note of is when they pulled in, the doorman was on his ear-com. He assumed it was about them. Not too soon after, another hotel employee came out with a lady in very fine attire.

“Wait here.”

What else was he to do? The car was still running, and he was in the passenger seat. All Phainon could do was watch the exchange. There was a lot of bowing on the hotel's side, but also from Mydei. A form of reverence and appreciation. From all the clues given, he assumed she was a manager. They have to have many for as big an establishment as this is. The trunk was popped, and bags were given to the staff. After another bow and handshake, Mydei got back in the car.

“Things go well?”

“Yes. That was one of the managers of the hotel. They were very happy to have our company. We could have stayed at the bed and breakfast near the winery. I like this place a little more.”

Pulling out from the entrance, they made their way back on the road leading into town. It had become a lot busier than the last time Mydei had visited. More stores have been opened. Newer tourist spots as well. The small town he knew as a boy was so much more lively now.

“So, since the last time we ate, I got to pick the food. How about you do it this time?”

“ME?! Are you sure?? I've never been here. So I don't know what's good or what would be ok to eat and then go to a museum.” His finger pointed at his stunned face.

“Yes, you. No one else is in the car but us. So come on. What is something you like to eat?”

Doing some thinking, he was reminded of home. The good seafood he hadn't had in a long time, not since he left home.”Uhmmm, how about seafood?”

“Good choice. I know exactly where to go.”

They finally reached downtown, and Phainon was just falling in love with the place. The architecture was amazing. It was so old-world, and many took that old, making it semi-modern. Part of him wanted to skip the food and go right to the museum,but he was having a hard time keeping the grumbles of his stomach quiet.

They pulled into a parking space. Mydei leaned way too much into his own space. Breath could be felt on his skin. Phainon was trying to keep himself calm. The sexy voice of his driver was right in his ear. All coming out as a whisper. “If you wanted to eat, I could have brought more fruit for us, silly puppy.”

No more words were said, the sunset exited the car. A slight laugh could be heard on the wind. He was just left in the passenger seat with way too many feelings. This was the second time today Phainon was glad he wore black pants. Gawd shit! What that man's voice does to me. Did he HAVE to whisper?? Fuck..

Composing himself finally, he exited the car to stand at its front beside Mydei.

Dorado Petaloúda

“Is that in the local dialect?

“Yea. Dorado is a type of fish that is caught here. It's very prevalent. No matter how much fishing they do, fish are always there. Petaloúda is for butterfly. More about how the fish is prepared, not the insect. The restaurant is called that because the owner got their start on that dish. It was very

popular.” Mydei explained happily. It made him feel things, being able to explain stuff about his home to someone who was finding a spot in the CEO's heart.

“Damn, you sure do know a lot about here.”

Lightly punching him in the arm, “I'd hope so. Didn't you ask if I grew up here? Even though I did spend too much time in the mansion, I did get to be here quite a bit, too.”

Mydei grabbed his hand for the second time today, sending all kinds of not-organ-shaped hearts through his system. Holding onto it, Phainon let himself be led to the restaurant.

Once at the door, Mydei let go and was talking to the staff at the door. He could tell they recognized the prince, making one of them run to the back. Not even a minute later, an older man from the back came out; he looked very elated to see the company. Came over to Mydei, giving him a big hug. Having a very quick chat in the language of the area.

“And who is this fine strapping young man?” The owner was talking about him, and Phainon's embarrassment level went through the roof.

“Cosmo, this is Phainon. He works for me as the head of security. A good friend of mine.”

Phainon THOUGHT he was going to shake the owner's hand. Nope, he was dead wrong. He got pulled into a big hug as well. He had never been in a place where the people were so personable, cheery even.

“Well, good. The young master needs some friends. He works to damn hard. He needs someone just to be normal with. You keep that up, lad.” Patting Phainon on the shoulder.

“Uh. It is an honor to meet you, sir, and I'll try.” Sir, you have no idea how much I would love it to be more than friends.

“Come this way, I'll get you guys a good table. Really good view of the water.” Cosmo was more than delighted to have the two boys as company. He was going to make sure this visit was extra special.

Phainon was trying his best not to be super embarrassed. It wasn't often that he ate at a place, always trying to keep social interactions to a minimum. He couldn't understand how Mydei knew so many ‘happy’ old men. At least Zeno was a polite hi, not trying to make me part of some family. That hand is strong, too. I wonder if he still fishes.

They followed the older man through a lot of tables. For a Saturday at lunch time, it was a pretty full diner. The path led outside to a sitting area overlooking the water. They were the only ones out here. Boats could be seen in the distance, fishing and floating around for leisure. The town may be small, but it was full of life. It felt lived in. Seeing all this around him, Phainon was getting a good sense of how Mydei grew up into the man he is now.

“So whatever you boys want, I will make for you personally. I haven't seen Deimos in some time, so I would be more than honored to make you anything.” The smile was beaming across his face. Cosmo was more than ready to hop into the kitchen and get cooking.

“I mean, I'd love to try the dish this place is named after. It sounds amazing.“ Phainon was so hungry, he'd eat almost anything.

“It is. I used to eat here a lot when I was young. How about making that two? And maybe 2 pomegranate creams?” Mydei felt right at home here. Part of him wished he could move back, but being close to the restaurants in case of an emergency was more of a priority.

The owner left the two men to go make them an amazing dish. You could see a spring in his step. He was more delighted to have them as company.

“Is he always that cheery?” Phainon questioned, laughing.

“Well, you know, I don't know. I haven't seen him for a few years. I do know he really likes me, though. So this probably made him extra happy.”

One of the staff brought them their drinks. Both were larger-sized cups with a creamy pink color beneath a large dollop of whipped cream.

Taking a sip, tons of flavor hit Phainon’s palate. His eyes grew wider. Part of him wants to drink the whole thing right there. He felt like a little kid again.

They talked about the area until Cosmo returned with 2 plates of the Dorado Petaloúda, lightly crusted with panko and served with homemade pitta and sauce. They started into their dishes. Mydei was more than happy to share his favorite childhood things with someone who was elated to be shown them.

“What do you think?”

Trying to look a bit more dignified, he put the fork down. “Holy shit. This is just amazing, and that word isn't even good enough. This has to be the best fish I've had in my life. Nothing back home even compares to this. It's so soft and tender. The flavor?? Shit, it's so good.” He kept praising the food for another five minutes. Mydei was more than happy to hear all the wonderful praise. Phainon’s excitement was infectious.

They finished their meal, ordering dessert after.

“I do hope you don't get tired of pomegranate-flavored things. It's kinda what this region is known for.”

“No, no, you're good. It's interesting to see what people can do with it. It can't be easy with such a tangy fruit.” Before he was just about done with his drink, a large bowl of pomegranate Gelato was brought out for them to share.

A very vibrant pink color, speckled with some of the seeds. They both enjoyed it immensely. Phainon left no flavors uneaten. He was in love with the food.

“Wait here, I’m gonna go pay for it.”

He disappeared inside. Phainon was full and happy. He was basking in the flavors still floating around in his mind. Making a note of where this was to definitely come back again.

“I take it everything was good?” The older man in glasses asked.

“More than. Did you catch that this morning?” Mydei fished out his wallet.

“Yes, I did. Those were the two biggest I caught. Something told me to save them, and I can see why. So, young master, can I ask, is he someone special?” Making a face like he's implying things.

“I thank you for saving them. And….” His ears were becoming a bit pink, the same as the gelato, from the question. “...uhmm no. Just a friend.”

“Awww, that's a pity. You two look good together. Well, enjoy the rest of your trip, and you need to come visit more often.” Cosmo knows what he said and meant it.

A cough was had to hide his embarrassment, but all in truth, he was developing feelings. Mydei just didn't want to act on them. Afraid of what would change, not sure where they really stood, since both had issues with relationships.

Mydei placed a very large bill in the older man's hand. Way out doing the price of their meal. “Please, keep it all. Give the staff a good tip from it.”

“You are so much your mother's son. She used to do the same thing. It was just like this. Just two of you. You have grown up into a fine man, sir.”

“I'll have to tell her you said hi. Also, from how Phainon was talking, you may also have a lifelong customer in him, too. He grew up in a place with seafood, and he could not stop raving about this meal. I do thank you for everything.” He walked back to get his companion so they could get on with the next part of their trip.

On the way out, Phainon had to stop and shake Cosmo's hand, telling him himself how good everything was. The old man was more than delighted to

hear all the praise.

“Bye, you two. Please, come back again. Have fun and a very safe trip home.”

Both men got in the car, starting to pull away from the restaurant. Old eyes watched them leave. Yupp, totally, they should get together. Good luck, highness.

~~~~~~

“Ohhhhh my god!!!!” Phainon leaned his seat back.

“You good?” Mydei asked, turning at the stoplight, the destination was just across town. It lies close to where the ruins can be seen.

“My god!! MORE THAN!!! That was so incredible. I guess going to culinary school, you know where to find the best food in town.” All the fish and fruit flavors were dancing around in his senses.

“Noo, it was before that. Remember Zeno and Xerxes? I've been around them since I was a child. And I've seen Cosmo just about every time we would come here. I always asked mom to stop, even if it was just for a soda and pita.” Stopping back here really did make Mydei's heart long to return permanently.

“Well, I can see why you love food so much. Those guys are amazing. They do some awe-inspiring work.” Phainon swears he could crash into a food coma with so many good things he's had today.

Before he knew it, they were parked outside a building that looked ripped out of time itself. It had used some of the old architecture for the front and then built the rest of the museum on the back, but keeping in tone with the aesthetics.

They walked inside, while Mydei greeted the people at the door, Phainon was looking around in wonder. Even the entrance had stuff dating back a few thousand years. A tap on Phainon's shoulder told him that they could go

in. Stepping out into the rest of the building was just a sight to behold. Phainon's eyes couldn't be wide enough for everything. Sites were assaulting his vision from all sides; he didn't know where to start.

“Does every place here know you? See, I told you you're a prince.“ Giggling to himself, he wandered a bit forward, looking at the representation of the smelting machines they used for their weapons.

“Well, this is my family's land, and a good chunk of the stuff in here was donated over a long period of time. It had all been done by archaeologists hired by the family. Most things were even before my grandfather's time. They have been at it for quite a while.” The whole building felt like stepping through time. Mydei was proud of his heritage.

Amber eyes just watched his guest. Phainon walked around the place with childlike wonder. Asking every and any questions about the item or its history. If Mydei couldn't answer it for him, one of the guides was more than happy to come in and explain anything Phainon had questions about.

Otherwise, they were left alone in the exhibits.

They came to a back section dealing with the war aspect of the culture. So many items belonging to the infantry. Something caught his eye.

There was a display of all the heads of the Kremons family. Listing any information that could be found. Some were full of detailed information, others just a line or two because of how old and sparse the information was.

Phainon’s breath caught. Holy shit… these weapons… They are exactly like the ones in his room. That's so crazy. There was an old spear and shield that looked exactly like his. I wonder if it's a family thing why he has them??

A hand grabbed his shoulder, bringing him out of his thoughts. Secrets he carried that have more context to them now. “Are you ok?”

“Yea, I'm good. Just amazed by all your family history. It's incredible. Thank you for sharing all this with me.”

That smile came back across his face. Phainon’s insides were giddy to see more of it. “No, I should be the one thanking you. For one, I was kind of afraid you were going to turn me down, but if you did, I was just going to have to be ok with it.”

“Yeaaa…. I just…” A hand grabbed his arm, squeezing a little.

“You don't have to explain anything. I just appreciate that you trusted me this much to bring you here and show you a world not many see. I'm forever grateful." Mydei glanced down at his watch. They had actually been there a long time. Getting lost in history will do that to any one.

“Well, it's almost 6. We left Cosmo's at 1. Do you feel like having dinner now? Or would you like to explore more?” Mydei also couldn't believe how much time had passed.

“Wait, it's almost 6?!? Where did the time go?? Didn't we just get here?” Phainon was shocked that they had been here that long.

“I’m afraid not. We have been here for almost 5 hours. I figured that was going to happen. Considering, I get the feeling you love learning, and it was on full display." A small laugh could be heard from him. Mydei was happier than he's been in a long time. He's never been around one person who got him to laugh and smile so much. His insides had feelings that were new and weird. Maybe he would digest them over more food.

“Yea, I do. Well, I can't look at EVERYTHING right now. Then I won't have anything to look at next time we come. So, yea, let's go eat.” Phainon turns to walk back the way they came. Mydei was behind but at a slower pace. Words struck him hard.

Wait, did I hear right? Did he say ‘WE’?? Like he would do this again?? I have to be dreaming. I really never imagined this trip to go this well. Maybe I really have gained a friend finally.. ppfft at 30.. gawd. I just hope it's not too much.

A warm hand came down, lifting his chin up. That bright smile looked amazing against the snow white hair. “Hey, who's too much in their head

now? Are you good?”

“Yea, sorry, just had a moment. You've just been waiting to throw that back at me, weren't you?” Mydei was really starting to get attached to those lovely cerulean eyes.

Doing the classic sticking out of the tongue and winking, Phainon was laughing all the way, "Guilty as charged, my prince. However, shall I be punished?”

“I'm gonna take you to the winery and make you eat good food and wine.” The oh so scary threat was made.

Walking right alongside him, they both were laughing. “Ohh no! What shall I do?? Enjoy it?? Wooee is me.”

Once back at the entrance, Phainon thanked the staff for all their help and letting them explore at their own pace. He told them he was definitely coming back again, so he could see even more stuff. Phainon also got some souvenirs to bring home.

Once back in the car, they were all still smiling and laughing. Neither man has felt like that in a long time. If ever. With their work being so demanding and their personal lives being nonexistent, days like these were ones to treasure.

The road to the winery was back on the original one they were driving on near the orchard. When they got close enough, one could make out the brewing and bottling facility, the restaurant/tasting part, and the bed and breakfast.

“Like, ok, I see why now. The hotel has more rooms and more to offer. Plus, I bet the view is better there, too.”

“Quite. Like I said, not that this place is bad. I've been here before on my own, but the hotel feels more personable. This is more for the ritzy tourist. The food is great, though. Plus, getting to try the wines firsthand is always fun and gives you a better perspective on taste.”

It was odd for a Saturday night at the winery to be this busy; they parked a bit away from the building. Both were fine with a walk. It would help with digestion later.

A private room was booked for them on Friday. An exact time wasn't given but probably around dinner time. Their timing wasn't too far off. Before they could go eat, Phainon had to have a proper lesson in wine tasting. He was told that it was his choice of what they would have.

All the processes made sense, and within a half hour, a wine was chosen for the meal. After ordering their food, Phainon got lost in telling Mydei all the wonderful things he experienced.

It's just like he is a little kid coming home from a field trip. Has to tell me everything with such enthusiasm. God, it's infectious. He's….. he's….he's infectious. Those feelings were creeping back again in the back of Mydei’s mind.

That smile was back again, not just for the storytelling, but for the storyteller.

Because of the music and atmosphere, neither man noticed that the weather had changed partway through the meal. It was coming down hard enough to get one drenched.

This time around, they both chose different desserts. Delicate and light, considering the heavy meat and vegetable meal they had just consumed.

On the way in, Mydei took care of the bill. Same as before, what he left was more than the cost of the meal. Tips that could be split for the whole house. Not just the front.

When done, they both thanked the staff for their time and food. Once at the entrance, both men stopped.

“Shit, when did it start raining??” They both almost said in unison. Looking out the window, Phainon couldn't tell how much was coming down.

A voice came from behind them. The hostess at the podium informed them it had started about forty-five minutes ago. Neither had any clue, being so lost in the good time they were having, that Mother Nature had other plans.

Fishing the keys out of his pocket, he taped Phainon on the shoulder. “Stay here, I'll go get the car and bring it over.”

“Hey!! Come on, I don't mind getting wet.” Haha, as of late, that is a lot.

“No, I won't hear of it. You're my guest. It's my job to take care of you.” Before any interjection could be had, Mydei was already out the door. Sprinting to the car, getting completely soaked.

The car was brought around, and he even got out with an umbrella to help his guest into the car. Not once caring if he looked like a drowned cat.

Escorting his guest was a priority. Phainon even made an 'Ohh you’ face at him, but didn't complain. He figured it was a losing battle. Which it would have been.

Once the passenger was in the car, not wet, he could go around to his side to get in.

Trying to ring his hair out before getting back in really didn't do him any favors. Giving up, all of the hair that clung to him was put up in a bun. Every bit of his clothes was sticking to his frame. A certain pair of cerulean eyes couldn't stop looking.

God damn, he looks gorgeous wet. Why does he look so good with and without clothes? How does he do it? I wish I didn't have better control right now. I'd love for him to pull off in the orchard and make love to him in that seat. -internally sighing-    Just…fuck..

Mydei tried to stay as still as possible, driving back to the hotel. Besides getting the car wet, he knew his body was cold and reacting to it. Everything was frigid. Too much blood was flowing to try and warm him up and to the wrong places. He didn't want to be rude in front of his guest. Not that for a split second it didn't cross his mind.

“Are you good?? You look like a wet cat.” Phainon teased. His clothes were barely wet, except for the bottom of his pants.

“I feel like one. I know how it can fix that.” A smile crossed the wet cat's face.

Phainon’s mind was starting to overreact. Not that in his wildest fantasies he didn't engage in such pleasures. He couldn't do it for real. Also, he basically went out for his first date with the hottest single man in town. He had a ton of food, visited many places, and had a bit of alcohol in his system… anyone could take it as a date that was going to go places.

Mydei taped a few things on the screen, making the phone appear. The number was dialed for the hotel.

¤¤¤¤¤

Hotel:

Yes, Master Kremnos. How can we be of service?

Mydei:

Hey, I was wondering if there

were any private onsens available?

We kinda got caught in the rain coming down.

If not, that's ok, figured I’d ask.

Hotel:

Let me take a quick check.

*keys clicking*

There is, but it is partially outdoors.

Has a garden and waterfall with it.

Would that be of interest?

Mydei:

*smiles to himself*

Yes, that will be fine.

Is there a time limit for it?

Hotel:

No, sir.

As you are one of our biggest patrons,

it is the least we could do.

I will make sure robes are supplied to both of your rooms by the time you get here.

If there is anything else you may require,

please don't hesitate to ask.

Mydei:

Thank you, I appreciate it a lot.

We will be there in about 10 minutes.

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

“I guess if you stay often enough, they would do things like that.” Going on this trip has opened Phainon's eyes to a lot of things. The privilege you get from being in an upper-class family, but also the separation it causes. He

can see why Mydei has a very hard time making honest friends. Especially ones who don't want something from you.

I think this is different. He WANTS to show and share these things with me. Why me? I still don't know. It's crazy, too, how much everyone loves him. He has such a big heart for everyone. Like, and it isn't just the family name. Mydei did all this on his own. I can see why not learning about your friend passing till years later would make you want to shy away from people. Who's really gonna be honest with you?

By the time the hotel came into full view, the rain was lightening up. Much more scattered, indicating the storm was just about done passing through the area. Not that the area didn't look beautiful, covered in rain, but it was getting late for the two of them. Plus, Phainon had no clue as to when Mydei was up that morning.

The one benefit that Mydei did use was the garage VIP parking. It was covered so they didn't have to worry about getting wetter than needed. Well, more so in clothes. Exiting the garage, there was also a service desk there, and an attendant waiting for them. She handed him the keys and a towel to try and dry off on. Indicated to them that their room was on the 10th floor. Both luxury suites with balconies overlooking the area. Robes and extra towels were supplied for the onsen. Even though it was private, they still would prefer if sensitive areas were covered.

“The information I got said that the onsen is on the 6th floor. Ours will be in room 9.” He muffled, telling Phainon the information using the towel to get some of the water out of his hair.

Hahaha, time to be very mature… 6th floor room 9… hahaha nice. Yeaaa, I've dreamt about that too. Phainon knew he was a pervert.

They both step onto the elevator, pressing the button for the 10th floor. Being on an outside wall, nature could be seen all around them. It looked really beautiful at night with some of the street lamps catching the light rain just right against a lot of the flowers. Off in the distance, something caught Phainon’s eye.

“Hey, question, what is that over there?” Poking his finger against the glass.

Placing the towel around his shoulders, walking over beside him. Mydei could feel a warmth coming off the man beside him and didn't know if he was imagining it all day or not. And it looks like he wasn't. “That glow out there? Ohh, that's the lava flows I told you about. There are still a few active ones that come near the surface out by the ruins. Most are all underground now, used for heating and the onsens here.”

“WAIT?! We could have extra died at the ruins!?!?” Part of his anxiety was spiking. The time was coming soon for his evening medication. Phainon didn't like taking it, but because of being in the hospital so young, it affected a lot of things.

“No. We weren't even close to where those flow from. I just took you to where I always went. I told you before. I wouldn't let anything happen to you.” Mydei was staring right in his eyes as he spoke. The worry was written all over Phainon's face. He was hoping that he could provide some sort of relief for his guest.

《DING》

The bell to the 10th floor rang, breaking the spell that had come over the two of them. That smile came back, hitting Phainon right in the heart. That was one thing he'd never tire of. Mydei squeezed his arm, exiting the elevator.

Sexy wet kitty. Hot damn! How those jeans hug now…. Wait, wait…. Onsen….hot spring… she said towels… ohh god, oh no. I'm gonna have to get in first. There is no way I could go second and not stare and not already be turned on. Plus all my scars..
