Chapter Summary

Sunday morning was finally here for both men, and feelings were all over the place from the previous eveing. The onsen... both personal pleasures, with only a wall separating them. Everything was crazy.

Unfortunately now they need to make the trek home and each are trying to bury their feelins for the other with out actually talking about it. Damn feelings.

How are either going to act knowing the things they learned and experienced?

Chapter Notes

No true beta read. Hopefully you enjoy!

Special privileges happen when you visit a place often, even more so when your family owns the land the hotel is placed on.

There wasn't a wake-up or check out time. The dining area served food all day. If they really wanted something for breakfast, it could get made.

Mydei woke up the next morning with an explosion of emotions. His sleep was amazing. The good rest and soaking in the Onsen did wonders. The lingering thing was haunting him.

Through the wall, he heard Phainon pleasuring himself. All the while, he was doing the same thing. Mydei didn't know how to take it all in. There was a part of him, wayyyy in the back of his conscience, that WANTED to see it all.

He had already admitted to himself that Phainon was very attractive. But then to hear how much he was enjoying this mini-vacation, the joy and excitement in his voice, made him fall just a bit more for his white-haired companion. All those feelings needed to be locked away.

Mydei could tell there was a lot of internal history that hurt him. Letting anyone in that close would probably never happen, especially with being his boss. He finally realizes Phainon is his first crush and is let down. Feelings were there, but that fire kept burning out before him. He is even hoping for the smallest of sparks. When they do arrive home, it needs to be put out as quickly as it appears.

Pulling the pillow he was lying on closer. Part of him felt empty. Wanting more, but being held back. Like if he'd touch the fire, more than burns would happen, scorching more than any stove could ruin skin.

The only thing this chef can do now is just watch that spark from a distance. Knowing that no one else's warmth will ever match.

Swinging his legs over the bed, Mydei was shocked that he was naked. It never happened.

Dammit, I guess I was too tired after cleaning up to care. I'll get a shower, put some freaking clothes on, and THEN text him to see how things are going. What does he want to do? I know I don't want to be late getting either of us home. We both have work tomorrow.

~~~~~~~

Snow white hair lay across the dark pillows. Cerulean eyes opened to an empty bed. Like they always had. Part of him actually wanted to crawl into bed with Mydei, fall back into a blissful sleep, and just get up later.

“That's a dream that's never gonna happen. Why can't my brain just let me enjoy stuff? Why does it have to be this bad? Like that devil is on my shoulder, always telling me you're not worthy of anything. The angel tries so hard to let me feel happiness, but he just gets crushed.”

Rolling back around to face the nightstand, his phone was showing almost 10am. Phainon wasn't even sure when he passed out after the quick, clean-up shower he had. His body was so relaxed that it just crashed instantly.

Yawning “Ohhh godd dang… I never get to sleep this late. Stuff always needs to be done. I wonder if he is up yet?? I also severely hope he didn't hear me. It would make things so weird.”

As if right on cue, the screen lit up with a text from the lion prince.

▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎

My prince:

Good morning, I hope you slept well. I am just getting myself together. It is 10am. We can get food on your time. When you're ready. Just come over and knock on my door.

Also, thank you again for agreeing to come with me. I am having the most wonderful time. It means the world.

▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎

“God. Seee…. This is why I can't win with this man. Always doing anything and everything to show just how much he cares. Fuck, I am so lucky. Why couldn't I meet him in another life, where mine isn't so bad?”

Since they were going to eat first, then probably leave, all his bags were in order. Fishing around in his clothes, he found an outfit to look his best. Even though he had hangups about himself, Phainon always wanted to present the best side of himself. No one needed to see what's under the mask.

Donning a pair of black jeans and a sky blue t-shirt, he was still trying his best to process his life from the past 24 hrs. If he hadn't already fallen for the prince, it would have made things so much easier. They could have been friends. Feelings make this all so much more difficult.

I wish I could lock them like a server, maybe even take the password from me. Well, let's get to this.. I can finish this day… then I can go back to my little safe private room.

~~~~~~~

The rest of the day went rather quickly for them. Even though he had slept in, Phainon was tired by the time they were leaving in the evening. So for the long ride home, he got to take a nap.

Would he go to bed when he got back? Maybe. It would all depend.

The trip back was much more peaceful this time for him. Even knowing that he was taking the long ride, his mind wasn't everywhere, worrying about the car and its passengers. The dreams that came were rather peaceful. Relaxing. Being by a large ocean side at night, stars dancing in the night sky. Tiny organisms had their own competition with the stars every time a wave came up to the beach. Just to see who could shine brighter.

The driver was mostly OK. Only that small, tiny piece of information that was trying to get out of the little box it was in. Sometimes, looking at that snow white hair and cerulean eyes, Mydei's mind could only imagine what he was doing to make those sounds.

Mydei also berated himself for thinking about it. He was a respectable man. He didn't think any untoward things about anyone. Not even….. his…. IT manager.

Yea….

No….he….can't

It happens from time to time. He was thankful that, hopefully, Phainon never saw the blush adorning his face.

When he pulled into the office parking lot, his heart was torn. He wanted to offer for him to come back to the house, but a sleepover didn't go so well last time. His heart didn't want any more disappointment.

“Phai...”

Only soft breathing was heard.

“Phainon…” The name came out a little louder. He didn't want to scare anyone awake.

He hesitated, then reached his hand out to touch the blanket covering his arm.

He was, more than anything, glad it was dark out. The blush and heat ran across his whole body. Mother, you need to stop insinuating AND being possibly correct.

Phainon moved closer to the hand touching him, looking for more comfort. His face was covered in content.

Mydei couldn't let it go on. His poor heart couldn't take much more of this closeness.

“Phainon, we are home.”

“Huh…???? Whhhaaa??” Sleepy eyes looked up at him, softly illuminated by all the electronics on the dashboard. “ We are …home..*yawn* … already?? Shit, I feel like I just layed down.”

“Nope, we are home. Do you want to take a bit to get awake? I could drive you home and have someone get you in the morning, if you don't trust your alertness.” Mydei was getting way too used to looking at that face up close.

He didn't know how to explain it, not like his insides weren’t already in knots. More like excited and scared at the same time.

“Noo, I'm good.” Before sitting up in the seat, he grabbed a bottle of water from the cooler. Once the chair was back in the upright position, Phainon thought he saw a slight blush on his prince's face. Those thoughts were stirring something inside. Something embarrassing. God, that face is so adorable.

“I just need a few, then I'm good to go. I know we discussed this before, but I truly do not know how I can ever repay any of this kindness you've shown me. If words could express my gratitude, I'd try. They keep losing themselves on me, though.“

The blush was all over Mydei's face now, creeping down his neck. There was no hiding it. Phainon noticed his breathing was a slight bit faster than normal. Watching the heather grey t-shirt rise and fall a bit more with each breath. Never in a million years or more would he have ever imagined making anyone hot under the collar.

Not like he was just saying words, Phainon truly meant them all. Making his sunset prince blush and get all flustered was just an added bonus. God, what I wouldn't give to just kiss him right now. I'm just a pawn in my prince's court…… I know my place.

It was Phainon's turn to grab Mydei's arm, bringing his thoughts back to the car. Just offering him a sweet smile, he grabbed the door handle, letting himself out. With his back to the car and his dream, the sigh out of him was long.

“I should hurry up and get my stuff. It's late, we both have work in the morning, and you have a bit more of a drive. I don't want to keep you.” Walking back to the trunk, his fingers ghosted along the sleek car. Once behind, he tapped on the trunk for it to be open.

Reaching to get his bags, his hands stopped on the straps. He felt so much hesitation, but knew it wasn't the time or place for feelings. Phainon needed to get home before he did something stupid.

Placing his bags in the back seat of his car, he went back over to the best ride of his life to get the rest of his things. Leaning in, he gave a warm smile to Mydei. He hadn't felt this loved or needed in a long time. “Drive safe, I'll see you in the morning?? “

A simple nod and smile was his answer. Both men would probably fail with words at this point.

He held close to him the rag from the orchard. It was never asked for, so he kept it. My prince, you are too wonderful to me.

Getting in his car, the trip home was short. Given that he lives in town, going to and from work was never a chore.

In his safe space at last, he could relax. Getting changed quickly and taking his meds, keeping an eye on Mydei till he got home, was a priority.

“Who knows, maybe I may get a show tonight?”

~~~~~~

Morning came around to the office, and another part of that storm was coming through the area. Ready to douse more of the land, making the only thing you can hear is the patter of rain hitting the ground. It made the exit out of the elevator not as bad. Castorice was always the first one in and then the boss. After 8am, is when the rest of the office came in for the day.

The IT crew was in at their normal 8:30am on the dot. The wait was now on for their leader.

Mydei didn't have any meetings today, so he could get some regular work done that he hadn't been able to since moving in. The door to his office was left propped open, letting in the sounds of the outside world. His doors were normally closed, due to talking about company topics and the like. His soundproof wall kept things private.

He was in the middle of signing some documents when he heard the door to the elevator ding. It could only be one man. The head of the IT department. Knowing how personable Phainon was with Castorice, he wanted to kinda listen in to how he really felt about their trip.

°°°°°°°°°

“Good morning, Miss Castorice.” He set a jar of pomegranate jam and honey on her desk.

“Uhmmm, good morning to you too, Mr. Khaslana.” She was very taken aback by the presents. “ Are these for me?”

“Yes, ma’am, they are. I brought presents for everyone from my trip.”

“Ohhh, you went on a mini vacation???? That never happens. What's the occasion?? Where did you go?” Not that she didn't already know the answer, she just wanted to see how he'd present the information. She was well aware that Mydei was trying very hard to be friends with him. She was equally more surprised that Phainon agreed to anything, which was amazing. It must have been a wonderful time, considering his enthusiasm.

Also, getting gifts for everyone.

“Yea, I know. Weird right? I really don't have an answer for that. Some….. friends wanted me to take a break. It's the least I could do for their request.”Not admitting that he was trying for his parents. Who were just dirt boxes, under a pretty tree.

“Well, that's wonderful to hear. Sorry, please continue.”

°°°°°°°

Mydei's ears picked up the sound of a familiar voice. Putting his pen down, he pushed away from the desk enough for his legs to get out. Turning the chair to the side, it was wheeled to the end of the desk. Leaning back in it, he just listened.

°°°°°°°°

“The boss invited me on a trip. I didn't know where, but it happened to be a place he spent a lot of time at as a child. I FREAKIN WENT TO CASTRUM KREMNOS!?!? Can you believe it? Like, of any places we could have gone, I had no idea it was there.” The excitement in his voice was infectious. Cass already found herself smiling.

“I didn't realize there was an orchard right outside the ruins. Went there first. Ohhh, that reminds me.” He got into his bag, pulling out another

present. “The boss said I could take as many as I wanted. So I got one for everyone in the office. They are so good. Not as tart as normal ones.”

She gladly took the fruit from him. Waiting for more of his story.

“Then we went IN the ruins. Like I mean IN. I got to places that normal tours don't show the public. Plus, to hell I can see why. We had to go up these scary-ass chains to get there. I didn't think my soul would take it, but I made it in and back. He said his mom would have been proud of me.”

“Yes, I have heard the most inner parts of the ruins can be quite perilous. It's amazing that the two of you went in unescorted.”

Running his fingers through the snow adorning his head, a long sigh came out.

“That's what I thought, but I guess it was just him and his mom back in the day. That's so crazy. It's so beautiful, though. Even though it's run down, there is so much majesty to it. Like the arena. I could just FEEL the history standing in that spot.”

“Where did you guys go next?”

“ Well, we left so early and really hadn't eaten, except for a few fruits in the orchard. He said I could pick, but I've never been out there. So I suggested fish. Dear lord. MISS Castorice!! You have to go to Cosmo's place. I felt like I was back home with how good it was.. hell, better.”

“I have heard wonderful things about them. He happens to be an old friend of his mother's. I was told she always tries to support one of her dear old friends.” She had had their stuff a few times before. The boss has had business meetings over there from time to time, bringing her to go meals. She wholeheartedly agreed that the food was wonderful.

“Then we went to the museum. My. God.”

She couldn't help but giggle at the excitement over taking his face. She was so happy to see him getting out and having a good time.

“The history in that place. So much detail. Like, from records on HOW the place was built to the food they prepared, everything. I've never been in a place that was so thorough with their records.” The rest of his bags were placed on the ground. He had been standing for a while, and the bags were making creases on his skin.

“The boss has talked about their land's history before. They wanted all generations to know their glory as a people as well.”

“That part was totally not skimped over. Ohhh, and the weapon room was incredible. All types of weapons you can think of. The boss's spear and shield would fit right at home there.”

°°°°°°°

Everything in Mydei's system stopped. Eyes going wide. Did he hear correctly?

My spear and shield??? No one but my family knows I have that. How is that even possible? He hasn't been to the house since I got everything moved in. I don't understand.

His mind was all over the place, looking for an answer, but nothing could solve this riddle. He didn't want to ask either. Things may get weird then.

He continues to listen but only with half of his mind. The other half was on this conundrum.

°°°°°°°°°°

With all the toiling he did in his mind, Mydei missed some of the story, but when he picked up , he could tell that it was almost over.

“And then we came home Sunday night. Like, it was an amazing trip. I don't travel much, but this was an experience. It definitely meant a lot.” Picking up the other bags, he was ready to head to his office.

“Well, I am glad the two of you had an amazing time. I think you both probably needed it. You and the boss work too hard. Never take any time

for yourselves, very much overdue, I think. I don't want to keep you, but thank you so much for thinking of me on this trip. I truly appreciate it.” Her smile was very infectious. Making him give her a bright one in return.

Picking up his bags, he left to go distribute the other gifts. Cass noticed a slight more emotion in his steps. Even if it was just the smallest amount, she could tell he was a little happier than he had been. She was more than happy to see they both had a good time.

I wonder if any new emotions were sparked between them? They would look so good as a pair and seem to have a very good time together. Who knows? Only time will tell.

~~~~~~~

The rest of the day was very quiet for him. Work got done, but his mind was distracted the whole time. Trying to figure out what it all meant, most of his lunch went uneaten.

He turned his chair around to the window, watching the rain fall softly behind the glass, reminding him of the weekend that they had just spent together. The things he had seen and heard were now etched into his mind. It was something he couldn't escape from. He almost didn't want to.

But Phainon, knowing about his relics, bothered him like no other. Pulling up his phone, he pulled up the finished drawing of the camera placement. Everyone was taken into account. He brought the special ones into the house in their boxes. Even in the weird off chance that Phainon DID check on him, there was no way for him to see the contents. It was the only thing he didn’t have access to.

I don't remember saying anything about my own when we were at the exhibits. I still don't understand.

A ding on his computer shifted his thoughts. Turning back around, the email program was loaded. And there at the top of the page was the man who was plaguing his thoughts.

▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎

To: Mr. M.Kremnos

From: Mr. P. Khaslana

July 14th, 20xx 4:00pm

I would like to bring to your attention that there will be a large security update to the cameras installed at your home. It will take place at 5pm today and last for at least 2 ½hrs to possibly 3. Depending on how the system updates. The earliest possible is the 2 ½. If you are to be home during maintenance, the security for the gate will be the last thing updated. To still let you go in and out of the residence. The application for the camera will notify you to let you know it's been completed and everything is operational.

Sorry for any inconvenience.

Thank you

Mr. P. Khaslana

▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎

“I think that has to be the most formal email I've ever received from him. Maybe I should head home early. Just to get it out of the way. I'm too distracted to finish work.”

Gathering up his things, he was done for the evening. Maybe going home would provide some answers, he was hoping.

4:30pm wasn't totally abnormal for him. It did happen, but not often. Bidding Cass a good night, he made his way home. No music was played

on the stereo. Everything was quiet except for his mind. Not that he was upset about the situation, he wasn't. Just couldn't understand how.

Pulling into the garage, it was 4:50pm, just in time before things would go down. He entered the door that led into the kitchen, in case there were groceries. He wasn't quite ready for dinner yet, so the mini pancakes with fruit in them were a good snack. Even cold.

Putting a few in a bowl, he needed to get out of the suit he was in. Since it was his own place, taking food to his room was something that happened often since moving in.

They were placed on the dresser while looking for clothes to wear. Just then, a soft beep was heard in the room. His amber eyes shot up, looking for that sound. Nothing was on. No music, no fireplace, and no TV. It was just him looking for clothes in the dresser. Another softer one went off. His eyes focused on the sound. It was coming from around the fireplace.

Walking over to it, he studied the wall space. Running his fingers over the molding, it all felt normal. Tilting his head a little more to the side, he ran his fingers back over the same places with just a bit more pressure.

A swipe over the molding, at the top section where the upper molding met the frame for the inlay for the wall - his fingers sank in some. The release made a click sound. Grabbing a hold of the small panel, it was pulled open.

“A …..camera???? Here in my room?? How.. when??”

Pushing it back shut, his lips pushed together in a tight hold. His thinking was hurting. Sitting down on the bed, he needed to go over what he knew.

“It had to have been him. No one else has been in my house. Especially my room.” Lying back on the bed, his sunset hair flared on the black comforter. Mydei was trying to put it all together. “ But why?? I don't understand. What could….. would…. There….be?”

The past few months, interactions flooded his mind. Phainon has been very tip-toey around him. He knows that there have been many blushes that were

caught. Mydei almost wanted to push them off as a figment of his imagination. The feelings that were brewing in his chest were all coming forth.

“Ohhhh, my god. Last night at the hotel….” His eyes went wide with the realization of it all. “.... Phainon…. Was…. He..” that blush was coming back, but not just on his face. His whole body. “ He was getting off to me. While I was unknowingly thinking of him. We finished together separately.” It then hit him harder that this camera was installed with the rest. Any of his private moments were probably and most likely seen.

“But why…?? I'm not anyone….”

“anyone would be lucky to have you.”

“I know I would”

The thump in his heart got louder. Mydei could hear it in his ears. The man he was trying to befriend…..cared for him. Wanted him. He still couldn't fathom why Phainon would pull away from him so hard. It felt like they had a connection. So many things they enjoyed together.

Did he figure that because I was his boss, he couldn't pursue anything with me? Like, yes, they are employed, but not directly. Is he afraid of me?? My family?? I don't understand. From the talk with Cass, he had a good time. Am I reading this wrong? Why the cameras? It does feel…. Does he like me sexually? I did feel his eyes on me a lot over the weekend. Probably being all wet from the rain, and then the Onsen probably didn't help him. Is that what caused him to do it in his room?

Part of him was kind of touched that he went so far as to put cameras in his room, but would never pursue things. It made him realize now that Phainon could only “like him from afar. Nothing more. That maybe wanting to keep him at a distance is why he gets ‘bailed’ on a lot.

Not that he wasn't attracted to him as well. He made a mess all over the rug for it. Talking to his mother helped him come to the determination that he did LIKE him.

“So what do I do with this information? I'm not really upset that he's more than likely seen ALOT. I don't think he's the kind of person that would share that across the internet. It was probably all just for him. Maybe… just maybe.”

Thoughts were brewing inside him. He wanted to test this theory just to see if it was correct. Mydei surmised that this camera, in particular, was not part of the ones for the main house. This one was special, so maybe it's part of a separate program that only he had access to.

So the camera will be down for almost three hours. He must get some kind of notification that I'm in the room. So maybe after some time, I could do a little something FOR him, to show my appreciation for the weekend. Then see how work goes tomorrow.

That is just what he did. After the allotted time for the maintenance, it was time to put on a show. Something about being watched, but only by Phainon, excited him. For the man, he knew, to really reject the outside life, to not engage in anything social, he had to be special to go to these lengths.

Standing in the doorway between the two rooms, he figures he couldn't be seen. Knowing that he was being watched by a man he now wanted back, excited him. It was now time to see just how round up the cameraman was going to get.

~~~~~~

《BEEP》

The computer had been constantly going off while he was in the kitchen. Bowl in hand, he walked over to see what the commotion was all about. Maintenance was done, so there shouldn't have been a problem. Everything went back up online, okay.

It was the special cameras.

The bowl was immediately put down, and all of his focus was now on the computer and his prince. He couldn't believe what his eyes were seeing; besides the 2nd night in a row, his prince was pleasuring himself again.

“Dear lord. Fuck this is amazing. Someone must like me. I got to spend an amazing weekend with the man of my dreams. Dropped me off and he went home and had some private time. Now again?? God damn. ….wait…wait… wait… does he have a collar on?? I might just cum right now..this night is so perfect. “

The rest of his evening was spent in front of his monitor, being spent.

~~~~~~

Chapter End Notes

Soooooooo ohhhnoooo, Mydei knows about the camera's now. Realizing that he has been watched ever since the house was bought. Poor Phainon doesn't know what an equally as horny and lonely lion will do with that information.

Thank you so much for reading. <3

Chapter Summary

Phainon was having the time of his life this week. Going over all the videos he had saved from Mydei's nigjtly exploits was a dream come true. He had no idea that the Chef Prince was so dirty.

What he wasn't expecting was an invitation to eat Saturday night. How is he able to thing straight with so many things going on inside his head.

Poor boy is just a mess of emotions.

Chapter Notes

No beta read.

Note.. this is an emotional chapter. I made myself cry with it. If you get emotional from it, in any way, i guess i did a good job.

By the time Friday rolled around, Phainon didn't know what to do with himself. Since coming home Sunday night, each night was like a blessing had been answered. Someone was letting him feel out his fantasies with the boss.

There was a little part of him that questioned whether it was too good to be true. Considering how much he's had to clean up his desk area proves otherwise.

“Ok… uhmmmm...” Clicking into his saved videos folder, he went into the deeper, secure one of private videos for the house. ”OK… so.. Sunday night was just hands in the shower. Monday was with a freaking collar and a vibrating plug. Tuesday.. oh god Tuesday. To see him on his hands and knees with his ass in full view with toys in it... “ He rolled his eyes shut and

shuddered. He could have seen himself in there. Every part of Mydei's body was perfect. And seeing a thing he would love to get into was just the best visual orgasm ever.

“Soo ahem… where was I..” He clicked into the next day. “ Wednesday was more shower stuff, but there were toys suctioned to the wall. What I wouldn't give to be that toy, either. That hair stuck to him was just so beautiful. And last night… nooo, last night was beyond what I ever thought he'd do. Edging himself for at least an hour if not more... clamps on those perky red nipples, chain between. Never letting himself reach that edge. Fuck, I know I was having issues. He was such a tease to me. I almost fell out of the chair with how hard I came. “

He did wonder what came over Mydei, though? To do it once a night this whole week. What could have possibly gotten him that excited?

The anxiety had been behaving itself, for the most part, all week. That nagging devil was back. Poking at him. Making him 2nd-guess everything. He has someone now, doesn't he? I don't know what he does most of the day...and I really haven't seen him. Maybe this past weekend was just him testing the waters for someone else. Why am I jealous? He isn't yours to begin with. Your only… friends…. Just friends.

Closing out the file system, his heart was all over the place. He was starting to question if he needed to see the doctors again about his anxiety. It had been all over the place as of late. The extremes really haven't been good on his system. He hadn't needed a psychologist for a long time. Whatever had happened recently, to have Mydei ‘SEE’ him was messing with his psyche. Like a god looking upon his world, deeming Phainon worthy to bask in his holy presence. It has since been the destruction of his soul. It was now lost forever.

His self-loathing was interrupted by a ringtone he hadn't heard in a while. There was a text message from his prince. No matter how much he hates himself, he wants to always be at Mydei's backing call. A loyal like a snow white puppy.

“Let's see, what does my prince want?”

▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎

My prince:

I hope I'm not interrupting you for anything. I know your work always keeps you busy. If you happen to be free tomorrow night, would you want to come out to the house for dinner? I have some new things I want to try. See what you think? If not, that's ok. I understand things are on your time. I asked a lot of you last weekend. I don't want to push anything. If you do, come out to the house around 4:30. Just let yourself in. You don't need to respond. Just come if you wish.

▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎▪︎

“Ohhh shit… Mydei. My Prince. You don't understand. I've been coming all week long, thanks to you…..maybe. Maybe I should. I already know his cooking is amazing. I'll try. What more can I do?”

To his odd surprise, the notification that the bedroom was busy didn't go off. Later in the evening, when what would be bedtime for most, he had to check it. And there he was, snuggled under the black comforter, sound asleep. Rolling the footage back, nothing happened: changed clothes like normal, prepared for bed, and then went that fast. Phainon could only assume Mydei was getting up early to make things.

The past few nights, his escapades have been till almost 1 in the morning. He couldn't believe that the boss was up anywhere between 6 and 6:30, still being able to come into work, looking immaculate as always. Maybe it was a Kremnoan thing. Always looking amazing. From the picture, a long time ago, his parents were very good-looking as well. Thinking back, the prince totally looked like his mother. Beautiful as the first rays of sunlight beaming across the land. No wonder he was so in love with her son. It is as if a goddess of beauty bestowed her blessing on him, that his would forever be eternal.

“It has me hooked. I guess I should go too. I want to be on time. Maybe I should bring something as a gift or a dinner thing. I'd love to take him

flowers, but with someone else probably in his life now, I don't want to cause issues.“

~~~~

4:30 on the dot, he was there. He was really starting to love this house, not just for what happened in it. The peace it offered back in the woods. Amenities that most would dream of. Like, yes, it was an expensive house, but it felt lived in. A home, not just a house.

He knew that's where it had to stay, just out of arm's reach. With his prince possibly having someone nobody knew anything about, the possibility hurt. He knew there was very little space for him. He still couldn't fathom when it may have happened. That Saturday at Zeno's, he said he didn't. And now all the perversion at night, it only led him to believe it was for someone. It was just something he'd have to accept.

He hoped that he wasn't overdressed for the occasion. He knew it was just dinner. He had on a white button down shirt with gold trim, and small suns adorned the cuffs. He had another shirt that matched, but was very noticeable. There was also a pair of pants that matched, but were very dressy. So just sticking with his black jeans was a more comfy choice.

Taking a deep breath, he let himself into the house. Immediately, he was caught up in a storm of smells. So many sweet and savory things all at once. If he was a food connoisseur, then maybe be able to place the flavors. The only thing he knew was that it all smelled wonderful.

Kicking his shoes off, the other shoes confused him. The dress shoes from Friday were there. He remembered them because of having the red soles on them. The pair of black boots thoroughly confused him. He'd never known Mydei to own that type of clothing. Maybe it's the other person. Wait… those are men's boots. So he is gay?? Like for real? I mean, straight men can like anal…. I just… I didn't figure he liked anyone.

Walking into the kitchen, his heart was doing circles. Those sexy jeans were back. Hanging dangerously low on his hips. The black compression shirt was so tight on his torso. It was hugging every muscle on his frame.

Making sure Phainon saw each and every one. Plus, too, he gathered, all the moving around caused it to ride up.

Shirt up, pants down. Ohhh damn. I'm in trouble.

What also caught his eye was the white and gold-trimmed waistband sticking out from said low-riding pants. That belt wasn't helping much. All of his hair was done up in a singular braid, just lying over his shoulder. Phainon had taken notice that the glasses were worn more often now that he had his own place, never at work. At home, they always adorned the sunset hair.

Why does he have to be so effortlessly beautiful and handsome all the time?

“Evening. Hope I'm not interrupting.” Phainon had to giggle to himself, watching Mydei jump at his words. I guess in chef mode, the rest of the world isn't there.

“Hi, uhm noo.” The blush was on his face. Mydei was hoping all the cooking would hide it. “You are just on time. What.. what do you have?”

“Ohh, this?” Walking over to the counter, a covered vase was placed. Making a ting sound when it contacted the marble countertops. “I didn't want to be a rude guest, so I brought something. I knew sweets were out of the question because you make better. So I went with an edible arrangement. I hope that's ok.”

Leaning over the counter, Mydei pulled a strawberry from a stem. He unconsciously licked his lips before taking a bite. The berry was very much in season and juicy. Phainon tried so hard not to stare as the pink tongue came out to lick up the rest on his lips.

Shit.. noo.. dude…nooo. I can't get hard here in the kitchen. Not that I didn't have fantasies about licking sauce off that body, lying across this countertop, like my buffet. Every part is a treat. Just to hear him beg for more. I can't.

“These are really good. In season too. Thank you. That's so thoughtful. So are you hungry?”

The whisk slowly went around the rim of the pot he was over. Phainon could never walk away from here now and not see cooking -no, specifically Mydei's cooking - as sexual. It is some of the hottest stuff he'd seen. That wasn't adult material.

“Uhmm, yes, please. Starving. I can't wait to see what you're working on.” He was starving in more than one way, but had to hold back. Helping set the table, his eyes wandered back to the front door. That pair of boots was haunting him now, poking at the sadness in him.

Dinner went relatively smoothly. Each is making conversation about the food. Asking questions to further the dish-making process. Being at opposite ends of the table, his nerves felt a little better.

“Hey Phainon, while you're here, can we talk?”

Hearing those words, his blood and soul sank. He never found it good when people said that to him. It never ended well. He tried to play it cool.

“Yeah, sure. What's on your mind?”

Mydei sat himself more upright in his chair. Trying not to show his nerves. “Us”

Phainon's insides were screaming right now. He was trying so hard to hold back his feelings of flight. Letting the man who held his whole being speak was important.

“I’m not quite sure how to breach this. I've never had to do it before. Leading a restaurant is one thing. Trying to talk about inner feelings is another.” His voice was carrying hints of worry. Not knowing what to say or how to say it.

Phainon’s anxiety was winning right now. “If there is a problem. I can leave. As I said, I know I'm a lot.” Yea and you are too good for me. Even

as a friend.

The trepidation could be seen in his amber eyes. Not sure of where to go. “Noo, noo. You're good. Can I ask you a very serious question and get an honest answer?”

A simple nod.

“Do you like the show you've been getting privately?” Mydei was jumping headfirst into this ocean, this one he didn't know if he could swim or not.

Heat started building under his skin. Phainon's whole body was on fire. “I'm not sure what you're talking about.” He tried so hard to lie.

“Come now, don't be so coy about it. You saw the chains. Didn't you? And you've seen all the other things that have happened since I moved in?” There was no hate or malice in his voice. Just the soft question riding off his lips, sending Phainon's internals into a panic.

Fuck fuck fuck!!!! So not only does he have someone, but knows… about them all… god.. fuck.. nooo.. noooo I didn't want this. I went too far. He's gonna hate me. I took my lust to a place it should have never crossed.

“From the look on your face. I'm right.” Mydei watched his apple rise and fall with a hard swallow. A soft nod was all his body would allow.

His white hair hung in front of his eyes, trying to hide the windows of his soul. “How?” Was all he could manage.

“You mentioned to Cass about the museum visit. And told her my spear and shield would have looked great in there. No one knows I have those, but family. When you said the cameras were going down. The ones in my room made a noise. I just happened to be in there when it sounded.”

Phainon's eyes went wide with shock. He had no idea that would happen to the private ones as well. He tried very hard to speak. ”Why did you let me see those things, if you have someone?”

The words hit him oddly. Mydei was very confused. “Have anyone? What would give you that impression?”

“Those boots by the door, for one. And all the sexual things you did, it was for a lover, wasn’t it? I don't see why you would do any of those nice things for me if you actually had someone.”

A small laugh left his throat. “No, silly, they were for you, and those boots are mine."

“What!?! You have to be joking. None of that could be for me.”

“No, I'm actually quite serious. I was really hoping you would come to dinner. Phainon, I don't know how to say this… “

White hair got up from his chair in a flash, making his way to the door. He didn't want to hear anything. His world was falling to pieces. Tears were ready to fall. He couldn't let anyone see.

Phainon thought he was quick, but Mydei was just a tad bit quicker. Grabbing his arm halfway through the living room. Mydei knew he had to say it now or never. “I want to ask you out.”

Phainon froze. Those words have never been spoken to him by a person he cared about. Anyone else who had tried, he had no interest in. This was Mydei. His prince. It all hit him like a meteor crashing down upon him.

“I feel something with you that I have never felt with anyone else. I feel like a statue with others, but normal around you. I don't know how many times in the past month you've gotten a blush out of me, more than I have fingers to count. And I was shocked at first about the cameras, but I'm not upset at them. Part of me kind of liked being watched, but only by you. This past weekend, just helped me affirm how I felt. I would like to….”

His words got cut off. Phainon put his hand up to the one holding his arm, pushing it off. “I'm sorry you feel that way.” The lying hurt; his heart was tearing itself apart. “I can't accept anyone's affections. I appreciate the care you took with me, but for someone like me, I don't deserve it or you.

Mydeimos, you are too good for someone rotten like me.“ He walked over to the door, putting his shoes on. He dared not look at the man, stunned in the middle of the room.

With his back turned, holding onto the handle, he had to say it. “You don't deserve a monster like me.” Before any more could be said, the door opened and closed.

Mydei sat on the edge of the fireplace. The shock was slowly starting to fade, and the sadness took over. Now he was feeling the rejection that all others had felt from him. He was hoping so hard that Phainon liked him as well, that his line of thoughts weren't wrong.

They weren't just wrong, they were soul crushingly wrong. He was ready to try and put himself out more just to get burned by the fire instead.

~~~~~

Everything felt like a repeat of that night. Once again, knowing full well he had crushed Mydei's hope of anything normal. He pulled off to the side of the road, just like before, but this time he couldn't stop his tears. They hurt so bad. His ambition got the better of him. Now it was out in the open that he'd been spying on Mydei. Hoping to catch anything that would appeal to his corrupted soul.

“I can't now. I just can't. Everything is ruined. He knows about the secret camera and me watching. At least he didn't know he was falling for a murderer.” Everything he hated about himself was coming out. He couldn't stop being mad at himself for his messed-up life. “They would still be alive if it weren't for me. I get people hurt. I still can't believe my parents lived as long as they did. I figured I was a curse. Maybe that's why the gods took them from me. To save them from my corruption. So they could pass with a happy life. Now this… noo, I can't. He can't love me.“ His fists were banging on the steering wheel.

“You can't love the fallen; there is no saving us.”

Once his tears had dried somewhat, he made the trek home.

With the keys under his fingers, all of the cameras were deactivated, except for the main entrance and gate. The special ones had their systems set to fully deactivate, and the program to be erased in the next few hours.

The horrors of what he caused were eating at his soul. The folder with everything relating to Mydei was shoved in an extra secure folder and then hidden from view. He was going to try to erase his feelings. They crossed his own line. They hurt someone. He never wanted that ever. The only one needing punishment now was him.

His heart was broken in so many ways that he didn't know if it could ever be repaired.

~~~~~~~~

Within the next half hour, a red car pulled into the driveway. The driver got out as quickly as possible. What met Gorgo when she opened the door was her son, on the ledge of the fireplace, in tears. Her son had been hurt deeply. As per the fault of his father, showing tears was a sign of weakness. To survive in the business world, you can't show any signs of weakness.

So to see him now holding his legs to his chest, crying, hurt her like no other. She walked slowly over to him, once close enough, petting his head. The knees came down, arms wrapping around her waist, soaking up all of her son's tears.

A good ten minutes of tears finally settled down. His arms unhooked around her. She was finally able to squat down to see his face. The once proud lion of Kremnos was now a scared, soaked kitten.

“My son, please, can you tell me what has brought the mighty lion down. I've never seen you this upset.” Her thumb slides across his face, catching any tears that are still falling.

“ I …..I love him….but …I got rejected.” His body was trying so hard to fight it again. The one person, outside of the arms that hold him now, he wanted, coldly rejected him. “He also said that monsters like … him didn't deserve love.”

Gorgo couldn't believe what she was hearing. From everything she's heard of this boy: he's sweet, polite, caring, adorable. The list went on. Never did she hear a bad thing about him.

“He wouldn't even… explain. Just left. Maybe just like him, I can't have…..love. Too many treat me like I'm on a pedestal. He didn't.”

Mydei wasn't going to tell his mother about the cameras; that was his own secret. What was the truth was that he wanted to have a relationship with Phainon. Their weekend together helped him realize that. I'm too good for him??? He's rotten??? I don't understand.

“Mother, there is a lot he didn't tell me. Can you help me find answers, at least? I at least want to understand why he said no.”

Sitting on the stool behind her, she pulled out her phone. A friend of hers, going a ways back, may provide her son with some answers. She fired off a quick message and went back to her grieving son.

“I know of someone who may be able to help. You met him a long time ago. I'm not sure if he works the weekends or not. He'll get back to me when he does. For now, I need to take care of you. MY heart hurts seeing you this upset.”

“Mother… you.. You don't need to. I just need to suck it up and…” The second time tonight, his words were cut off.

“Mydeimos Kremnos!” He sat straight up, hearing her commanding tone. It didn't happen often, but when it did, no one questioned anything. “I will NOT have you acting like your father. It is good to show emotions. It doesn't make you a wall. There is something special about that boy. To grab your attention this hard, he did something right. I want to know as well. So, I do not want to hear any more negative out of you, young man.”

There was no way, in all the fires of Kremnos, he would ever disobey her. Mydei has seen her wrath. It wasn't just because she was a mother. She was a force of nature to be reckoned with.

If there was a way answers could be found, he trusted her judgment. Mydei knew deep down that yes, she did ‘love’ his father, but she loved him more. Wants nothing but the best for him in any endeavor he pursues.

Now it was just a matter of waiting.

~~~~~~~

Gorgo stayed with him the rest of Saturday and all day Sunday. She didn't want to leave him alone while his heart was broken. Getting a hold of Castorice for him, she told her he is taking the day off tomorrow. Possibly two. Some things had come up. Cass sent all her love and support. From the sound on the line, things were bad.

~~~~~

Not till she came in for the morning did she know the full extent. Sitting down at her desk, pulling up the log of people coming in, her eyes went wide with shock.

“Phainon is here… already?? Since 6:30!?! Something definitely happened, and it was bad.”

She tried to stay at her desk all day to catch the snow-haired man. Maybe try to glean a little as to what happened.

Then, around 2:30, she heard a body coming down the hall from the tech office. Sure enough, it was him. Cass caught sight of him before he rounded the corner. She was in total shock. Phainon had to prepare himself to come past her, like he was putting on a mask to hide things.

Playing feign was starting to become a thing for her. She picked up the phone and had a fake conversation, in hopes that it was heard.

Phainon was coming towards the desk.

“Yes, can I take a message? Mr. Kremnos is currently out of the office for a few days due to medical reasons. I will be sure to pass the message along

when he comes back. Is that everything? Sure thing. Thank you for your concern. Have a good evening, bye.”

Phainon was shocked to hear the boss had never come in. Now was out on medical. He couldn't fathom what could have possibly happened. Was I the cause??

“Good afternoon, Mr. Khaslana. How can I help you?” She could see some kind of guilt hiding behind his eyes.

“I just wanted to let you know I was leaving for the day. The rest of the crew is fine. I put in a note for my bosses that I'm going to be out of the office the rest of the week. Taking some personal time.” Part of him was hesitant to ask about Mydei.

“I see.” Cass scribbled a note that he was going to be out, to put it in the system later.

“That's good to hear you are taking time. That doesn't happen often.”

“Uhm, I didn't mean to listen in, I kinda heard on my way over - but the boss is not here?” He was trying so hard to hide his heartbreak from the weekend.

“No, sadly, he isn't." There was something up. There was a feeling deep inside that he knew something. I'm gonna play the card. I hope it works. “Madam Gorgo got a hold of me last night to inform me that he wasn't well and she was staying with him. It must be quite serious for her to be involved. So honestly, I'm not entirely sure when he will be back.”

The shock hit him harder than expected. His mom was involved now. He knew now that things were serious. The need to get out of the building was first on his mind

“I'm…uhmm sorry to hear that. Please have a good rest of your week.” He didn't even let her say goodbye before he was at the elevators and gone.

“Wow. That is totally not how I expected that conversation to go. Something happened hard. I kinda wanna know.” Pulling up her contacts, she went down to the lady she was looking for.

《RING》

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

Mama G:

Good afternoon, my dear.

Cass:

Hi, Mama G.

I would ask if things are well,

but I know they aren't.

I know you said Mydei was ‘ill’

and left it at that.

I was wondering if Mr. Khaslana

anything to do with it?

Mama G:

Give me a second.

(She quietly walks outside, shutting the door behind her. Opening her car door, she gets in the driver's seat, shutting it. Giving them the most amount of privacy, she put the rest of the call on speaker.

I didn't want to disturb him or

set fire under anything else.

The short of it all

is Mydei asked him out

and got rejected.

Cass:

WHAT!?!

You have to be kidding me.

Those two have been spending

quite a lot of time together recently.

There has been a

noticeable change in them both.

Like it all was a good thing.

Mama G:

That's what I thought

when I called them on their trip.

They got caught in the rain,

and my son made a call

to the hotel to book an onsen.

I had called him before he got in.

I got the impression that there were feelings.

At least on his side.

He wasn't so sure about Phainon.

I guess he asked him over for dinner.

Popping the question after.

From the sounds of things,

Phainon got very defensive,

calling himself a monster and rotten.

That Mydei deserved better.

(Cass couldn't believe what she was hearing. The bright and cheerful man who just brought her and everyone else presents from their trip...a monster?? Rotten?? Where in all the world's name would he get the idea that he was that bad a person? Undeserving of anyone.)

Cass:

Mama, I just don't understand.

I guess none of us do right now.

I could tell something happened.

He had to put on a face

to talk to me before he left.

I made up a partial lie that

the boss was sick,

just to see where he would go.

There was shock

and guilt written behind those blue eyes.

Now I know why.

Mama G:

So, I'm going to try whatever

I have in my resources to see if I can help.

Now, whether they get together

is for them to figure out.

They do work in the same building.

I finally got him to go to bed.

He's been up since Saturday night.

Cass:

Whatttt!?!? He was up that long??

Ohhhh…

My heart is breaking for those two.

I really thought an office romance was

finally going to happen

between two men who reject everyone.

All we got was heartbreak…

…..

…..

Ohhh nooo

Mama G:

What is it??

I have a feeling it isn't good.

Cass:

No, it isn't.

With Phainon taking a week off….

I'm very afraid that he is going to want to quit

or at the very least, get transferred.

Mama G:

Yeaaa, I was kind of thinking the same thing.

(Car sounds in the background)

Sweet, I have to go.

The thing I asked to help with this issue is here.

So I'll keep you updated.

Please just keep watch on things on your end.

Cass:

Will do, ma'am.

Please take care.

I pray for those two.

I don't want to see either sad.

They are both such wonderful people.

¤¤¤¤¤¤

Pulling up her scheduling screen, Cass sadly puts in the vacation that was written down. Once it was entered, an email popped up. It was informing her of more people and vendors that were coming to the party.

I wonder if either will show up. The boss for sure. Phainon… I really wish.

~~~~~~~~

Chapter End Notes

Love hurts. Those two have so many things holding them back, that trying to be honest with each other blew up hard.

Hopefully Anaxa can find Mydei his answers and find some semblance of peace.

Thank you for reading through the emotions. ❤️

chapters.title: Chapter 13
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Gorgo's longtime friend finally arrives at the house to help with the sad and forlorn kitty. Mydei's mind is in shambles from rejection, not eating or sleeping; he's a mess. But for your first love rejecting you, in a world that only sees you for your status, there may be no glue that can put those tiny pieces back together.

Anaxa has a pretty emotional case on his hands. Will his skills be enough to help the lost?

Chapter Notes

No beta read. Small note at note at the end.

Cool mint hair was caught in the breeze as he exited the car. Looking around, he was taking in all the information he could. A case was going to be given to him for sure, but he wanted to have all angles covered to come to any conclusion.

Coming around the front of his car, he waited for the madam on the phone to join him.

“Good evening, Anaxa, it has been a while.” Extending her hand to shake his.

“Same to you, Lady Kremnos. I see the gods of time can't touch you. Still as beautiful as ever.” A small smirk adorned his face.

“Always having a way with words. Thank you for responding to my request on such short notice.” She leaned against his car, arms crossed over her chest. Her mind was just as frazzled as the situation was. Even she couldn't find an explanation.

“I only speak the truth. So, you are in need of my skills? And for you, they won't cost much. I have known you for a while, and you're a good friend. I am only glad to help.” He would have to come up with a cost later. It was always an equivalent exchange for him. Depending on the assignment given, how involved, and anything affecting him, then set his prices.

“You are well aware of my son running the Evernight. He has always chosen to be single because of his status and responsibilities. As of late, he had taken a shine to his IT manager. And confessions on Saturday have led to some things that were said that make no sense. So what I'd like from you is to find out ‘the why’. I'm going to leave this between you two for confidentiality. Anything said between them stays there unless he states otherwise.”

The pink and blue eyes are deep in thought, listening to the request. Finding information was his specialty. Almost no one could keep anything hidden from his fingers on the keys.

“I understand. I'll accept the request. Once a conclusion is reached, then I'll figure out payment. And yes, everything will stay between him and me. No problems there.”

“Come, I'll introduce the two of you.” Heading back into the house, sounds could be heard from the kitchen. They both wander down the hall, stopping at the threshold. The heir was on a stool, looking like a tornado went through him. His t-shirt looked like something out of an alternate teen music store. It was ripped in a few places and was just hanging off his shoulders. His bun was barely holding his hair back. His glasses look like they haven't been off his face in ages. The ripped jeans were starting to become his go-to pants, not at work. He did invest in other colors but the same style.

The bags hung very low on his face. Lack of sleep and anxiety were on full display. He was trying to nurse a bowl of oatmeal.

“My son, I thought you were in bed?” She walked over to him, gently pushing his bangs away from his face. Her hand then rubbed his shoulders for comfort.

“I was, then I felt ill. Tried to…” His head looked up, seeing a man wearing a dark teal suit in his kitchen. “My god, I'm so sorry. I didn’t realize you had guests. I'll remove myself…”

The man with teal hair words stopped him before he could go any further. With the most serious look on his face, words came out lacking emotion. “No need to leave, Mydeimos. I am here for you.”

His amber eyes shot up at her. Confusion and panic were all over his face. “Mother, am I being committed? I'm unfit to do anything?”

Gorgo's eyes shot at him. “Anaxagoras!! What the hell? With the state he's in, you're going to make a joke like that?”

“I'm sorry. I do apologize. Sometimes my humor is off. No, Deimos, you don't need to leave. I actually am here at the request of your mother, who is still shooting daggers at me.”

“Yea, well, I didn't find that funny.” She sat on the stool beside him, waiting for the rest of the conversation.

Clearing his throat, he tried not to laugh a little.”Your mother had informed me about the incident recently, and I'm here to help you find information. I am a private investor. We go way back, so I was more than happy to help.”

“Is this who you texted Saturday?”

“Yes, and Anaxa is very good at his job(maybe sometimes not his humor). So I am going to leave you two to discuss things. It is going to stay confidential. I am going to check on the restaurants and make sure everything is going well. I hope you find answers and get some sleep.” She kisses him on the forehead. Her arm wrapped around him like a security blanket, one Mydei didn't want to give up.

“I will try. I may get answers, but this may be it. I don't want to try again after this.”

“It's ok, just take your time. I am behind you for whatever you choose. Anaxa, please take care of my son. Find him answers, please.”

With a short bow, he gave his sign of affirmation. “I will try my hardest. No information escapes me.” With his confirmation, she was comfortable enough to leave her son alone. The worry was still there, but she had a good feeling with Anaxa being there.

Trying to fix himself to look a bit more proper. His hair was readjusted, and pulling the shirt up on his shoulders. “Can I get you anything to eat? Please pull up a chair.”

Anaxa couldn't believe his eyes when the refrigerator was opened. One could swear it was from an industrial kitchen. So big that a sheet tray could fit in both ways and still have room. “There is freshly made pasta salad if you're interested. We will probably be here a while. I would like to take care of you while doing all this.”

Still trying to take in everything around him, Anaxa finally reminded himself that someone was talking. “Ohh, that will be perfect, thank you. I'm sorry. I'm just very distracted by this kitchen. I've never seen a house have so much ‘stuff’. Especially industrial grade.”

Placing the bowl with silverware in front of him and water, he walked back to the stool that once held his butt. “When I got this place, I wanted to make sure it was all restaurant-grade. I tend to cook a lot. So if I were to make something here, I can replicate it in any kitchen.”

“Very smart thinking. Just like your mother.” Reaching into his bag, a netbook was retrieved for taking notes. “Now, anything that is said between us stays that way. Even though your mother is my friend, YOU are my client. So, when discussing things, I'd prefer if you were as honest as possible. NO matter the details. I've seen and heard just about everything; nothing is a surprise at this point.” Mydei just watched in awe as the bowl was devoured in front of him. All the while talking, but never being rude.

“I understand. I thoroughly appreciate your transparency and protection of the information. Uhmmmmm…may I get you another bowl?” A small

laugh left him, seeing it already empty.

The look of confusion crossed Anaxa's face. When he looked down, everything was gone. Not that it was a small portion. It was a very full bowl. Now it just sat empty before him. ”Shit, I didn't even realize. It was so good. Ate it like popcorn. One bite and you can't stop. My compliments to the chef.”

“No need, it was something simple. Right now, I don't really feel much of anything. Numb really.” Letting his hair down, it could even be seen in the strands - there was no life in it either. Once adorning his head like a fiery sunset, now it was dull as a crayon drawing.

He walked over to the container and returned with another for his guest. “So if you wouldn't mind, please explain to me what's happened." Mydei was more than impressed with him; not only was he taking notes, but consuming the pasta at the same time. That is somebody being ambidextrous whom he's never seen. With kitchen things, yes. This was totally different.

“I suppose my mother told you the short of it.” A simple nod was his response. Anaxa was letting him talk before any questions. “I have been single all my life, and I had no interest in people. No one wanted me for me. It was all the money. So I kept doing the one thing I loved, and that made me happy.” He motioned around the kitchen and even to the second helping being destroyed.

Another fork-full disappeared, as the other hand was writing notes.

“I have known our IT manager for almost 8 years. And when I bought the house, I wanted him to do the security for it. There was something in his enthusiasm that…” Stares down at the oatmeal before him. Hoping in the slopping mess, he'd find the answers. “…drew me in. Why at that moment, I had no clue?”

All the while he is retelling the past month, Anaxa sits quietly and listens. Feeling sorry for the man- no boy- in front of him. So much of his life had to be dictated by others. Never really got to live for himself. Yes, he may

have the skills to run a business, but being a normal person, there was no book on it. He could tell by how shaken the voice was retelling everything, that this was his first ever crush, making this all the more heart breaking.

The conversation went by fairly quickly. A month of recounting sporadic meetings didn't take as long as some who were giving him a lifetime of information.

“May I interject a personal question?”

Mydei stopped mid though. Kind of lost in his eyes, like no one was home running the shop. “Please, if it will help.”

“So you knew he had cameras in the house before this past weekend. Did you, at any time, wonder how much he was seeing? Any time you engage in activities outside your room, I mean.” He had seen so many things over the years of helping people with their issues that matters of mature content didn't faze him.

“Honesty, no. It didn't cross my mind at all. The only time I can think of that wasn't in my room was the night he bailed on me. I had done things out on the pool deck.” His insides were thoroughly embarrassed. Never had he talked about anything sexual to a living person before. It was all kept locked up, for fear of saving face for the family. Mydei knew it had to be done to find answers.

“I see. What happened this past Monday? Since you had mentioned things changed this past week.” Writing in a netbook helped get more notes down and keep them organized. Much better than paper could ever be.

“Well, to be fair, I think it was partially the whole trip. The thing that broke everything was seeing him aroused on the balcony, then hearing him finish in the room next to mine. I was doing the same. Monday came around. I was at first suspicious when he mentioned things to my secretary that no one, outside of family, had seen.” Mydei couldn't stomach any more. He took the bowl over to the sink. Didn't really know if he'd take care of it later or not.

“I got an email that my camera systems were going to be down for a while. No big deal. When I got home later, during maintenance, there was beeping in my room. I searched, finding a camera hidden in the molding above the fireplace. Later, I found one in the bathroom.”

An eyebrow went up, but no words were said. Anaxa continued to write.

“I was concerned, but not upset by it. I’m still not sure why they are there in the first place. I considered my feelings about him and gave him a show all week. I was hoping to bring him here and….” The memories were flashing back. He had thought the rivers had dried up. No more tears could be found. Somehow, the storm brought it back for him. Starting slow and steady. Not fully ready to engulf him yet. His body was too weak to sustain him.

For the old man that he was, Anaxa could still be quick on his feet. He was over to Mydei in an instant. Trying to catch the body from hitting the floor. Going down with him, he tried to lower them both carefully. Without consuming much or sleeping, Anaxa knew the body in his arms was in no condition to stand.

For now, he just held the man in tears. Anaxa figured that at this point, Mydei had stopped caring. If he were to drown in the lake, then so be it. The best he could offer would be the ferryman keeping him afloat.

After a good 5 minutes of tears, he could hear them softening. “Can you stand? Continue this on the couch?” A small yes was all he heard. Helping the lion to his feet, Anaxa was amazed at the muscles on his body. He didn't figure the CEO had time to work out, but he was wrong.

Once, finally getting him to a better seat, even lying down, he retrieved his notes to continue.

“...and ask him out. But…. I think there was a major misunderstanding. Since I've been allowed to be my own person, at home, I've changed up my style some. I bought the pair of boots over by the door. When he got here, he thought they belonged to someone else. Also, the things I was doing via the cameras were for someone else as well.”

“They were all for him, I take it?” A nod. “Was there part of you that liked being watched?”

“Yes, for the first part. Complicated for the second. I don't think it's really exhibitionism, per se. I am thinking more because I knew HE was watching. No one else had ever made me feel that way. Also, I wouldn't do that normally.”

“If I can also ask, because I know it's a private space, may I go up to your room to see the camera?”

Slowly, Mydei made his way to standing. His body hurt in so many places. Like, instead of running a marathon, the marathon ran over him. One by one, he dragged a tired and starved body up the steps. Right now, he is cursing about getting a house with a second floor. Anaxa was right behind him, giving him balance along the way.

Once there, he sat on the bed. Catching his breath was hard. “If you go to the top left corner, run your fingers along the seam of the molding, eventually you will push down.”

“While I do some work on this, please continue.” His lithe digits got to work, looking for the object in question.

“I think it shocked him that I found them, and more so that I wanted to date him. His response was quick and cruelly visceral towards himself. I tried to stop him, to tell him how much I cared and wanted him. It's his response that hurt the most….. “ Deep breathing could be heard. Anaxa could tell the worst part was coming. Keeping his back to Mydei was probably for the better. “....he was sorry that I cared for someone like him. I deserved way better. He called himself ….” A few tears rolled down his cheek” …. rotten and a monster.”

All of the intricacies Anaxa was doing screeched to a halt. He couldn't believe the words he heard. For as brilliant as his mind was, there would be no cause for that. From what he had heard, both men were just sad and lonely. They just so happened to find a common ground and desperately

wanted it to be more. The extreme negativity was breaking all those gears. Now he could see why both Gorgo and Mydei were concerned.

He knew that this was a sensitive subject, but had to be dealt with swiftly before either man, particularly the more guarded one, did something extreme.

Hooking up a cable to the camera, he let the notebook do some work. ”I am deeply sorry that this -well any of this- had to happen so poorly. I know of TTC and Phainon. They may be smart with security, but I am just a tad bit better.”

Mydei looked at him, confused. “Are you a hacker?”

“Uhmmmm… nnnnoo? I used to work for them a long time ago. So, I know things about the ins and outs of security. How can it be breached? So then, in turn, fixing it. Plus, as a private investor, I have to have ways of finding things I need. Nothing stops me in the pursuit of knowledge.”

“Look, I don't care if he ever accepts me. He probably won't. I……I just want him to be ok and not think so poorly of himself or worse. So, what if he has weird kinks...a lot of people do. I feel, though, he would never do anything to hurt anyone. Hell, I had a hard time getting him in the car with me.” Mydei readjusted himself on the bed.

Anaxa's mind lit up. Information was being added to the puzzle.”Car issues?? What do you mean?”

“I'm not sure.. if he isn't driving, his anxiety spikes hard. The only way I got, the long trip there and back, with him, was that he slept. Does that help things?” Mydei figures anything, no matter how small, can be of help.

“Yes, it does. Now I have the gist of the issue. My book is done downloading what it needs. Can I leave to do more work, or do I need to stay and babysit? “ A small smile adorned his face. Hoping the joke would help lighten the mood.

“No, I am fine. Just exhausted, and my whole body hurts from crying. If you need to leave, please do what you need to. I assume all the stuff that can help you isn't here. So, do what you must. I'll be ok.”

“If you go to bed, it will help me a lot. You can think more clearly with a rested mind and body. If you don't take care of one, the other will fail.” The wall was replaced as it was. “Do you know if any of the cameras are still working?

“I think maybe only the one at the entrance outside and at the gate. There was a quiet humming I could feel when the system was active. Now, the house is mostly silent.” Crawling up the bed, he sank into the blankets strewn about on it. Mydei was hoping that with exhaustion, sleep would come easier.

“Get some rest. If I find….. out…” His words were cut off by soft breathing. Coming around the bed, the lion was out. Maybe finding that little bit of hope, let his mind unfurl itself a bit and finally rest. He pulled the blanket up over him, gathering his things, and leaving just as quietly as he arrived.

~~~~~

Paying attention to the code she used on the door it was easy to remember. Locking the door behind him, he could feel all the emotion hanging in the situation. So much uncertainty was worrisome.

“I need to get back to my big computer. I have questions that need answering.”

“Hacking” the gate was no problem. With how the situation was and from what the netbook picked up, a lot of the system was down or deleted. Even with it offline, he was still able to extract data from it. It was a way to follow the trail back to the source.

Once back in his abode, Anaxa made quickwork with the information he was provided. To further help his investigation, he went to the TTC employee portal.

It still existed in his bookmarks, just in case. Seems his forward thinking paid off. The backdoor code surprisingly still worked. Ppfft, they haven't changed anything in years?! I'm shocked. At least getting this information will be easy.

Going off the already known information, the manager's section was easy to find. There were things in place keeping him from going deeper. He was not detoured by just a little locked code. Considering that he helped build the site ages ago. Some new things may have been added, but still the same.

A few quick command codes entered, accessing the managers' profiles was no issue. There almost at the very top.

Branch Manager: Khaslana, Phainon

Clicking into it, all information was available to him now.

“Let's see what all we are working with. He started that young and became head so quickly. Smart kid. Just as I thought too. He's around Mydei's age. Graduated from tech school early. Wait… what was it…” Pulling out the netbook, his notes gave him the information he was looking for. “His parents have been deceased for at least 5 years and are in the local graveyard. On here, though, there is no emergency contact.“

Pulling up a few more menus, it showed all the changes to the page and when it was updated. Sure enough, 5 years ago, the contacts were removed. Before then, it showed 2 names:

-Audata Khaslana, Mother

-Ierón Khaslana,Father

While pulling up a tab on the other monitor, Anaxa pulled up what information he could find on both of them. Lucky for him, it was very detailed. It showed they were immigrants to the area. His father was a farmer, and his mother did some farm work but was also a baker. More information was found on another page.

“Soooo, our tech wizard was adopted. Interesting. I wonder if I can find those adoption papers.”

Going by where their address was located, he searched around for orphanage adoptions 30ish years ago. There were a few places around where his parents lived that had children adopted at the time. The first place he checked was a bust. No good information was sourced. The second and third brought no fruit to his labor either. The fourth, there was the hint he was looking for.

Glancing over at the clock, it was already midnight. He'd been at it since he got back at six in the evening. Once he was hooked on a thing, there was no stopping.

Reading down through the information, what he found clicked so hard in his mind.

“No wonder he doesn't like anyone else driving. Poor boy was in a car wreck so young.” He tried very hard with all of his cases not to get attached, but something about this did tug at his heartstrings.

“He was the only survivor.”

Everything that Mydei had described fit into the puzzle now with this. Doing a bit more digging from the adoption papers, he found a crash report. At least this was detailed information.

So witnesses around note that his family's car was not in the wrong. They were hit head-on by a drunk driver. Because both cars stopped in an instant, the ones behind the family had no time to react. Smashing the back end. When emergency responders got on the scene, all tried to extract anyone from the wreckage.

Driver of car 1:

Perished on impact. The autopsy report showed alcohol levels 3 times the legal limit.

Driver of car 3:

Minor concussion and laceration on the right side of their face. Whiplash was evident. The body was stressed over impact. Survived.

Family of car 2:

Driver: male, mid 20s. Impact from the collision trapped him against the wheel. Was only alive for a short while after the crash. Died at the scene.

Front passenger: Female, mid 20s. Were able to extract from the car, internal bleeding. Only made it to the hospital. Perished

Back seat passenger 1: Female, very young. Thrown into the seat in front, causing concussions. Had glass from the window in her back. Internal bleeding was also found at the hospital. Passed not long after arriving.

Back seat passenger 2: Male, very young. Was stuck between front seats, glass from the back window embedded in his backside. Minor concussion. Was non-responsive for a time. Only survivor.

“Well, that explains his fear of anyone else driving. He has survivor's guilt. I'm very surprised at how well his mental state is, considering what he went through. I'm beginning to believe that's why he believes no one should be with him. Blames himself for everything. Maybe also that's why his sexual experiences are left to himself and behind a monitor. It's no one but him.”

Sitting back in his chair, he looks over everything. Yes, this case was easy, given his connection to the TCC, but he felt more needed done somehow. Yes, the case had been ‘figured out’ , but that didn't stop a nagging feeling he had.

“Well, I got the answers. I'll go see the lion in the morning. One, to check on him. Two, go over this information and see where we can take it.”

Sending all the info he found to the work folder, everything was logged out and put back in its place. He never leaves a trail when looking for information. When transfers were complete, he too made his way to bed. A lot was going through his mind on how to handle both of them.

Love is a very fickle mistress.

Chapter End Notes

Author's note: -His adopted patients' names are the same as his real ones from the game. Except for his dad. His name in the game is Hieronymus, but doing a search for the name, it showed me all different spellings of it. This is part of the modern Greek translation: Ιερώνυμος (Ierónymos)

Anaxa, true to his word found the source of Phainon's troubles. Its always the decision when something bad happens, do you tell the party involved or not? How will it affect them? In this instance, not good. Hopefully, telling his findings to the sad lion will help some. But with a broken heart, is there a band-aid big enough?

Sanku so much for still coming along for the ride. We are getting closer to the end. 4 more chapters left. Will it ever work out between them? Or forever be alone?
