chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Eveything still hurt. Mydei still feels the sting of what happned. Not only had a friend died when he was younger, now his once chance at being happy with another person is gone forever. After a shower his tired body goes down stairs to an odd smell. Anaxa was in his kitchen cooking him breakfast. After the small exchange, they go over what he had found.... he feels a bit better but still lost.

Chapter Notes

no beta read

The early morning rays tried to shine through the window. With the dark red curtains, not much made it in. Throwing off the covers, Mydei couldn't breathe.

“God.. I'm so warm. Why the..???” Looking down at the rest of his body, he fell asleep in what he had on yesterday. Exhaustion took over, and he slept. He couldn't even remember when it happened. Last thing he knew, Anaxa was talking to him about something, and then blank.

He wishes his dreams were as such. Seeing the past weekend again made his heart sink. It was the best time and feelings that have happened in a long time. He never knew that hanging around a person who meant a lot to you could also give the same feelings of putting on that white coat in the shiny steel jungle.

Once he finally finished culinary school and could wear that white jacket proudly, he did. Food was his passion in life. It was the most freeing cooking, creating meals, and serving the public. Sharing things that were part of his life with someone and that they were enthusiastic about it, made

his heart soar. This was the same feeling. Something about that white-haired man was infectious. It drew him in. He wanted to be a part of it.

He knew now that hope was lost. Phainon would probably never speak to him again. Worse off would probably put in for a transfer to escape what has happened between them. He figured that it was the major line he crossed. Trying to be more than friends wasn't on the terms he agreed. He broke that verbal contract. Now has to deal with the consequences.

Rolling over, his phone said 8:15am. What was beside it brought tears through a sad smile, the smallest he could muster. A small, white origami dog sat by his phone. Phainon had made it when they were going to eat breakfast at the hotel. Stopping in the book section of the hotel, he caught Phainon taking a picture in a book and couldn't tell what it was. Somewhere between that small library and the dining hall, paper was found. Being buffet style, Phainon told him to go first.

He thought it was weird, but didn't think anything of it. In about 5 minutes, he was joined.  Asking Phainon if he wanted him to stay, he said no. The brightest smile was on his face. Since the table was chosen, Mydei could make a quick trip to the bathroom before eating. Phainon was up at the tables when he got back. But what was waiting for him,  Mydei felt like his heart was shot over and over again with Eros’ arrow. Phainon found a diagram for an origami dog. Just so happens that he made it out of white paper, matching his hair.

“I guess this is all I have left of him.” Soft tears rolled down his face onto the pillow. “I guess it's time to lock it away. Caring about others only makes bad things happen. Hephaestion died, and now Phainon thinks he is a monster. He'll probably remove himself from my life entirely.“ Slugging his way out of bed, everything hurt, but not as much as the day prior. Trying to get out of his clothes, a shower would help try to relax his body, possibly his mind.

The marble seat on his butt was cold; he was at least glad his body had some feeling. Turning the knob on the wall, the shower head over the seat turned on. It was like a soft rain across his body. Sorry father, you are not getting what you desire. I'm not doing this again. I'm dedicating myself to

the restaurants, and that's it. Food and work will be my life. There is no room for love in this Kremnoan's life.

Getting redressed, his favorite pair of jeans was put on with an oversized black zipped hoodie. Colors of red, black, gold, and white were strewn about his shirt like paint splatters on a wall. Hair was up in a messy bun. Glasses sat on his head in case needed them. Right now, his eyes still hurt.

Descending the stairs, he smelled something in the kitchen. Walking in, a more casually dressed investigator was making him breakfast.

“Anaxa?? What?? I… don't understand?”

“I see the lion crawled out of the den finally. You look more alive than yesterday. I take it the 14-hour nap helped?” Eggs were stirred in the pan. Mydei meandered over to the stools, pulling a tired body into them.

“Look, not that I don't appreciate this, but I don't…..”

“Need anything from anyone? I figured you'd feel that way. That's why I didn't ask beforehand. Self-loathing will do that to you.” Grabbing a plate, eggs, and 2 pieces of toast were placed in front of him. “Don't argue and eat. You need it. I really don't want to have to call your mother. “

A small snoot was shot his way. Anaxa smiled, finishing his own plate, mildly smirking. “You do look better. I'm sure your head hasn't changed much.” He sat down beside the tired lion.

Twirling some of the eggs on his fork, a long sigh left his lips. “Pretty much. I've resigned myself to just living for my job. It's the only thing that has always been there. I've never felt sad about it. I've never been upset at getting hurt with it. I know what it feels like. I tried to swim in the ocean but ended up drowning.”

“Eat first, then we can go over what I found.”

Partway through their silent meal, a small vibration sounded against the counter. Flipping the phone over, the smallest smile graced the sad face.

“Can I ask?” Mint hair swayed softly in front of his face.

“My secretary. She just sent some emojis. A purple heart, a butterfly, and a single flower. She cares.”

“That's very sweet of her. See, you are cared for. No need to be so hard on yourself.”

Finishing his last bite, he took the plates over to the sink. To his surprise, all other dishes were done. It was empty. Anaxa had done them for him. He shouldn't have gotten angry. So much was brewing inside his head that it was hard not to have visceral emotions over it.

Sighing, his tired body went out to the couch to lie down. His guest was soon to follow. Sitting down on the reclining chair, Anaxa told himself he needed to get one. The comfort on it was exquisite.

“Are you prepared for my findings?”

“ You have stuff already?? God, you’re quick.”

“Well, when you've been doing it as long as I have, my fingers find everything I need.” Anaxa knew what sly comment was made. He was hoping it might bring some laughter to the sad lion.

“Sir…. That was dirty.” That small smile came back, even just for a second.

“It was?? I wasn't aware.” I was totally aware. “So the short version of it all is he is just like you.” Mydei's head rolled on the seat cushion, staring dumbfounded at the statement. “You both feel you can't have anyone in your life. Yours is because of status. His is because of survivor's guilt and slight mental insecurities.”

The words ' survivor's guilt’ made him sit straight up. This is the first he's ever heard of this. His own issues pale in comparison to hearing those words. “Now, just because his stuff sounds worse. Doesn't mean it's worse than the other. You both have experienced something that has greatly

affected your lives and changed who you are, how you feel about yourselves and others.”

Mydei just sat silent at the words being told to him. Anaxa wasn't wrong. It was just hard not to feel that way when everything had been good up until this point, and then went horribly south.

“The other short of it all. He has survivor's guilt from a car wreck that left him scarred and an orphan.” At those final words, Mydei's heart broke worse than it already had. Knowing that Phainon lost everyone he loved. He was the only one left. Having body and mind scars from it…. Feels like he can’t have anyone ever.”

“I guess that's why he rejected me. It hurts a little less now…. But….”

“I get it. It's gonna sting. At least you know. Here is a detailed report of what I found.” Anaxa hands him 2 papers detailing all his findings. With the car wreck and the adoption in his hand, Mydei wanted to love this man harder. Someone so young, having all their world destroyed and trying to live knowing so much got taken. He did deserve all the love, but he knew it was over for them before it had any chance.

~~~~~~~

Getting up hurt. Every scar on his back made themselves known. Not one part of his being didn't feel like shit. Phainon was mad at himself for so many reasons. The biggest one of all was alone in a house in the woods.

He broke the prince's heart and made him cry.

That sweet smile that just lit up his whole life, he will never see again. Toying with the idea of quitting or staying played over and over in his mind. He wanted to stay, but now that Mydei knew about his voyeurism and the cameras, he'd never look at Phainon the same way again. Nothing more than a pervert getting things so many have dreamed of.

Quitting was his other option. Then there would be no more problems at the office. No one would see his sordid face. This option, his prince……

No….noo… I can't say that anymore. I got so many nice things from him, and what did I do?? I fucking broke his heart. I have no right calling him that anymore. I can't let either of us get hurt. I'm a curse. I had to. You can't love a monster like me. I get people killed and spy on others having sex. What is there to fucking love??

Phainon wishes so hard that he could just reach his hand in, pulling out his heart and leaving it under a dome. Never to be seen or touched again. He didn't need it. All it brought was pain to everyone.

Flipping his phone on, it was now Friday. Time was lost to him. Days were a blur. Phainon couldn't even remember when he last ate. Trying to bear the weight of his world has crushed him. He wasn't strong enough.

Opening his email, there at the top was the reminder about the company party. It was a week away. “Maybe I'll go for the first and final time. Get my goodbyes in before I send my request to be switched to a new client. I have lived this long with that crushing weight of my sins on my shoulder; I'll just roll my ball somewhere else. Maybe it won't be so heavy there.”

His whole being stopped. With his phone being held above his face, back flat on the bed, arms stretched out, something caught his eye.

His wrist.

Or more about what he was wearing.

There was a little girl selling bracelets she made with just embroidery thread at the hotel. Mydei bought one for him before they left. Saying they were now even for the origami dog. It was small, simple, but so intricate. She had a way of mixing red and black with white and blue. It's… it's…. Our colors. He even tied it on my wrist. I was so upset about everything, I forgot it was there.

“God dammit!!!” Setting the phone down beside himself rubbing his hands all over his face in frustration. “I don't know what to do? Mom would have the answers. She always did. Firstly, she would tell me how much of a jerk I am for breaking his heart. Secondly, get told I need to stop worrying and

follow what my heart desires. Stop living in the past. Live for the here and now.” Phainon knew with his aliments, it was hard for him to want to trust anyone else with his burdens. It was his and his to share alone.

“Deimos, why do you try so hard? Why do you want to try with me? You could have anyone you wanted. Anyone in the world, but me? I just don't get it. Hell, you even shared a lot of your life with me. No one probably sees that.”

Running the strings between his fingers, the thread was soft and vibrant. I at least owe him an apology before I leave. I'll go just for that. I can't take it any further; it will just hurt him more. One final time, one last dance before the villain bows out. Crushed by the weight of his own desires.

Picking the phone back up, his company website was brought up. Typing in his info, he got to the payroll ledger. He never took time for anything. Compared to others he worked with, Phainon had a gross amount of vacation and sick time. Seeing the numbers available, he knew one more week was what he needed. Go to the party Friday night, probably break the heir's heart more. Saturday, go to the office and clean all his stuff out. Monday morning, go back to TTC and get a new client or just stay in the main office. Maybe never take clients again,  just oversee operations.

“ It's the only way to save what little soul I have left. Be it damned otherwise.”

~~~~~~~~

Inputting the numbers she was working on got interrupted by an email notification. Clicking over to it, her heart got a bit sadder. The IT manager was taking another week off. Something deep inside told her things were going from bad to worse. Castorice didn't like the feeling at all. The boss was only technically back on Monday. She got confirmation from him that he was going to the closest restaurant branch to begin the prep for the party. So he was in, but not really.

Anaxa spent the weekend with Mydei, helping him go over his feelings and the things that had transpired. Also, to make sure he looked like a normal person again and not a corpse, sleeping weird and not really eating wasn't helping him get better.

By the time Monday was finally here, Mydei looked normal again, albeit his heart was still broken. He knew that would take time. The worry still clung to him that he'd never see Phainon again. Even if it wasn't in his life. Mydei had to prepare himself for the possibility that an email would come to him that the IT manager would quit this project and would be replaced soon.

That's the part that stung the most. There must have been something there for Phainon to pull away so hard. The moments that they shared couldn't have been fake. At least he hoped they weren't.

Yes, he was a lion on Kremnos. Always prideful. Always ready to take on a challenge. Never backing down. Till now. This was something he wanted to dump his heart into. Take care of it. Spend time. This time, though, the lion had to back down for fear of the unknown.

Putting on his work pants, a thin black turtleneck, with no sleeves, adorned his torso. And to finish it all, his black chef's jacket was lined in golden thread. Looking at himself in the mirror, he had the confidence to get the work done for his people. They have done so much to support the restaurant and him that it was his turn to give back.

The trip to the closest kitchen was a short one. There was one in town, only a few blocks from his offices. There were many nights, after being a businessman for a whole day, toiling away at the mountains of paperwork to keep everything running smoothly, he would end up in the kitchen. Sleeves rolled up, hair tied back, and not leaving till the last customer had left the building. While doing orders, every time he graced the kitchen to help, he always made some sort of pastry early in the evening to share with everyone who worked in the whole house. Not just the back.

Some places had the division between back and front of the house, 1st/2nd/3rd shifts, but not in his houses. Everyone was part of the team and knew it. If a concern from the ground ever reached him, he went personally to take care of it. No one was better than others when it came to being taken care of. Luckily for him, most issues never made it past the house. All taken care of, not wanting the boss to see to it personally.

Stepping out of the car, his gaze shifted skyward. Grey clouds were coming to settle in. The forecast for most of the week was rain. It never bothered him. It always made for a good afternoon nap or a long slumber. No matter the intensity, it was always a comforting blanket to him.

When he stepped into the building at 6 am, most of the staff were waiting for him in the dining room. They all pitched in for the party. Even the bussers contributed to it. Everyone in the company always looked forward to these events, so helping in any way they could made it that much more rewarding.

“Morning, Kyros. Surprised to see you this early.” Shaking the hand in front of him.

“Sir. Well, it's a busy week, and the more hands on deck, the better. The supplier got all the things you requested on Friday. The menus have been set and broken down for what needs to be done at the earliest and what needs to be done at the last minute. We were just waiting for you to assign tasks to get started.”

“See, this is why I leave you in charge. You always have it handled for me.”

“Well, you are here to be a chef, not a general manager. The kitchen is ready for you.”

Hearing his voice, the rest of the staff gathered in the dining room for the morning meeting. Once everyone was here, Kyros gave him a nod to start.

“Morning, everyone. I want to thank each and everyone of you for your help this week. The next 4 days will be busy. Between prepping for the party and still being open, everyone is valuable. Anything you contribute to the party will help make things easier to get to the finish. Some of you may be new and have not met me yet. I may carry the name of Kremnos, but any who knows me know the kitchen is my passion more than running the company. I am just like your chefs. Nothing more. When this jacket is on, that's my role. If you need anything, please come see me. Even if it is just to say hi and introduce yourself. I'd be more than happy to meet you.”

There was much cheering from everyone in the room. The energy to make this the best party it could be was infectious. A few new people go together in a small group to go meet the head of the company before getting to work. Everyone in the small group couldn't believe the type of person the CEO was. He was nothing like they had seen in other places.

Once everything was settled, he got to work. The menu was long for the 100+ people who would be there for the event. Everyone needed to be taken care of. It is why he does this in the first place. If your people are taken care of, everyone prospers.

The other side of the coin, though, kept his mind off the thing he really wanted and was concerned about. So much would be happening over 4 days, Mydei wouldn't have time to dwell on the “what if’s?”. Food was his focus; that's where it needed to stay.

Except for things with pomegranate.

There weren't many, but the few that did brought his mind back to that weekend. How the fruit was eaten in the orchard, excitement over the gelato, the wine….he tried to blink those thoughts away. They didn't matter now. That friendship was over. He was ready to be cut out of Phainon's life

forever. All he had now was beautiful memories that hurt like a knife slowly carving its way into the skin. It's there, it hurts, but eventually his nerves would give out. Not feeling the pain anymore. Right now, it was too fresh.

Time heals all wounds. Maybe….. but I never got over Hephaestion… So what makes this….him...any different?

~~~~~~~~~~

Regardless of how negative he felt about the whole situation, that bracelet never left his wrist. Something about it felt warm, comforting.

“So the party is tomorrow night. Am I ready for this?? Fuck no… I'm not. I'm scared as hell. I don't want to do this, but I have to, to protect him. It isn't that I don't want him, I do.” Phainon leaned his head against the shower wall. Neither heat nor cold did anything to help with how he was feeling. Everything felt so dead inside. The one person who had reached out the hardest, he broke.

“There is no way to fix this. I don't even know why I'm entertaining the idea to go…. It's probably mom and dad. Maybe.” The cold water ran down his back like a river flowing from a mountain, finding its way through all the muscles and scars on his back, looking for a way to head south. Snow white hair clung to his neck. His forehead was searching for the coolness of tiles on the wall.

He had been nursing a small headache across his forehead all week. It's all from the stress of the situation, but mostly his crying. Everything hurt. This is the worst he's felt in a long time. Not since his parents passed.

Turning off the water, he just stood there. Forcing his body to do anything constructive on these vacation days was a chore. It should have been considered sick time, but he had more vacation time to burn.

The only towel on him was the one drying some of the water off. Being in this apartment alone and on the top floor, he wasn't worried about anyone seeing him.

Walking past the closet door made him pause. The outfit he had chosen to wear to this was hanging as a reminder. It was chosen when he was in a better frame of mind. When a partially happier him wanted to attend, just to see the boss. Now it was just for goodbyes.

White pants hung from the door. They looked brighter against the lights dancing in his room from the street below. Soft gold thread connected the fabric together, giving it a statue feel. A small star charm came from the belt loop to his pocket.

A gift from his mother. Being her star in the sky.

She always had to be with him in some way. Not that his father didn't care, she was just way more expressive about it. Of course, the dog they had was the most forward about his love for Phainon. That was ok in his book. He never had to explain anything. Just an unspoken bond between man and beast.

The silk under his fingers was exquisite. One of the few things that wasn't tech, he splurged on. The black shirt had a higher collar than most shirts, but it was styled that way. Gold thread was used for seams, which made the outfit match as a whole. Darkness and light. An allegory for his own life.

“Why not go out with a bang? Not like I will see anyone from there after tomorrow. Why don't I do a rope choker and gloves? Why the fuck not?”

Walking over to the window, he stared at the life below him. Everyone goes about their daily lives, cars lighting up the ground like the night sky. Everything was peaceful behind glass. Quiet. Serene. Not a feeling he felt often. It felt as though Mother Nature decided to cry along with him. Small rivers flowed down the glass, mirroring his own soul.

“Maybe I should move back home, work remotely? I wouldn't have to worry about physical interactions anymore, unless it's on my terms. No worries.”

Slipping on a pair of white boxers, he needed a drink before bed. The quiet hum of the refrigerator was all that could be heard in his small apartment.

All other electric items were off.

Just before opening the door, his heart slowed its beats. He forgot that on the counter were the rest of the pomegranates from the trip. Running his fingers over the fruit, he could see the laughter and smiles Mydei gave him from eating it like a crazy man, making a mess everywhere. His lips pulled in his mouth. He didn't know which direction he wanted. Sad about his choices or happy about the memories.

Both hurt.

It was time to make the last happy dream he'll have.

Chapter End Notes

Both boys are in such a state right now. They don't know where to go with their emotions. Yes, they are hard, but it's what makes us human. The party is soon, will it fix anything?

chapters.title: Chapter 15
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

It is time to face the music. Phainon decided he is going to look his hottest to tell the man he was(still is) hopelessly in love with that this will be their final meeting. This is goodbye.

What he wasnt prepared for was what will happen on the other side of the entrance doors.

Chapter Notes

No beta read.

“Twilight Courtyard Convention Center. Never thought I'd have to come here for anything.” Taking a deep breath, hands still tight on the steering wheel, he got the first step done by at least being in the parking lot. So many cars were around him. Every employee was invited to it. No one was left out. It was the one day a year when all 5 of the restaurants were closed.

The venue was big enough to carry a small event like this. There were some bigger companies and trade shows that used this building as well. 100+ people weren't an issue. Being that the family is a big part of things going on in the city, everyone was actually fighting to host it. Somehow, Twilight won above the others. Every year, they always look forward to hosting this.

“Why wouldn't you? When your CEO is this selfless, it makes sense.”

His wandering thoughts get cut off by the sound of his text message alert. Who could possibly want me? Unknown number??

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

430-XXX-XXX

Taking a risk is all a part of life. It is what makes us human. If you shut out the sun, what will grow? There is no labor of love without a bit of strife. When you persevere, glory will be delivered to your future. You fought for what mattered most. Will you take that leap into the sun? Embrace its warmth like flowing wheat fields? Or let the tides of darkness consume another victim. You are strong enough to get what is yours.

Will you take it?

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

He reread the message over and over. This person knows who he is. They are dropping hints that they know things, very aware of the situation he was in. Part of him was shocked that he was found. Once he got the number of the current phone, he made it untraceable because of the content he enjoyed, covering his tracks.

Who is better than me and knows about what's going on? I don't like it that they are maybe right. I need to get in there and get this done. The sooner I say goodbye to everyone and break his heart for a second time, the sooner I'm leaving.

Giving himself one final look in the mirror, he got out. Adjusts the ribbon collar and gloves. Going out with a bang is what he was after. The buttons on the front of his shirt were dangerously low, even for him, not starting till after his pecks. Much of his chest could be seen. He hid the good looks behind a computer screen. They draw too much attention.

I'm ready.

~~~~~~

Scanning his badge at the door, he was allowed in. They found it the safest way to know who's coming and going. Also, to prevent anyone from getting in to start trouble. Many security measures were taken.

Everyone was dressed up for this occasion, so bringing his best wasn't out of place.

Once inside, it smelled heavenly. The far corner was the buffet of food. Anything you could possibly imagine.

This is from all the love from their head chef, amazing. Why did I fall for the sweet one? Is there really any room in his heart for me? No.. I broke it, remember.

The party was already well underway by the time he decided to show up. At least an hour to two had already passed. Many were just now eating, some were mingling, and others took to the dance floor. Everyone was having a good time.

His cerulean eyes scanned the area. He knew what was being hunted.

The buffet….???? No. How about the dance floor?? Nothing there either. So I guess that just leaves the tables and groups.

He started at the far end nearest the food, slowly scanning his eyes around, looking for a sunset in a sea of color and lights. Just when all hope was lost, there it was.

Found you.

In a back corner was a group of people and the man of the party. Moving through the crowd, a stool was found in the opposite corner. Sitting by the wall, from his angle, Mydei could be clearly seen.

He looks so good. Dressed in an all-black three-piece suit. Dark red tie. I think that's his lion pin that's on most of his jackets. Kinda funny, he matches mine in gold trim. There are too many to go over now. I'll wait. I've heard some don't leave till almost 3 am. Party while you can, I suppose….

He stayed glued to his chair the whole time. A waiter came by a few times to offer him anything to drink. He just took water. He wanted a clear head to ruin the night.

Something about this group bothered him. Popping open his phone, he did some quick work accessing the signed in guest list. He skipped through the

restaurant's employees. The people around him looked important. In the other section, people were invited guests. Some of the pictures started lining up. Some were shareholders in the whole family business. Others seemed to be important friends of his father's.

The one, though, was sending an itch under his skin. Phainon had been there an hour, just watching. And the one man standing close to Mydei was too close.

Who the fuck does this bitch think he is? He is practically on top of him. He's been inching closer over the past twenty minutes. Trying to keep a smiling face. Ppft, that’s the face of an ugly, smug bastard. Thinks he is gonna get places. Just because he is….. wait!!

He remembered a conversation that they had a while ago. He had mentioned that Mydei's father wanted him to marry, but his mother just wanted him to follow his heart. Looking through the names again. The older man beside him was his father. He's a business partner of Eurypon's. The younger man was his son.

More tabs opened, something about this guy was bothering Phainon to his core. Yes, he was ‘good looking‘, but something about the face said he had an ugly soul.

Let's see here….

With a few more clicks, the fire of anger was being stoked. He knows he shouldn't be mad or jealous, but when he said Mydei deserved better, it wasn't this.

This… this...bastard was kicked out of and forbidden from going into a brothel? The fuck did he do? Assaulted the workers and forced them into acts that were not authorized by the establishment. There were rules to follow, and he broke them…..

There was more information about the charges against him, but like any person of power, his dad got him out of it. Now he has his eyes set on Mydei.

Glancing back at the group, his hand was going slowly lower every few minutes and was almost over his backside. The coat Mydei was wearing only covered part of it. He also noticed there was something in Mydei's body language that Phainon didn't like as well.

The lion was trapped in a cage of hospitality and had no means of escape. The grossness kept him close. Too many were around to make a scene.

Then he snapped. The hand was placed on him. Not hovering, he could see the indent of fingers in the fabric. Phainon saw a quick body jump when the hand made contact; he was done.

That's it. I've had enough. I may not be what he needs… but that cesspool of sin isn't having the prince. No way. No how.

Pushing aside all doubt in his mind, his focus was just on saving Mydei from the situation. He had to be suave, but forceful.

“So, Master Kremnos, your father tells me you have yet to settle down. I think a strapping young man like you would be a great fit for anyone. Even including my so…n...” The old man got cut off.

“Pardon the intrusion,” Phainon's slick golden voice pierced the conversation. “This party is absolutely wonderful, Mydei.”

The amber eyes just stared in shock. Mydei thought he had drunk too much, but he hadn't touched anything. The one person he was giving up hope on seeing was right in front of him. Looking more dashing than ever.

“And just who are you, young sir? I don't think you have enough position to call Master Kremnos by a nickname.” The old man was clearly pissed at the interruption. His son was, too. Trying to play it off cool. Phainon took note of where his hand still was.

“Ohh me?? No one special.”

“Then maybe we should ask you to leave our private conversation, then.” The snark from his son, who was just asking for a punch to the face.

“Sorry, I didn't get to finish before I was cut off.” The brightest smile adorned his face. “I am Phainon Khaslana, one of 3 head managers at Telesaltes Technology Company, and just so happen to be the holder of Evernight Restaurants’ security contract. Pleasure.”

Mydei was stunned by what he was seeing. A side of Phainon he didn't know existed. What in all of Fury's name is going on here? I have to be in a dream. He…. He looks amazing. Why does he look...mad? There is something  behind that smile.

The whole group was stunned. The TTC was a very highly respected company. With some of the brightest people working there, they could be a force to be reckoned with if need be. And to have one of their managers here was taking them all aback.

“The night is still young, and I was hoping to borrow the Prince of Kremnos for a dance.” Phainon was taking that leap. He was climbing those chains again, afraid to fall. He so desperately wanted the hand to reach out for his.

“If you will excuse me, I would love to accept this request.” Quickly as he could, Mydei pulled his body away from the hand trying to molest him secretly.

They both silently walked to the far end of the dance floor. Mydei wrapped his arms around Phainon's neck, feeling his hand gently placed around his waist, and he smiled. Like they were meant to be.

Mydei looked up at the blue eyes he was very fond of, the blush coming back to his face.

“Uhmm, hi, I didn't know you arrived.”

Trying to calm his nerves, he noticed the soft pink dusting his cheeks. “I have been here for a while, doing security.”

“On what? This place is already….”

“For you.”

“Ohh, I see. You didn't…..”

“No, I had to. That piece of trash had you cornered with nowhere to run. I saw him touching you.” Mydei looked down at the statement, knowing it was right. Also, looking down seeing how low the shirt was unbuttoned wasn't helping right now.

A soft blush was dusted on his cheeks and now ears.

“Why did you step in?? I….” The words wanted to come out, but it hurt. “Can we go talk somewhere?”

A small nod was all it took for them to disappear from the room. Mydei walked with his puppy in tow, down a long, unlit hallway. At the very end was an office. Grabbing the handle, it was unlocked. He opened the door, letting his puppy go in first. Mydei soon followed, locking it behind them. Luckily for them both, there were no windows on the inside of the building. The far wall had some long paneled ones, seeing the city before them, still lighting up the night sky at this hour. People are still hard at work. Such was life.

Phainon leaned back against the wall, right foot propped up on it. Mydei sat on the conference desk, resting his feet on a chair.

“There is no one here but us, and the room is soundproof. We can discuss anything.”

“Well, to answer you honestly, if I didn't have better self-control, I may have started a fight. I've been here for about an hour…. Watching you.”

“Seems you can't get enough of watching me, can you?” There was a soft playfulness to his words. Mydei was hoping they would be taken as harsh.

“Yeah, you're right. I can't. So I did some digging on your guests. The old guy is a friend of your dad's and that…..” He tried to hold back his words.

“Piece of shit?” It was Phainon's turn to be stunned.

“I was going to say ugly cess pool of sin, but that works too…. is his son. I'm figuring they want to get you two hooked up since you defy your father's wishes.”

“Yea, pretty much. I wanted to punch him in the face when his hand touched my back. When it went lower, I panicked. I had no way of getting a hold of my guards.”

“Good thing I was there. So, the more digging I did on this bastard, the more I kinda felt better about myself……sorta. I may be into some things most wouldn't approve of, but I have NEVER hurt anyone. He was banned from a brothel for assault and breaking the rules. Some of their workers had to go to the hospital because of him.”

Mydei could feel the rage burning in his words. He wasn't aware of the crimes, but that's what happens when people who abuse power have money. He was sure his father didn't know about it.

“Phainon.. I am sorry about pushing you. I cared too much. I wanted something I know now I can't have, ever. I’m….” He tried to hold back the tears. The wounds were still too fresh. “....never loving another again. I'm not fit for it. I don't even know how normal friends work.”

There was a defining silence between them.

“You're going to leave me, aren't you?” The lion was on the brink of tears.

Phainon's head shot up. He was shocked and hurt that Mydei hit the note before he got to say it.

“Yeah, I thought so. If this is goodbye, I want a chance to say some things. Before you step out of my life forever. “

“I won't run. Please.”

“Look, first of all. Your watching me, never hurt anything. I was shocked, but I kinda liked it...OK, I liked it a lot. Considering what happened at the hotel.”

“What are you talking about?” He was scared to hear the answer.

“I saw you with a hard-on on the balcony. I was getting myself off from seeing it. Then it got worse when I heard you. I made a mess everywhere. I don't think I've ever been so turned on in my life.”

It was now Phainon's turn to be embarrassed. He was caught pleasuring himself, but they did it together, separately. He was glad the shirt was a loose material. He was getting extremely warm.

“Then, when I found out about the bedroom camera, a lot of things I felt made sense. I did like...no love having you watch me. I had a feeling no matter what I did, you'd be doing something to it.”

Fuck is the AC on.. dammit. Phainon almost wanted to lose the shirt.

“And you can't be a monster if someone else was at fault.”

His head tilted to the side.

The lion knew it was time. “It was a drunk driver, not you.“

Phainon’s heart was all over the place, emotions didn't know which road to turn down. “What makes you think that?”

“There was a newspaper article about it. 25 years ago. All witnesses say he was out of control. They had a hard time stopping him. He was 3 times the legal limit. They don't know if he blacked out or was distracted; that man took your family away. Not you. 5 year-old you didn't do anything wrong. You were a child. All you can do is love.” Mydei got off the table, going over to the man in tears.

Once close enough, Phainon wrapped his arms around Mydei's waist and cried. It was so hard for him to believe, but it confirmed what the nurses said a long time ago. No words were exchanged between them. There was an arm across his shoulders and in his hair, comforting him.

Finally leaning back, a sleeve came up to dry his face off. “Look, I don't want you to leave, but I also can't stop you. I can't MAKE you change your

mind about me….. or us. I guess, of anything, thank you for the wonderful time we had. It means the world to me. It's the last thing, though.”

“What do you mean by the last thing?”

“I can't do this again. My heart has hurt too badly from both experiences of caring. I can't do it for another. It's too much. I'm just going to break it to my father; he is never getting his wish. Even more so with assholes like that piece of shit around.”

Mydei tried to pull back, but Phainon's arms held him tight. “There is so much I want to say. First off, I am sorry for all the times I've made you cry. You are too beautiful to be that sad.” His head tilted into Phainon's hand along his face.

“Also….”

A slamming fist against the door broke his thought. ”Mydeimos, I know you're in there. Please come out.”

It was the son. Being back in a hallway, secluded, Phainon had enough. “Text your guards. Have them come here in about 10 minutes.”

He went over to the door, unbuttoning a few more buttons before opening it. Just to provoke him into starting first, he leaned against the door frame. The most sultry pose he could muster showed off more of his skin. “Mr. Kremnos is having a meeting right now. I can take a message if you like.”

“I think you need to move out of my way and let me have some private time with him. YOU did interrupt me.” The son was almost to the point of boiling over.

“Ohh, do I now? And what makes you think that time needs to be spent on you? I think that's more his choice.” Phainon knew his snark was going to win.

“Because I'm the type of man that can make that prince submit. He would look sooo pretty as my wife.” There was the cess pool.

“So you just want to control him?....Nothing is there for love. Treat him like you did all those workers at the brothel?”

“WhY YoUuu!?!? ” The anger was flaring, just a bit more pushing.

“And treat him like your own personal cock sleeve and not the prince needing worship and love?? I think not, Haikas.”

From inside the room, everything could be heard. Mydei was stunned by the conversation. When the hell did he learn that word??

There was the spark. A fist came flying at his face. Dogging, it slammed into the door frame. The other hand came at him, Phainon caught it mid-flight, twisting it around. His knee came up, right into the area below the ribs, in the stomach.

The body dropped to the ground. And just on time, the guards were there. They saw the physical altercation, not the words.

“Mr. Khaslana!! Are you alright? Are you hurt at all??”

“Well….I had to have something of a conversation with him, which was gross, and the stuff he said about Mydei was deplorable. But physically, I am fine. He is safe in the room. “

“Thank goodness, we will take care of him right away. Thank you for protecting Mr. Kremnos.”

“Security is my job.” He said with a smile to them. “Ohhh, and boys, you may want the authorities to look into his background. There are many questionable things there… not sure how recent.” There were times when he used his skills for nefarious purposes. Like making criminal accounts reappear on his civilian records. That's what you get for fucking around with an IT wizard like me. I know hacking skills most don't. You aren't hiding your sins from anyone any longer.

“Thank you, sir, will do.” With a bow, they dragged the body away. Once out of sight, he could safely go back into the room.

Once back inside, he relocked the door behind him.

“So anyways… as I was saying…”

Mydei reached up, grabbing the ribbon hanging from his neck, pulling it towards him. It was just enough of a tug that Phainon couldn't stop his body from being pulled forward, slotted right up against Mydei's.

He wasn't sure when the jacket came off or when Mydei was back against the table, but the AC needed to work a little harder.

Mydei took the ribbon, winding it around his hand. “Then I need to thank my knight, for protecting HIS prince.” Before a word of interjection could be had, Mydei took that leap. He pulled their lips together with the ribbon. Shock overtook Phainon's system first. Never in his lifetime or anyone's lives did he ever think that his first kiss would be from the man he's had sexual fantasies about since he was 16. Now with them both being 30, his love has grown with time. The last 8 years let him see so much.

The second shock to him was just how good it felt. To have that command pull him into something that was wanted, just made his desire work overtime. Phainon's whole body was being ignited with a pleasure he's never felt. No other person had come this far. He was being made to let go. Giving up control for just that moment, he enjoyed it.

The 3rd and most important shock of them all, being slotted up against Mydei's body, he could feel the erection straining in those dark pants. It was rubbing right up against his.

Lips that were soft, but needy broke from his. Mydei tried to catch his breath. “Look, I'm sorry. I overstepped again. I just wanted to feel a kiss once in my life, from someone who means the world to me.” He let the ribbon fall from his hands. Even though both men were very turned on, Mydei didn't know what his place was in Phainon's heart. He was afraid to ask.

He grabbed his coat, ready to leave the table.

“Where are you going?”

“Not going to give you the chance to say goodbye.” He didn't want to hear those words. It already hurt too much.

Hands were placed on either side of him, boxing Mydei into the table. “How about you help me test something instead?" Sunset hair flopped to the side in confusion. “I WANT to see…. Just how soundproof these walls are.”

Amber eyes widened, and then closed. Opening again with a softness and lust. “Am I too much?"

“No, I'm willing to touch the fire. Take the trial, try to get over what haunts me. I want to take that journey with you. I want to let you in. In turn, worship you, as you deserve.” He pushes his own aching tent against Mydei's. Hearing a soft gasp escape his lips.

“Will you make love to me right here and now?” Soft fingers came down the side of Phainon’s face.

“Your wish is my command.”

~~~~~~~

Chapter End Notes

See, all the angst and sadness was worth it. They finally admitted their feelings. Now what will happen behind the closed will be maybe more than Phainon's wildest dreams.

chapters.title: Chapter 16
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

With the cesspool of sin throughly taken care of, Phainon could now get back to what was most important: a hot young CEO in a three-piece suit that wanted him badly. Everything before his eyes made Phainon want him more.

But ohh was he going to be in for some suprises. They always say its the quiet ones you have to watch out for, and Mydei was no exception.

Chapter Notes

No beta read

SOOOOOO!!! Originally this was the last chapter. But my friend that I roll suggestions and ideas off of said that yea where the story ended was fine.. but there should be ar least a little bit more.

Soo, 1 more is coming 😏😉

“My command? Take me how you've always dreamed. I want to feel how much you adore me. Why did I make this(slotting his leg between Phainon’s, pushing up)so hard at the hotel? The hardon I tried to hide, soaking wet in front of you in the car, most likely teasing. You probably saw it. I want whatever you will give.” Mydei shifted his hips up a little more, getting the slightest bit of friction for it.

“You know, you look so amazing in that three-piece suit. That does really turn me on. With those glasses on, I wanted those eyes on me.” Leaning in, he placed soft kisses along any exposed neck available. Hand moving down his chest to the snaps of the vest, undoing them one by one.

“Maybe….maybe I'll have to wear it and no shirt.” His whole body was alive. Every sensor didn't know how to handle the new feeling surging through his veins. It was addictive. It felt good. One hand balanced on the table, the other ran through the fields of winter snow. Once the vest was free, he shrugged it off his shoulders, throwing it wherever.

Right now, neither cared.

Both of Phainon’s hands came up to the luscious chest he'd only seen from afar and squeezed.
