chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

You know what the worst thing is for a needy, clingy puppy? For the one thing you have attached yourself to has to go on a business trip for a whole month. Ok, yea, you can have texts and video calls, but it isn't the same as the warm body next to you or in a tight hug.

So, Phainon has a month without Mydei. What will he do with this time and where does Kyros fit into all this?

Chapter Notes

Happy 1 year writing anniversary!! I hope you enjoy the ending !

Sat. October 4th, one week left

Against all things he loves on the weekend, Phainon got his butt out of bed at 6am. Right now, sleeping in was for the weak.

It's been almost a month since Mydei went on a conference trip with his parents. Leaving him alone in a big soft bed, all by his lonesome. Because of the nature of the trip, they wouldn't have had much time to spend together. So Phainon had the whole big house to himself.

Which is terribly lonely.

Even video chats were short. He could tell at the end of the day that his prince was tired. The hotel they were in was very posh, but he knew Mydei wanted HIS bed and HIS Phainon.

Eating was even worse.

Sure, Mydei did make him a lot of food for the duration of his trip, and froze it for him, but it just wasn't the same. Spending evenings together making food. Phainon wasn't a gourmet chef by any stretch of the imagination, but he tried to help. Poorly cutting vegetables(though it did improve), stirring soups or sauces, and anything to help the meal prep together. The most fancy thing he's ever made was stuffed French toast. Everything else was basic things.

But this...this was special. Loneliness and boredom can lead to incredible things. Mydei always does so much for him. Before and after they got together, the CEO never changed. Always stayed the same selfless person. He always gave so much to those around him. NEVERasking for anything in return. There were times when he would walk into the office at 7 am, meetings and business work all day, and not walk into his own place till 1 am. Then do it all again the next day. If one of the restaurants needed help, he was the first one that was called, per his request.

Buying a house for himself was the first time in, probably forever, that he did something for himself. Getting out and doing something on your own, not tied to the family, must have been a huge relief. Now sharing a big house with someone made his soul that much happier. If one could read auras, he would be much brighter now.

After they confessed their feelings, Mydei tried to ask him to move in in the most subtle ways possible. He was still afraid of asking for big things like that. Phainon took a little bit to get the hints, but when he did, was overjoyed to come and share his life with a partner.

Once black pants and a white shirt were all neat and presentable, Phainon made his way downstairs. Turning on his phone, he was greeted with a ‘good morning’ message from Mydei, sent everyday before heading to work. Below was the one he was looking for.

Kyros

He was one of Mydei's head chefs for the restaurant in town. The best man to help head  operations, if you ask a lot of people, that person was him.

Phainon wanted to do something special, romantic. Have a proper date. Since getting together, they have spent most of their free time at home. Weekends were even hectic from time to time.

Through it all, they still made love at least 3 times a week. Both were finding new things about themselves and the other. With how much care and attention Phainon was given, more barriers were crumbling. Mydei's love carried a hammer that wasn't huge or overbearing. It was soft chisels that worked into the pressure points, cracking the whole wall.

Mydei had at least gotten him to the point where parts of his shoulders and neck could be thoroughly touched. He always waited, never asked for more; it was on Phainon's time with what he was comfortable with. It wasn't much, but it was progress. Helping him get over his own insecurities was a big hurdle, now done together.

So how did Kyros fit into this whole date equation?

Phainon had found the perfect condo to rent in town. Top floor. Looking over the entire city. The landscape could be seen for miles. He wanted to TRY cooking something special for Mydei. Knowing his own skills were less than par, he didn't have time with videos on the internet to learn. He needed a master. That master was Kyros.

Phainon had known him ever since he took the contract from Evernight. Besides setting up his security, he saw him a lot of nights for takeout. They were well acquainted with each other.

¤¤¤¤¤¤

The day Mydei left for his trip, the decision was made for the romantic dinner. Picking a place was easy; he just needed help with the hard part.

That afternoon, shortly after the lunch rush, at 2pm, Kyros was in his usual haunt. The back corner of the kitchen, sitting on a bar stool, tablet in hand, going over the meals and prep for the evening.

“It's almost like they put you on time out,” the bright smile said, meandering back to his hiding spot.

“Mr. Khaslana?! Sir, I…uhmm…shit.” Kyros was totally not expecting company. “Hi, is something wrong? You don't normally come see me, unless it's an important matter.”

Phainon smiled again. He was nervous to ask for help. “Well, it is important. You see Mydei...”

“Did you two break up already?? Dude, I’m so sorry.” His hand was over his heart, showing how much he cared.

“WhATtt!? Ohh gods noo… noo.. and uhmm no.”

“Are you sure?? Like you two good?” Kyros figured their relationship out the night Mydei told him that he was paying for the tech's dinner.

“Yea, dude.. noo we are good. I just have a problem. I was wondering if you could help me with it.” Pulling up a stool next to the head chef, Kyros poured him a drink.

The glass was slowly filled with a creamy white fluid, slightly yellow in color. Pulling it to his face, he caught the slightest whiff of alcohol from it. What he did pick up on was sweet lemons. Even though it wasn't wine, using what he learned at the Vineyard, he tasted it like a culinary master. He was trying to show off a little.

“I can see why he likes you, you're as bright as the lemons used to make this.”

“Is it usual to drink this early in the day? Does the boss know you get drunk at work?” Taking another sip, it went down smooth. It was creamy with just the hint of the sweet lemons.

A big, hearty laugh came from the chef, confusing him more. He then took a drink of his own. It was on the more clear side with just a slight hint of yellow. Bubbles floating to the top. “Well, no, I don't. You just looked like

you needed something to take the edge off. That is a ‘crema di limoncello'; it is a creamer version of the regular. Mine is just a sparkling fruit drink.”

Phainon felt dumb, but also cared for. It was becoming a new thing for him.

“You're good. So what's up with the boss?”

“He has to go on this month-long trip with his parents. I couldn't go because it was all business stuff. We face time at night. I can tell he's tired. There is probably so much going on that it's a lot, physically and mentally. Doesn't want to, but it's his job.” Hand just held the glass, staring at his image, distorted in the fluid.

“Puppy having separation anxiety?” Kyros was aware of the joke between the two men. Mydei made an off-hand comment one night, rolling out dough for the special dish of the night. He could never take it back.

“Yes,” Mydei hadn't even been gone 24 hrs yet, and he was already lonely. He was attached and didn't want to let go.

Rubbing him on the shoulder, “It will get easier with time, trust me. So how do I fit into your pining?” Laughing, he continues the work on the tablet.

Steeling himself, he takes a very big drink of the liquor in front of him. Letting the words come right out.”TEACH ME TO COOK!”

Kyros stopped what he was doing, very confused.

“He always does so much for everyone, for me. Never asking anything back. I want to do something romantic for him when he comes back. Watching the internet won't help me fast enough. I only have a month. I wanted to see if you could help me. I'll even pay you for your time.” He tried not to look at the man beside him. He was prepared for rejection. Running a restaurant is a lot of work. Phainon was just some dude trying to impress his boyfriend. Who just so happens to be his boss.

“You know he'd be impressed with just grilled cheese?” There is no tone to Kyros’ voice. Just words.

Phainon knew it was dumb to ask. He felt dejected and stupid. He would just have to do the best with his measly skills. He went to get off the stool, eyes to the ground, “I'm sorry for bothering you. Uhmm… thanks for the drink. I'll pay for it on my way ou….”

A strong calloused, burnt, and cut-ridden hand grabbed his wrist. “But I'd be more than happy to help.”

“But you…”

“Was just messing. Plus, it's different seeing your vulnerable side. Sit”

Just like the puppy he was, Phainon sat back down.

“Look, to be honest, I have no issue helping, but I owe you.” The snow-haired man pointed at himself in confusion. “Yes, you. For saving the boss at the party. I didn't like them from the minute they walked in, and something just didn't sit right when they were around him like vultures. I couldn't get over it. They had people in the way. I'm glad you did what you did. So for many reasons and because you're important to a good friend, I'll help.”

“Please don't talk about them, it will spoil my drink.” A laugh finally came from them both.

“So Mr. Tech Wizard, what did you have in mind?”

“I was gonna rent a condo in the city. Top floor. Amazing view. I wanted to cook for him. Cook something special, but my skills are ass, and the internet is too slow and inaccurate.”

Kyros was touched by hearing the plan. That someone was willing to put that much heart and effort into the once untouchable CEO. “You know it isn't gonna be easy? I have been doing this for a long time. I have been told by many under me that I am a tough teacher.”

“I know, but it's worth it for him.”

Setting his tablet down, he pulls out his own phone. “Let's get started on planning.”

¤¤¤¤¤¤

Being the head of security, Phainon could let himself into the building. Considering it was 6:30am, it was no big deal. A few of the overnight staff were in. They had gotten used to seeing the two men, even before the sun had peaked over the mountains.

“We have 6 days left. I have to say, for someone who spends a lot of time behind a computer screen, I'm very impressed.” He paused, pushing his lips together, sucking them in. “You're very good with your hands.”

Just a small snicker left Phainon's nose. Trying to be professional this early is hard.

“So, here is what we are gonna do over the next 3 days. I'm gonna have you do 1 dish a day. On the 4th day, you have to do the full course meal. So, come Friday night, you can do it all before he arrives.” Kyros tied his usual apron around, watching the sleepy man before him.

“Yes, chef.” It was affirmative, but still sleepy. He had been going every day before work, after, and longer lessons on the weekends.

Phainon looks down his list of things:

-Appetizer:

~Small loaf of Bruschetta

~Italian wedding soup

-Drink:

~Crema di Limoncello

-Main 1:

-Baked Gnocchi with Vodka Sauce and

Burrata cheese

~Main 2:

-Osso Buco: Braised veal shanks, tomato-based sauce, and gremolata

~Desert:

-Tiramisu

“What we will do, the desert will be made on Wednesday. So it has time to sit and get its flavors. Are you good with your 3-day task? Do each one so you can get it perfected. Then bring it all together. Hopefully, on Thursday, I can go with you to get everything you need and set the place up.” Kyros wanted this to go well for them both. They deserve to have a good time. If all it takes is a bit of shopping, lessons, and set up, he's more than happy to help.

Phainon’s head almost touched his knees, bowing in thankfulness and respect to Kyros for helping him. “DUDE.. I can not begin to thank you enough for all this.”

He was slightly embarrassed by all the praise. “Come on, lover boy. No need for all this praise. You two are my friends. I'm more than happy to help. So let's get this started. Everything will be done by yourself today. What you need for the first set is all back in our area. I'm going to go help the rest of the morning crew with their prep. I'll come back in an hour just to check. Good deal?”

Phainon stood tall with his orders, like a soldier on the front lines. He was ready to prove the lessons paid off. Everything up to this point was all small portions of things. The next four days will be portions made out for two people. “Yes, Chef!”

~~~~~

Mydei finally had some time to himself. Meeting and traveling have been very tiring. He knew it needed to be done, but missed HIS home. He was so grateful that it was almost over. Six more days. I'm just so done. I never thought I'd miss sex. Hell, it isn't just that, it's everything. It wasn't so bad in the past, but now having someone at home, it makes it hard to be away.

A knock on the wall brings his attention back to the present.

“Dear?? Are you alright? After the meeting, you snuck off. That isn't like you.” Gorgo comes over and sits beside her son on the window bench.

“Nope, I'm great.” He didn't want to worry her.

A soft smile adorns her strawberry blond hair, just like her son's. “You miss him, don't you?”

“I have work to do, mother. I can't be…”He is silenced when her finger is placed over his lips.

“My son, you have found love. It is ok to let it show. I don't want you to end up like your father and not show it when it matters. Phainon is an incredible person. You have found love with him. You were harder to crack than the toughest pomegranate shell.” Holding her son's hand to give him comfort.

“He was so nervous to meet you guys. I told him he was fine, but his anxiety was telling him otherwise. Probably seeing the type of people that came to court me, he figures some ‘nerd’ like him would be looked down upon.” A heavy sigh left his chest. He knew this relationship was going to be a lot of work for both of them. To trust and care for another person, but also to let that care in, it’s tough.

“Was he afraid that we wouldn't accept him, also, because he was a man?”

“That may have been a worry of his, piled up on everything else. I told him it was fine. And for the off chance neither of you two would like him(which I knew you would love him) or not, then I would cut ties for him. It was my life, and if he wasn't accepted, then I wanted no part of it.”

A warm laugh emanated from her. She knew her son. If it was something he wanted, nothing would stop him. Always like a true Kremonan. “Well, I'm glad things turned out. Just a couple more days.”

“There is the issue. Yea, I'm getting back around dinner time, but apparently I won't see him till way later. He told me something had come up, and he wouldn't be able to get me from the airport.” The sadness was so evident in his voice. His yearning was probably as strong as Phainon’s was.

Gorgo rubbed her son's back; she could tell he was hurting. Being a first love would be hard for anyone to be away from for a long period of time. They had only been together for three months, and Phainon had just moved in at the end of August.

“If you want, I can try to get you out of some meeting tom….”

“No, mother, I'm fine. It's my job. I have to do this. You both entrusted me to take care of these restaurants, and I'd be failing them if I bailed on meetings because I miss my boyfriend.”

She knew there was no convincing him. He was just like her after all. Not taking no for an answer, doing what the heart desired. His father wasn't so bad back when his parents first got together, but then business became his life. It was hard to peel him away from it. She was just glad Mydei wasn't becoming like that.

“We have some time before the next meeting, about a half hour or so. Give him a call. It will help.” Getting up, she moved his bangs, kissing her cub's forehead. “I want a happy kitty when I see you in a bit.”

With that direct order, she disappeared down the hall.

“I guess I have to then. I don't want to be yelled at. I fear her more than my father.”

Opening his phone, it was two in the afternoon. Being that it is on a Saturday, things shouldn't be too busy.

“I'll at least send a text asking if he's busy.”

The quickest text was sent. The waiting game began. Was he busy, awake?? It was hard to tell. They both knew constant massaging would be a distraction; per Phainon’s decision, they would wait. They only had their calls at night and a text when each got up. This was going to be out of the blue.

About 10 minutes had passed. Mydei was starting to lose hope that he wasn't busy.

Then dots appeared.

He wanted to make sure nothing was being interrupted. The reply made a soft smile appear on his face, the first genuine smile he's had during the day.

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

Phai:

I'd stop the world. Even hold my breath. If it meant I could share even 5 minutes of your fire. It brings me so much warmth that when we aren't together, I always want to seek it out. All because …..I love you.

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

The video call was placed.

¤¤¤¤¤

Mydei:

Are you always this romantic?

Do you woo all the circuitry and programs with that language?

Phai:

*the brightest smile is on his face*

Dude, if I knew that language,

I would have to be afraid of machines trying to take me from you. So…. Uhmm, is everything ok?

You normally don't call during the day.

(Lucky for him, he was just done with Kyros. The surprise may have been ruined if he called any sooner. They were still in the kitchen. The dishes that he worked on, he could take home, but he decided to share them with the house. They were all excited to try it. Knowing their head chef was teaching, they all had faith in Phainon's abilities. So going to get pizza would be an easy cover.)

Mydei:

Yea, mother is just too perceptive of things.

She told me I'd better stop moping and call you

or her and I were going to have words.

Phai:

*the smile was brighter*

Thanks, mom. Guess we can't fool her.

Sooo…. Uhmm..

I know I say this a bunch…but I really miss you.

It's hard having that big bed to myself.

Or not helping you cook things.

I'm being needy.

I'm sorry.

Mydei:

Noo, don't be sorry.

I feel the same way.

I'm gonna be totally honest with you.

I have maybe ‘done it’ once since I've been on this trip.

Like some time during the first week.

My mood has been so killed by everything.

On top of just being tired at the end of the day.

I can't even have a long conversation with you.

Phai:

I know.

I’m that irresistible.

Mydei:

*a soft grin peaks on his lips*

Ok, haikas. I'll let you think that.

Phai:

I will, ‘caz I know it's true.

‘Caz you love me.

Mydei:

I do.

Just sucks that I have to wait so long to see you.

Late Friday night is too far away.

I'm thankful Kyros offered to get me.

He had texted me way after I talked to you about it.

I was complaining that I'll have to take a cab home, when he offered.

Still not the same.

Phai:

I know, he's just not as handsome as me.

PLUS, he's taken.

I guess he does kinda have that DILF energy.

Bet his husband makes everyone jealous.

The kid is cute as well.

Mydei:

I can't believe…. No, I can.

I can believe you said that.

Please don't say that around him.

(He notices the box on the front seat. It's a pizza box from Evernight.)

At least you aren't going to other places to get that.

Everyone there would be offended.

You're dating the CEO

and going to a commercial chain....God.

Phai:

I wouldn't dream of it.

…

…

Hey

*a soft grunt was his reply*

I do really miss you.

It's so lonely.

I'm whining again.

Mydei:

Yea, me too, but soon.

I'm gonna have to work on this time frame next time this happens.

I just might say fuck it and bring you.

(Soft shoes can be heard in the background. A woman sits down beside him.)

Gorgo:

Good afternoon, Phainon.

Phai:

Ohhh uhmm..

Hi, Mrs. Kremnos.

Lovely to see you again.

Gorgo:

Phainon, really??

It was less than a week for Castorice to call me Mama G.

You are dating my son.

I hope you can be less stiff around me.

Phai:

Sorry, I just get nervous.

You're very important to him.

I just want….

Mydei:

‘Make a good impression’?

Again… we sleep together.

Phai:

*face becomes instantly red*

Dddduuuddeeeee..

Gorgo:

Mydei stop being proud of yourself.

He's all embarrassed now.

Anyway, I just came to check on you boys,

the next meeting is soon, unfortunately

So, I'm afraid I have to steal your lion.

This is the last one for the day, but it's longer.

Plus dinner.

I'll make sure he calls after.

Mydei:

Mother, you don't have to.

I have called him every night.

Phai:

Sometimes, he falls asleep on the phone.

I wait a good 5 minutes before I hang up.

Just till he's out.

Gorgo:

Well, dear, you take care,

and I'll see you whenever we get back.

*She leaves as effortlessly, as she arrived*

Mydei:

I guess I have to go.

Don't eat all that pizza in one go.

It would be bad for your system.

Phai:

Thanks.

*smiling alot*

Go to your meeting,

the sooner you do, the closer you are to coming home.

Love you.

Mydei:

Yea, yea haikas. I love you, too.

Behave yourself till later.

¤¤¤¤¤¤¤

The call ends from Mydei's end. He's always been very weird at phone goodbyes. It may seem weird, but Phainon knows he cares. There was a part deep down inside that was just a bit happier getting to see his lion, more than just being tired at the end of the day.

He could tell Mydei felt the same.

All the time, he only got up because he had to, not because he wanted to. The want to get up deteriorated very quickly upon his move into the house. Mydei insisted they share the bedroom. It would have made dating very weird, having separate rooms. Phainon was given his own space, though.

The room down the hall, upper floor, on the outer wall was the perfect place for his computers. The house wasn't in line with anything outside, so all types of internet signals could reach him easily. The best thing for him? He

didn't have to share the internet with anyone. Being throttled down because there are too many people taking up bandwidth in one building is gone. Phainon was given full leeway to do whatever with the room.

Having a lot of tech initially made housing hard in his small apartment, but then it all had a place. Now he had so much more room for things. He even added some new items he's been itching to get his hands on.

Living in the same house, not so many cameras were needed. There's more than one person living in the abode now. The secrets in the bedroom, however, he still kept them just in case. Maybe he wanted to watch them later or catch a sneaky lion doing things while he was away.

Once back at the house, he ate in the kitchen. Phainon didn't want to drag leftovers all over the house. The ricotta and steak pizza would last him a few days. This pie, in particular, was extra special; he helped make it. Tons of pictures were taken of his schooling to show Mydei later.

Now he needed to go over the list:

Is the condo booked for the weekend? Check.

Grocery list finished? Check.

Prettiest flowers ordered? Check.

Sexy suit laid out? Check.

The most beautiful necklace with a gold sun and a silver moon that interlocked. Both getting the other's opposite piece?

Check.

“Well, now that this is all in order, I just have to make it through the rest of the week. It's going to take forever." The pizza he helped make was so good that he ate at least 4 pieces. All the slices were skinny to get the most out of the pie.

Soon. I just hope you love it.

~~~~~~

The week flew by in a flash. There were so many meetings he had attended in the past month, Mydei didn't want another for the next month. He might have to have Castorice schedule any requests for a very future date, unless it was urgent.

No more people. He was exhausted from seeing and listening to so much talking. Yes, the family ate together during the day, but there was no respite.

The plane ride was six hours long, taking his arrival time to around 4:30pm. Just enough time to take a nap. He wanted to be up when Phainon came home from work.

Or so he thought.

Closing the distance to home, the nearer they approached, a storm was passing through. The pilot had informed everyone that they were going to be an hour late.

A nudge shifted him out of a dreamless sleep. “Mydei, honey?”

“Hmph”

“Hey, you might want to text Kyros. We are going to be an hour late. We just hit a storm. Nothing bad, just a delay.”

The grumpy and sleepy look on her cub's face said everything. It was bad enough having all these meetings, not seeing his boyfriend, and now he had to wait longer to get home. He was not a happy kitty.

Fishing the phone from his jacket pocket, a quick text was sent. Informing his driver of the bad news. The reply was very quick.

I wonder if he took the day off for me. I guess that is what friends are for.

The reply was simple. Mydei was told to take his time and stay safe. He'll be there when the plane gets in. Not to worry about anything.

His eyes couldn't stay open any longer. For the duration of the flight, Mydei was going back to bed. Deep down, he was hoping Phainon wasn't too sleepy to see him. So the more rest he got now, the longer they could stay up.

Phainon was worth it.

The rest of the flight went by in a flash for a sleepy passenger. Gorgo gently woke her son, informing him that they would be landing soon. Kyros must be watching the boards for the flight. He sent a text saying ‘see you in 20 mins’. Mydei was fully aware that even on a more private flight, unloading passengers and luggage would take a while.

The plane touched down at 5:30pm. Rain was still falling outside, but not enough to be disruptive. It cooled everything off. The smell of fall was in the air.

Leaving the terminal, Kyros was waiting for him. Engrossed in something on his phone.

“I didn't take you to play games on your phone?” A touch of sleepiness could be heard in his jab, but he was way more awake than earlier.

“No, sadly, that's my husband's thing with our daughter. He and Serena love to play either co-op or against each other. It's funny to watch. How are you feeling?”

“I guess ok after that nap. More like a sleep, I suppose.” A faint grumble sound emanated from him.

“Hungry as well. I guess you slept through the meal on board?” Grabbing Mydei's on board luggage, they headed to the area where the rest was.

“Yea, that chair was almost better than any hotel bed.”

“Well, let's hurry up and get your stuff. Then we can get you fed.”

20 minutes later..

“I'll take you to get something to eat. I'm gonna text Theo to see if there is anything they want. I'll take it home after I drop you off.”

In reality, he texted Phainon to see how everything was going. His reply was good. All the food is done. Got a little burn on the inside of his arm from the oven, just wasn't at the right height. (The joys of being a chef).Phainon was finishing getting dressed right now.

I'm so excited for them. Even more so because of the work the puppy put into this. He's got this. Kyros smiled to himself.

Mydei was busy playing on his phone when the car stopped. Looking up, it didn't feel like a restaurant, more like a hotel or a business office. Kyros got out of the car, pulled out an umbrella, and came around to his side. Opening the door for him.

“Uhmm Kyros… Do we have the right place? This doesn't look like a place for food.” Getting out of the car, he was more confused than ever. The chef walked quietly beside him to the front door. The umbrella was closed, and Kyros fished for something in his jacket.

Grabbing Mydei's hand, a key was placed in it.

Room 702

Confusion was written all over the blond's face.

“You need to pick up dinner there. Get going.” With no more words being said, Kyros shushed him inside. Then promptly ‘leaving’ from the view of the confused lion. He went around back to the extra parking space. Phainon left his car unlocked for him to deposit the luggage. An envelope was left in the trunk with his name on it. Phainon had used Mydei's influence to show his appreciation. Buying Kyros a thank-you gift for everything. The hotel where they stayed, he got them a week's pass for it, with all the amenities and entertainment included.

He was so touched by it all, and Kyros knew he couldn't argue. When Phainon put his mind to it, there was no stopping.

The rest was up to them.

~~~~~~

The whole elevator ride to the top floor left the tired and hungry kitty in such a confused state. This wasn't someone's home or a place to get food. These were living condos. The only thing he could fathom was that a friend of Kyros’ had food, but then he took off. Leaving him here. Questions just hanging in the air.

Nothing made sense.

Room 702

Taking a deep breath, the key was placed in and turned. Mydei was bewildered and didn't know what to expect.

“Hello?” Quietly, he walked in, but then his senses were hit with all sorts of things going on at once.

Classical music was playing. The soft sound of the rain could be heard against the windowpanes. The air was full of so many familiar smells. He knew them all by heart.

Cresting the opening of the hallway to the rest of the condo, he stopped. Breath was taken away to some far-off land. His amber eyes tried to take in everything he saw.

The ambiance of the rain. Medium length table with a beautiful bouquet of flowers adorning it. Candles are lighting the table in a soft glow.

His feet pulled him forward. His mind was trying to piece everything together. Fingers gently touching the red and black petals. “God, these are beautiful.”

A voice from the bedroom, pulling his eyes towards it. “Not as beautiful as you, my Prince.”

“Ph..ai..non??”

“In the flesh.” Mydei couldn't take his eyes off the man coming toward him. Phainon’s suit perfectly mirrored his own. White suit with a black shirt and a striking blue tie. It all complemented his own black suit, black shirt, and a red tie, always in perfect sync with each other.

“What…what is all of this?”

Once close enough, Phainon picked up Mydei's hand, kissing the back. “I wanted to do something special for you. You always give so much to everyone, including me. Never asking anything in return. So, I wanted to give you something to show how much I love you. For all that you've done for me. Helped me understand my past. Been there through all my breakdowns. Everything. You mean so much to me.”

Just listening to him speak, Mydei was trying so hard to hold back the tears. Just seeing him was enough, but to have all these caring words spoken to him like a love poem. Then to have done all of this. The dam was so hard to hold back.

“Soo, I have a confession. Kyros was in on the whole thing.”

Mydei's face had the slightest bit of shock, but he wasn't surprised at all. Kyros has an amazing poker face.

“So after you left, I went to visit him to see if he'd teach me how to cook. Almost made me sad when he said you'd be happy with just grilled cheese, but then he was more than happy to teach me. Because my passion was that strong for you, he couldn't say no. Plus, it's you. So, over the past month, I learned how to cook you a full meal. I did it every day. Even on the weekends.”

“Really?? I don't buy that. You value your weekend sleep.” Folding his arms over his chest, a smile adorns his face.

“I did. Even when there were overnight people still there working in the morning..”

“Phainon… that’s from 2am till 10am. Are you really telling me you forwent your weekends to get up early?” He was still very skeptical.

Phainon pulled out his phone, showing him the gallery of his work. There were pics every day of progress. There were ones taken on the weekend with a time stamp of 7:10am.

“Anything for you.”

He couldn't hold back any longer, arms wrapped around Phainon's neck. His face nuzzled into the snow-white locks, smelling the sweet scent he's become so fond of. Arms came around his waist, pulling him in. After being gone so long, bombarded with meetings, and a longing that rivaled any poem, Mydei's tears were flowing. Caught by the snow before him. Everything was just so wonderful.

Phainon was wonderful.

Yes, he can sometimes be a pain. It was never done out of malice. He's always been playful. Possibly, if the accident never happened, the sun would be shining even brighter. It didn't matter. Mydei was home and being spoiled by the man he loves.

Pulling back, a deep blue napkin wiped his tears. Lips trying to kiss them all away.

“Hungry?” Loving lips touched the side of Mydie's face.

“I haven't eaten since this morning. I was too tired to eat on the flight.”

“Hey, before we eat, I have something for you.” Reaching into his pants pocket, Phainon pulls out a red velvet box. All neatly tied off with a black and gold bow.

“You didn't have to.”

“Yea, well I did, so no take-backsies.” There was that infectious smile Mydei had missed. There was something about it that warmed even the gloomiest days. That smile belonged to him and was so easy to get.

The ribbon was pulled and set aside on the counter. The box was slowly opened to jewelry that danced in the light. Two necklaces, interlocked in the middle. A half sun holding on to the moon. Almost like an eclipse. A rare thing in the night sky, just as rare as their love.

“I wanted to get us some kind of matching jewelry. Rings would be at a later date, but this we can keep closer to our hearts when the other isn't around.”

Wait.. did I hear him right? Rings?? At a later date?! He'd....really want to marry me? Shit…. I need not think about this right now, or I'm going to cry again.

Closing the box, it's placed on the counter. Amber eyes meet cerulean. Oceans of time just flow between them. Mydei wrapped his arms around the snow-white fields, getting lost in their soft feel again. Lips came together in a most tender kiss. It was slow but desperate. The time being apart has made their need for each other stronger.

They held this kiss in what felt like eternity. Neither wanted to let go, but oxygen was needed. Breaking apart to heavy breaths, foreheads against each other.

“Soo, are you going to let me woo you with my fantastic cooking?”

A light smirk and laugh left his kiss-swollen lips. “Is it though?” Not mean, just to tease.

“I would hope to fuck so.. or Kyros needs to go back to culinary school. And I worked on this for like a …”

Finger was placed on his lips.”It's ok. I'm just picking. I know what he demands of his cooks and even more so of himself. It wouldn't be as harsh with you, but wouldn't let you go easy either.”

“Yeaaa, he is a tough teacher. I had an easier time in tech school, but he was an amazing teacher.”

“Soo, tell me puppy, what did you make good?”

“Well, how about you sit down and I can serve you. Let someone take care of you for once.” Walking over to his seat, Phainon pulled out a chair for his love.

“Not that I don't appreciate it, but just to note: Prince, not Princess.” Part of him is having a hard time being pampered. Seeing how excited his puppy was over the whole thing, it was just something he'd have to get used to.

A kiss is placed on his cheek. “I know.” Walking away mumbling to himself; Maybe princess in bed.

“You'd better be glad I like you. I heard that smart ass comment.”

“It’s from an ass you love.” Plating up the starters. “Especially when I'm getting you to beg for more.”

“Haha, you are so insufferable, but…. You’re not wrong.’

With the smile on his face, Phainon knew he won.

Everything that Phainon is doing for him, the surprise hits Mydei right in the heart.

I don't think I could love this man any harder. It just sucks it took so long for us to meet. Now that I got him, I'm not letting go for anything. This is where I want to be.
